--// ++ Configuration ++
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local NodeService = {}

NodeService.pathfindProperties = {
	AgentHeight = 5,
	AgentRadius = 2,
	AgentCanJump = false,
	AgentCanClimb = false
}

--// ++ Main script ++

type NodeService = typeof(NodeService)

type NodeKey = string
type Vector3InString = string

type Angle = number

type NodeDictionary = { [Vector3] : { [Vector3] : Angle } }

local nodeIndex : { [NodeKey] : NodeDictionary } = {}

local function GetAngle(anchorPoint : Vector3, variablePoint : Vector3) : Angle
	local delta = anchorPoint - variablePoint
	local dx, dz = delta.X, delta.Z

	--// Compute angle from -Z axis, clockwise
	local angleDeg = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.X, -delta.Z)) --// Note the `-dz`

	return angleDeg < 0 and angleDeg + 360 or angleDeg
end

--// Initializes the node set and saves it, also it returns invalid nodes
function NodeService.Initialize(self : NodeService,nodeKey : NodeKey, nodeFolder : Folder & {BasePart}, visualize : boolean?)
	
	assert(
		typeof(nodeKey) == "string",
		`NodeService Module error; :Initialize() -> parameter nodeKey must be a string`
	)

	assert(
		nodeFolder:IsDescendantOf(workspace),
		`NodeService Module error; :Initialize() -> parameter nodeFolder must be a descendant of workspace`
	)

	local localNodeIndex = {}
	local invalidNodes = {}
	local allNodes = nodeFolder:GetChildren()

	--// Used to detect if the path to the neighborNode is obstructed
	local partForChecking = Instance.new("Part")
	partForChecking.Anchored = true
	partForChecking.CanCollide = false
	partForChecking.CanQuery = false
	partForChecking.Transparency = 1
	partForChecking.Parent = workspace

	--// Used to exclude unwanted parts when checking for path obstruction
	local overlapParamsForPartChecking = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParamsForPartChecking.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlapParamsForPartChecking.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Baseplate}

	--// Finds all valid neighborNode of each mainNode
	for index, mainNode in allNodes do
		
		if index % 10 == 0 then
			wait() --// Prevent script timeout
			print("Loading")
		end
		
		local mainNode = mainNode :: BasePart
		local mainNodePosition = mainNode.Position
		localNodeIndex[mainNodePosition] = {}

		local neighborPositions = localNodeIndex[mainNodePosition]
		local hasNeighbors : boolean

		local AgentDiameter = self.pathfindProperties.AgentRadius * 2

		for _, neighborNode in allNodes do
			local neighborNode = neighborNode :: BasePart

			--// Skips if it's iterating the same node
			if neighborNode == mainNode then continue end

			local neighborNodePosition = neighborNode.Position

			--// Places partForChecking at the midpoint of both nodes looking at the neighborNode
			partForChecking.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((neighborNodePosition + mainNodePosition) / 2, neighborNodePosition)

			partForChecking.Size = --// X = Diameter of the twisted's hitbox; Y = 1; Z = Distance between nodes
				Vector3.new(AgentDiameter, 1, (neighborNodePosition - mainNodePosition).Magnitude)

			--// Continues if path isn't clear
			if #workspace:GetPartsInPart(partForChecking, overlapParamsForPartChecking) ~= 0 then continue end

			if visualize then
				--// Path visualization
				local pathVisual = partForChecking:Clone()

				task.defer(function()
					pathVisual.Transparency = .8
					pathVisual.Parent = workspace
				end)

			end

			neighborPositions[neighborNodePosition] = GetAngle(mainNodePosition, neighborNodePosition)
			hasNeighbors = true
		end

		if hasNeighbors then continue end --// Continues if there are valid neighbors to mainNode
		localNodeIndex[mainNodePosition] = nil
		table.insert(invalidNodes, mainNode)
	end

	nodeIndex[nodeKey] = localNodeIndex
	return invalidNodes
end

--// Gets a specific set of nodes
function NodeService.Get(nodeKey : NodeKey)
	return nodeIndex[nodeKey]
end

local function IsInFOV(anchorAngle : Angle, variableAngle : Angle, FOVRangeHalfed : Angle) : boolean
	local shift = (variableAngle + 180 - anchorAngle) % 360
	return shift >= (180 - FOVRangeHalfed) and shift <= (180 + FOVRangeHalfed)
end

--// Generates a path the twisted can follow
function NodeService.Generate(
	self : NodeService,
	nodeKey : NodeKey,
	startPosition : Vector3,
	maxNodeChain : number,
	fovRange : Angle
) : {Vector3}

	assert(
		typeof(nodeKey) == "string",
		`NodeService Module error; :Generate() -> parameter nodeKey must be a string`
	)

	assert(
		typeof(startPosition) == "Vector3",
		`NodeService Module error; :Generate() -> parameter startPosition must be a Vector3 or a string`
	)

	local nodes = self.Get(nodeKey)

	assert(
		nodes,
		`NodeService Module error; :Generate() -> nodeKey isn't found in nodeIndex` 
	)

	local startDepth = 0

	--// Checks if the startPosition is a position of a node or not. Usually if it's not, it means the twisted just lost interest & is back to patrolling
	if not nodes[startPosition] then 
		local closestNodePosition : Vector3
		local closestNodeDistance = math.huge

		--// This loop finds the closest node to the start position
		for nodePosition, _ in nodes do
			local currentDistance = (startPosition - nodePosition).Magnitude

			if currentDistance >= closestNodeDistance then continue end

			closestNodePosition = nodePosition
			closestNodeDistance = currentDistance
		end

		startPosition = closestNodePosition
		--// Since the twisted isn't on a node, the beginning node is considered as the first waypoint
		-- DISABLED; Doesn't really work, will probably remove later
		--startDepth = 1
	end

	--// Randomized DFS algorithm
	local lastNodeSeesNeighbor : boolean? = false --// Saves the info if last node has nodes in its FOV
	local pathfindingFOVHalfed = fovRange / 2

	local stack : {{any}} = {{startPosition, startDepth}}
	local visitedSet : { [Vector3] : boolean } = {}
	local traversalOrder : { [number] : Vector3 } = {} --// Used to update the depth found in real time
	--// The longest valid path found, only updates whenever the longest valid path is found, obviously
	local longestTraversalOrder : typeof(traversalOrder) = {}
	local furthestDepth = startDepth

	while #stack > 0 do
		local nodeSet = table.remove(stack) :: {any} --// Pop last element (LIFO)
		local nodePosition : Vector3 = nodeSet[1] --// Position of node
		local depth : number = nodeSet[2] --// Depth of node
		visitedSet[nodePosition] = true --// Mark as visited
		traversalOrder[depth] = nodePosition --// Sets the order of the node according to the path.

		local isCurrentIterationTheDeepest = false

		if depth > furthestDepth then
			furthestDepth = depth --// Updates furthestDepth if depth is bigger than it
			longestTraversalOrder = table.clone(traversalOrder)
			isCurrentIterationTheDeepest = true
			lastNodeSeesNeighbor = false
		end

		if #traversalOrder == maxNodeChain then
			lastNodeSeesNeighbor = nil
			break
		end --// Breaks loop if the desired amount of nodes is reached

		local POVAngle : Angle? =
			--// pathfindingFOVHalfed >= 180 means that it can see 360 degrees (full circle), making POVAngle checking a bloat
			pathfindingFOVHalfed < 180 and depth > startDepth and GetAngle(traversalOrder[depth - 1], nodePosition) or nil

		local validNeighborPositions : {{any}} = {} --// Will save the next stack candidates

		for neighborNodePosition, angle in nodes[nodePosition] do --// Iterates all neighbors

			--// Doesn't skip the iteration if there's either no POVAngle or the POVAngle is in range
			if POVAngle and not IsInFOV(POVAngle, angle, pathfindingFOVHalfed) then continue end

			if isCurrentIterationTheDeepest and POVAngle then
				lastNodeSeesNeighbor = true
			end

			if visitedSet[neighborNodePosition] then continue end

			table.insert(validNeighborPositions, {neighborNodePosition, depth + 1} :: {any})
		end

		for i = #validNeighborPositions, 2, -1 do --// Fisher-Yates uniform shuffle algorithm
			local j = math.random(i)
			validNeighborPositions[i], validNeighborPositions[j] = validNeighborPositions[j], validNeighborPositions[i]
		end

		table.move(validNeighborPositions, 1, #validNeighborPositions, #stack + 1, stack)

		--// If the previous lines fails adding nodes to the stack & the last node sees a neighbor in its FOV, we add the last node to the stack & reset the visitedSet log, allowing the algorithm to re-loop
		if #stack == 0 and lastNodeSeesNeighbor then
			visitedSet = {}
			traversalOrder = table.clone(longestTraversalOrder) --// Makes sure the traversalOrder aligns with the logged longest path
			table.insert(stack, {longestTraversalOrder[#longestTraversalOrder], furthestDepth} :: {any})
		end

	end

	--// Rid the 0th index as it is useless
	longestTraversalOrder[0] = nil
	return longestTraversalOrder
end

return NodeService

local D=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.BrainrotData)
local Models=require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)
local W=require(script.Parent.World)
local B=require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local E=require(script.Parent.MoneyService)
local Steal=require(script.Parent.StealService)
local C={offers={},elapsed=0,spawnCount=0}
function C.spawn(item,x)
 item.model=Models.create(item,W.root)
 local offer={item=item,x=x}
 item.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x,1.8,0))
 local prompt
 prompt=W.prompt(item.model.PrimaryPart,"Buy $"..item.price,D.cast[item.id][1],function(player)
  if offer.sold or not Steal.near(player,item.model.PrimaryPart) or Steal.carriers[player] then return end
  if not B.freeSlot(player) then C.notify(player,"Expand your base or free a stand.") return end
  if not E.spend(player,item.price) then C.notify(player,"Not enough cash.") return end
  offer.sold=true
  if Steal.carry(player,item,"purchase") then
   prompt:Destroy() Steal.attach(item) Steal.prompts(item,false)
   C.notify(player,"Bring it to your safehouse!")
  else offer.sold=false E.add(player,item.price) end
 end)
 table.insert(C.offers,offer)
end
function C.init(notify)
 C.notify=notify
 for i=1,7 do
  local starters={[5]=2,[6]=1,[7]=3}
  C.spawn(starters[i] and D.make(starters[i],false) or D.random(true),-115+i*17)
 end
end
function C.step(dt,now)
 C.elapsed+=dt
 while C.elapsed>=3.4 do
  C.elapsed-=3.4 C.spawnCount+=1
  local item=C.spawnCount%3==0 and D.make(math.random(1,3),false) or D.random(true)
  C.spawn(item,-121)
 end
 for i=#C.offers,1,-1 do
  local offer=C.offers[i]
  if offer.sold then table.remove(C.offers,i)
  else
   offer.x+=4.2*dt
   if offer.x>=121 then offer.item.model:Destroy() table.remove(C.offers,i)
   else offer.item.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(offer.x,1.8+math.abs(math.sin(now*3))*0.26,0)) end
  end
 end
end
return C

--!strict
-- Server entry point: the only Script. It starts every system in a fixed order and owns the player
-- lifecycle, so "what runs when" is answered by reading this one file.
--
-- A service is a ModuleScript in Services/ that returns a table of functions. To add a system:
-- write the module, require it here, and add its functions to the lists below.
--   INIT            build own state; must not call another service
--   START           connect remotes and loops; every service is initialised by now
--   PLAYER_ADDED    runs once the player's profile is loaded
--   PLAYER_REMOVING runs while the profile is still readable; DataService goes last

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared").Net)

-- Remotes exist before any service is required, so a service may look them up at any point.
Net.setup()

local DataService = require(script.Parent.Services.DataService)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.Services.GameService)

type Step = { name: string, fn: () -> () }
type PlayerStep = { name: string, fn: (Player) -> () }

-- Explicit lists: no folder scan and no priorities to guess, and every call is one the type checker
-- can follow. Order matters and is visible here.
local INIT: { Step } = {
	{ name = "DataService.init", fn = DataService.init },
}
local START: { Step } = {
	{ name = "DataService.start", fn = DataService.start },
	{ name = "GameService.start", fn = GameService.start },
}
local PLAYER_ADDED: { PlayerStep } = {
	{ name = "GameService.playerAdded", fn = GameService.playerAdded },
}
local PLAYER_REMOVING: { PlayerStep } = {
	{ name = "GameService.playerRemoving", fn = GameService.playerRemoving },
	{ name = "DataService.playerRemoving", fn = DataService.playerRemoving }, -- saves: always last
}

-- One failing step must not take the other systems down, and it must say so loudly.
local function run(name: string, fn: (...any) -> ...any, ...: any)
	local ok, err = xpcall(fn, debug.traceback, ...)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[Boot] {name} failed:\n{err}`)
		workspace:SetAttribute("BootError", name)
	end
end

for _, step in INIT do
	run(step.name, step.fn)
end
for _, step in START do
	run(step.name, step.fn)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- Nothing gameplay-related sees the player until their data exists.
	if not DataService.load(player) then
		return
	end
	for _, step in PLAYER_ADDED do
		run(step.name, step.fn, player)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	for _, step in PLAYER_REMOVING do
		run(step.name, step.fn, player)
	end
end)
-- Players who joined while the modules were loading: PlayerAdded already fired for them.
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Tests and tools wait for this instead of guessing with task.wait.
workspace:SetAttribute("ServerReady", true)

-- RanchClient: the player's side of Rot Ranch. Waits for the game, mounts the HUD and the RanchDex
-- over the 3D ranch, starts the soundtrack and the critters' motion, and binds the ranch keys;
-- every rule and every coin lives on the server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local scripts = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Hud = require(scripts:WaitForChild("Hud"))
local RanchAudio = require(scripts:WaitForChild("RanchAudio"))
local RanchDex = require(scripts:WaitForChild("RanchDex"))
local CritterMotion = require(scripts:WaitForChild("CritterMotion"))
local Controls = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Controls"))

local view = Hud.mountRanchHud()
RanchDex.mountRanchDex(view.area)
RanchAudio.startRanchAudio()
CritterMotion.startCritterMotion()
Controls.bindRanchKeys(view)

--!strict
--!native
--// Made by Herfdiug

--// ++ Dependencies ++
--// Services
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

--// Modules
local Jecs = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Jecs)
local World = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.World)
local EntityService = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.EntityService)
local LuauFutures = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFutures)
local LuauFuturesExtension = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFuturesExtension)

--// Types
type Entity<T> = World.Entity<T>

--// ++ Configuration ++
--// General components
local Pathfinding = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Pathfinding")
local Character = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Character") :: Entity<World.Character>
local Walkspeed = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Walkspeed") :: Entity<number>

--// Optional components (Must choose one pair)
local Following = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Following")
local Waypoints = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Waypoints") :: Entity<{Vector3}>
local CurrentWaypointIndex = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("CurrentWaypointIndex") :: Entity<number>

local Prey = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Prey") :: Entity<World.Character>

--// System only components
local FutureArrival = World:component() :: Entity<LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, boolean>>

--// ++ Main script ++

return function()
	
	--// Move to waypoint (nodes)
	for entityID,
		character : World.Character,
		walkspeed : number,
		waypoints : {Vector3},
		currentWaypointIndex : number
	in
		World:query(Character, Walkspeed, Waypoints, CurrentWaypointIndex)
			:with(Jecs.pair(Following, Waypoints))
			:without(FutureArrival, Pathfinding)
	do
		local humanoid = character.Humanoid
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkspeed
		
		local futureArrivalFunction : LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, boolean> = LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
			return humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
		end)
		
		futureArrivalFunction:poll()
		World:set(entityID, FutureArrival, futureArrivalFunction)
		
		humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[currentWaypointIndex])
	end
	
	--// Detect & Update movement (nodes)
	for entityID,
		waypoints : {Vector3},
		currentWaypointIndex : number,
		futureArrival : LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, boolean>
	in 
		World:query(Waypoints, CurrentWaypointIndex, FutureArrival)
			:with(Jecs.pair(Following, Waypoints), Character, Walkspeed)
			:without(Pathfinding)
	do
		local arrivalPoll = futureArrival:poll()
		
		--// Wait until :MoveToFinished:Wait() triggers
		if arrivalPoll:isPending() then continue end
		
		--// If reached
		if arrivalPoll:unwrap():unwrapOk() then
			
			--// Remove movement components if the character has reached the last waypoint, otherwise increase index
			if currentWaypointIndex == #waypoints then
				World:remove(entityID, Jecs.pair(Following, Waypoints))
				World:remove(entityID, Waypoints)
				World:remove(entityID, CurrentWaypointIndex)
			else
				
				table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
					World:set(entityID, CurrentWaypointIndex, currentWaypointIndex + 1)
				end))
				
			end
			
		end
		
		--// Reset Future
		World:remove(entityID, FutureArrival)
	end
	
	LuauFuturesExtension:AwaitAll()
	
	--// Constantly update the waypoint to move to (Prey)
	for entityID,
		character : World.Character,
		walkspeed : number,
		waypoints : {Vector3}
	in 
		World:query(Character, Walkspeed, Waypoints)
			:with(Jecs.pair(Following, Prey))
	do
		
		--// I couldn't care less to make a "set this only once" function so for now it'll just run every frame lol!
		task.defer(function()
			character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkspeed
		end)
		
		character.Humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[1])
	end
	
end

--!strict
-- What a saved player looks like, and how anything read from the data store becomes that shape.
-- Pure (no game, no service) so tests/ProfileSchema.spec.luau proves it without Studio.
--
-- Adding a field: add it to Profile and fresh(), read it in reconcile() with a type check.
-- Changing the meaning of a field: bump CURRENT and add a step to migrate(). Never edit an old step.

local ProfileSchema = {}

export type Profile = {
	Schema: number,
	Coins: number,
	Upgrades: { [string]: number },
}

ProfileSchema.CURRENT = 1

local MAX_COINS = 1e12
local MAX_LEVEL = 1000

function ProfileSchema.fresh(): Profile
	return { Schema = ProfileSchema.CURRENT, Coins = 0, Upgrades = {} }
end

-- A finite, whole, clamped number - or the fallback. Saved data can hold anything: an old version,
-- a hand-edited value, NaN from a bug. None of it may reach gameplay unchecked.
local function whole(value: any, low: number, high: number, fallback: number): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), low, high)
end

local function migrate(raw: { [any]: any }): { [any]: any }
	-- if raw.Schema == 1 then raw.NewField = default; raw.Schema = 2 end
	return raw
end

-- Any value in, a valid Profile out. Unknown fields are dropped; missing ones take the default.
function ProfileSchema.reconcile(raw: any): Profile
	local profile = ProfileSchema.fresh()
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then
		return profile
	end
	local data = migrate(raw)
	profile.Coins = whole(data.Coins, 0, MAX_COINS, 0)
	if type(data.Upgrades) == "table" then
		for id, level in data.Upgrades do
			if type(id) == "string" and #id <= 40 then
				profile.Upgrades[id] = whole(level, 0, MAX_LEVEL, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	return profile
end

return ProfileSchema

-- RanchDex: the rancher's field book of every critter in the cast. A grid of cards, one per critter,
-- each with a slowly turning 3D portrait (a black ??? silhouette until you have caught one), its
-- rarity, its $/s and five mutation pips that light up as you find Moldy, Golden, Spicy, Crystal and
-- Ghost ones. Opens with B or the HUD button; reads the "Dex" attribute the server keeps.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Critters = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Critters"))

local RanchDex = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local CREAM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 225)
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 8)

type Card = {
	critter: Cast.Critter, frame: Frame, viewport: ViewportFrame, camera: Camera, name: TextLabel,
	rate: TextLabel, pips: { Frame }, model: Model?, shownAs: string, center: Vector3, radius: number,
}

local cards: { Card } = {}
local panel: Frame? = nil
local counter: TextLabel? = nil
local lastDex = ""
local open = false
local spin = 0

local function label(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	l.TextColor3 = CREAM
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	l.TextStrokeColor3 = INK
	for k, v in props do
		(l :: any)[k] = v
	end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function corner(inst: GuiObject, radius: number, stroke: Color3?, thickness: number?)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = inst
	if stroke then
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Color = stroke
		s.Thickness = thickness or 2
		s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		s.Parent = inst
	end
end

-- The rarest mutation found of a critter (the portrait wears it), or "Normal", or "" if unseen.
local function bestFound(found: { string }?): string
	if not found or #found == 0 then
		return ""
	end
	local best, bestMult = "Normal", 1
	for _, key in found do
		local mult = Cast.mutationMult(key)
		if mult > bestMult then
			best, bestMult = key, mult
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Swaps a card's portrait: the critter in its best-found finish, or a silhouette.
local function paintPortrait(card: Card, shownAs: string)
	if card.shownAs == shownAs and card.model then
		return
	end
	card.shownAs = shownAs
	if card.model then
		card.model:Destroy()
	end
	local mutation = if shownAs ~= "" and shownAs ~= "Normal" then shownAs else nil
	local model = Critters.buildPortrait(card.critter.id, mutation, shownAs == "")
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	card.center = cf.Position
	card.radius = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	model.Parent = card.viewport
	card.model = model
end

local function buildCard(grid: Instance, critter: Cast.Critter, order: number): Card
	local rarity = Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity]
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.LayoutOrder = order
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 44, 26)
	frame.Parent = grid
	corner(frame, 10, rarity.color, 3)
	local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	viewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	viewport.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 92)
	viewport.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 226, 180)
	viewport.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 150, 130)
	viewport.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 210)
	viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.5, -1)
	viewport.Parent = frame
	corner(viewport, 8)
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 34
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
	local name = label(frame, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 100), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22), Text = "???" })
	label(frame, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 122), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16), Text = string.upper(rarity.id),
		TextColor3 = rarity.color, Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
	})
	local rate = label(frame, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 139), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16), Text = "",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 255, 120), Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
	})
	local pips = {}
	for i, m in Cast.MUTATIONS do
		local pip = Instance.new("Frame")
		pip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		pip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (i - 3) * 20, 0, 158)
		pip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
		pip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 34, 22)
		pip.Parent = frame
		corner(pip, 7, m.tint, 2)
		table.insert(pips, pip)
	end
	return {
		critter = critter, frame = frame, viewport = viewport, camera = camera, name = name, rate = rate,
		pips = pips, model = nil, shownAs = "?", center = Vector3.zero, radius = 8,
	}
end

-- Builds the book once: a wooden panel, a header with the count, the grid, and the mutation legend.
function RanchDex.mountRanchDex(gui: Instance)
	local book = Instance.new("Frame")
	book.Name = "RanchDex"
	book.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	book.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.53)
	book.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1010, 640)
	book.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 76, 42)
	book.Visible = false
	book.ZIndex = 5
	book.Parent = gui
	corner(book, 18, Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 90), 5)
	label(book, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 52), Text = "RANCHDEX",
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 70),
	})
	counter = label(book, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 38),
		Text = "0 / " .. #Cast.CRITTERS .. " FOUND", Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
	})
	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 12)
	close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 44)
	close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 40)
	close.Text = "CLOSE [B]"
	close.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	close.TextScaled = true
	close.TextColor3 = CREAM
	close.Parent = book
	corner(close, 10)
	close.Activated:Connect(function()
		RanchDex.setOpen(false)
	end)

	local scroller = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroller.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 66)
	scroller.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -126)
	scroller.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroller.ScrollBarThickness = 8
	scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	scroller.Parent = book
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(132, 176)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	grid.Parent = scroller
	for i, critter in Cast.CRITTERS do
		table.insert(cards, buildCard(scroller, critter, i))
	end

	-- The mutation legend along the bottom.
	local legend = Instance.new("Frame")
	legend.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	legend.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -10)
	legend.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 44)
	legend.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 44, 26)
	legend.Parent = book
	corner(legend, 10)
	local row = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	row.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	row.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	row.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	row.Padding = UDim.new(0, 14)
	row.Parent = legend
	label(legend, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 30), Text = "MUTATIONS", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 70) })
	for _, m in Cast.MUTATIONS do
		label(legend, {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 30), Text = string.upper(m.id) .. " x" .. m.mult,
			TextColor3 = m.tint, Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy,
		})
	end
	panel = book

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not open then
			return
		end
		spin += dt * 0.6
		for i, card in cards do
			local angle = spin + i * 0.4
			local dist = card.radius * 1.75
			local eye = card.center + Vector3.new(math.sin(angle) * dist, card.radius * 0.45, -math.cos(angle) * dist)
			card.camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, card.center)
		end
	end)
end

-- Repaints every card from the server's Dex attribute (only when it changed).
function RanchDex.refresh()
	local raw = player:GetAttribute("Dex") or "{}"
	if raw == lastDex and #cards > 0 and cards[1].model then
		return
	end
	lastDex = raw
	local ok, dex = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
	if not ok or type(dex) ~= "table" then
		dex = {}
	end
	local count = 0
	local rebirths = player:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0
	for _, card in cards do
		local found = dex[card.critter.id]
		local best = bestFound(found)
		paintPortrait(card, best)
		if best ~= "" then
			count += 1
			card.name.Text = card.critter.name
			card.rate.Text = Cast.formatCash(Cast.incomeOf(card.critter.id, nil, rebirths)) .. "/s"
			card.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 60, 32)
		else
			card.name.Text = "???"
			card.rate.Text = "lasso one to find out"
			card.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 36, 22)
		end
		for i, m in Cast.MUTATIONS do
			local has = found ~= nil and table.find(found, m.id) ~= nil
			card.pips[i].BackgroundColor3 = if has then m.tint else Color3.fromRGB(50, 34, 22)
		end
	end
	if counter then
		counter.Text = count .. " / " .. #Cast.CRITTERS .. " FOUND"
	end
end

function RanchDex.setOpen(want: boolean)
	local book = panel
	if not book then
		return
	end
	open = want
	if want then
		RanchDex.refresh()
		book.Visible = true
		local pop = book:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
		pop.Scale = 0.85
		pop.Parent = book
		TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	else
		book.Visible = false
	end
end

function RanchDex.toggle()
	RanchDex.setOpen(not open)
end

function RanchDex.isOpen(): boolean
	return open
end

return RanchDex

local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("BlitzRebirthsV1")
local B=require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local E={}
function E.sync(player)
 local level=player:GetAttribute("Level") or 1
 local rebirths=player:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0
 player:SetAttribute("Capacity",4+(level-1)*2)
 player:SetAttribute("UpgradePrice",550*level*level)
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthPrice",12000*(rebirths+1))
 B.refresh(player)
end
function E.join(player)
 player:SetAttribute("Cash",150) player:SetAttribute("Level",1) player:SetAttribute("Rebirths",0)
 E.sync(player)
 if not Run:IsStudio() then
  local ok,value=pcall(function() return Store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
  if ok and type(value)=="number" and value>=0 then player:SetAttribute("Rebirths",math.floor(value)) E.sync(player) end
 end
end
function E.save(player)
 if Run:IsStudio() then return end
 local count=player:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0
 local ok,err=pcall(function() Store:UpdateAsync(tostring(player.UserId),function(previous) return math.max(tonumber(previous) or 0,count) end) end)
 if not ok then warn("Rebirth save failed: ",err) end
end
function E.spend(player,cost)
 local cash=player:GetAttribute("Cash") or 0
 if cash<cost then return false end
 player:SetAttribute("Cash",cash-cost) return true
end
function E.add(player,amount)
 player:SetAttribute("Cash",(player:GetAttribute("Cash") or 0)+amount)
end
function E.upgrade(player)
 local level=player:GetAttribute("Level") or 1
 if level>=3 then return "All eight stands unlocked." end
 if not E.spend(player,550*level*level) then return "Not enough cash." end
 player:SetAttribute("Level",level+1) E.sync(player)
 return "Base expanded!"
end
function E.income()
 for _,plot in ipairs(B.plots) do if plot.owner then
  local rate=0
  for _,slot in ipairs(plot.slots) do if slot.item and not slot.inTransit then rate+=slot.item.rate end end
  local income=math.floor(rate*(1+0.5*(plot.owner:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0)))
  E.add(plot.owner,income) plot.owner:SetAttribute("Income",income)
 end end
end
function E.rebirth(player)
 if player:GetAttribute("Carrying") then return "Put down your brainrot first." end
 local plot=B.get(player) if not plot then return "No safehouse available." end

--!strict
--!native
--// Made by Herfdiug

--// ++ Dependencies ++
--// Services
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

--// Modules
local Jecs = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Jecs)
local World = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.World)
local EntityService = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.EntityService)
local NodeService = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.NodeService)
local LuauFutures = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFutures)
local LuauFuturesExtension = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFuturesExtension)

--// Types
type Entity<T> = World.Entity<T>

--// Initialization
NodeService:Initialize("TestMap", workspace.Map.Waypoints)

--// ++ Configuration ++
local agentParameters = {
	AgentRadius = 2,
	AgentHeight	= 5,
	AgentCanJump = false,
	AgentCanClimb = false,
	WaypointSpacing = 4
}

--// General components
local Pathfinding = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Pathfinding")
local Character = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Character") :: Entity<World.Character>
local MaxNodeChain = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("MaxNodeChain") :: Entity<number>
local PathfindAngle = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("PathfindAngle") :: Entity<number>

--// Components to be added (Must choose one pair)
local Following = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Following")
local Waypoints = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Waypoints") :: Entity<{Vector3}>
local CurrentWaypointIndex = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("CurrentWaypointIndex") :: Entity<number>

local Prey = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Prey") :: Entity<World.Character>

--// System only component
local FuturePath = World:component() :: Entity<LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, {PathWaypoint}>>

--// ++ Main script ++

return function()
	
	--// Node pathfind
	for entityID, character : World.Character, maxNodeChain : number, pathfindAngle : number in 
		World:query(Character, MaxNodeChain, PathfindAngle):with(Pathfinding):without(Jecs.pair(Following, Jecs.Wildcard))
	do
		--// Generate nodes
		World:set(entityID,
			Waypoints,
			NodeService:Generate("TestMap", character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, maxNodeChain, pathfindAngle))
		
		World:add(entityID, Jecs.pair(Following, Waypoints))
		World:remove(entityID, Pathfinding)
		
		table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
			World:set(entityID, CurrentWaypointIndex, 1)
		end))
		
	end
	
	LuauFuturesExtension:AwaitAll()
	
	--// Prey pathfind
	for entityID, character : World.Character, prey : World.Character in
		World:query(Character, Prey):with(Jecs.pair(Pathfinding, Prey)):without(FuturePath)
	do
		
		local futurePath : LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, {PathWaypoint}> = LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
			local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath(agentParameters)
			path:ComputeAsync(character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, prey.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
			return path:GetWaypoints()
		end)
		
		futurePath:poll()
		World:set(entityID, FuturePath, futurePath)
	end
	
	for entityID, character : World.Character, prey : World.Character, futurePath : LuauFutures.FutureLike<any, {PathWaypoint}> in
		World:query(Character, Prey, FuturePath):with(Jecs.pair(Pathfinding, Prey))
	do
		local pathPoll = futurePath:poll()
		
		--// Wait until :ComputeAsync() finishes
		if pathPoll:isPending() then continue end

		--// After computation
		local waypoints = pathPoll:unwrap():unwrapOk()

		if #waypoints > 0 then
			
			table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
				World:add(entityID, Jecs.pair(Following, Prey))
				--// Following the first waypoint results in "stuttery" movement, only opted if there is no other waypoints
				World:set(entityID, Waypoints, {((waypoints[2] or waypoints[1]) :: PathWaypoint).Position})
			end))
			
		else
			
			table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
				World:remove(entityID, Jecs.pair(Following, Prey))
				World:remove(entityID, Waypoints)
			end))
			
		end
	
		--// Reset Future
		World:remove(entityID, FuturePath)
	end
	
	LuauFuturesExtension:PollAll()
end

--!strict
-- Player data: load on join, save on leave, on a timer and on shutdown.
--
-- The rule this file exists to keep: A FAILED READ IS NOT A NEW PLAYER. If the data store is down
-- and the game hands out a default profile, that default is saved over the real one when the player
-- leaves. So a profile exists only after a read succeeded, and nothing is ever written for a player
-- whose read failed - they are asked to rejoin instead.
--
-- Scope: correct for one server holding a player at a time. It has no cross-server session lock, so
-- before the game has trading, server hopping with valuable items or several places, move to
-- ProfileStore (see the roblox-data-stores skill). The API below is small on purpose so that swap
-- stays inside this file.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ProfileSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.ProfileSchema)

type Profile = ProfileSchema.Profile
type Entry = { profile: Profile, dirty: boolean, saving: boolean }

-- Studio and the live game never share a store: a play test must not be able to touch real saves.
local STORE_NAME = if RunService:IsStudio() then "PlayerData_Studio_v1" else "PlayerData_v1"
local LOAD_ATTEMPTS = 4
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 120
local SHUTDOWN_BUDGET = 25 -- BindToClose gives 30 s in total

local DataService = {}

local entries: { [Player]: Entry } = {}
local store: DataStore? = nil
-- False only in Studio without API access (an unpublished place, or the setting off): the session
-- then runs in memory and writes nothing. In a live server a broken store never falls back to this.
local persistent = false

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "Player_" .. player.UserId -- UserId, never Name: names change
end

local function readWithRetry(player: Player): (boolean, any)
	local dataStore = store :: DataStore
	for attempt = 1, LOAD_ATTEMPTS do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return dataStore:GetAsync(keyFor(player))
		end)
		if ok then
			return true, result -- nil here means a genuinely new player
		end
		warn(`[Data] read failed for {player.UserId} (attempt {attempt}/{LOAD_ATTEMPTS}): {result}`)
		if attempt < LOAD_ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(2 ^ attempt)
		end
		if player.Parent ~= Players then
			return false, nil
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

-- Yields. True when the player now has a profile; false when they were kicked or left.
function DataService.load(player: Player): boolean
	if entries[player] then
		return true
	end
	if not persistent then
		entries[player] = { profile = ProfileSchema.fresh(), dirty = false, saving = false }
		return true
	end
	local ok, raw = readWithRetry(player)
	if not ok then
		if player.Parent == Players then
			player:Kick("Your data could not be loaded. Nothing was lost - please rejoin.")
		end
		return false
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return false
	end
	entries[player] = { profile = ProfileSchema.reconcile(raw), dirty = false, saving = false }
	return true
end

-- The live profile, or nil while it is loading. Every caller must handle nil.
function DataService.get(player: Player): Profile?
	local entry = entries[player]
	return if entry then entry.profile else nil
end

-- Call after changing a profile. Saving is batched; this never yields.
function DataService.markDirty(player: Player)
	local entry = entries[player]
	if entry then
		entry.dirty = true
	end
end

local function save(player: Player): boolean
	local entry = entries[player]
	if not entry or not persistent then
		return false
	end
	if not entry.dirty or entry.saving then
		return true
	end
	entry.saving = true
	entry.dirty = false
	local snapshot = ProfileSchema.reconcile(entry.profile) -- a sanitized copy, not the live table
	local dataStore = store :: DataStore
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		dataStore:UpdateAsync(keyFor(player), function()
			return snapshot, { player.UserId }
		end)
	end)
	entry.saving = false
	if not ok then
		entry.dirty = true -- try again on the next pass; never report a save that did not happen
		warn(`[Data] save failed for {player.UserId}: {err}`)
	end
	return ok
end

-- Main calls this last in PLAYER_REMOVING, after every other service has seen the player leave, so
-- they can still read the profile and their last changes are in the final save.
function DataService.playerRemoving(player: Player)
	save(player)
	entries[player] = nil
end

function DataService.init()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
		dataStore:GetAsync("__probe") -- throws when the place has no data store access
		return dataStore
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
		persistent = true
	elseif RunService:IsStudio() then
		warn("[Data] no data store access in this Studio session: progress is kept in memory only.")
	else
		-- Live server: keep the store and let each load retry and kick. Never play on defaults.
		store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
		persistent = true
		warn(`[Data] data store probe failed: {result}`)
	end
end

function DataService.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for player in entries do
				task.spawn(save, player)
				task.wait(0.2) -- spread the writes instead of bursting the request budget
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Shutdown kicks everyone and exits; without this the last PlayerRemoving saves are cut off.
	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player in entries do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				save(player)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + SHUTDOWN_BUDGET
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

-- CattleDrive: the conveyor of the ranch. Critters trot out of the Rot Corral in two lanes, down the
-- dirt drive past every ranch gate, and into Dust Canyon. Each wears its price; hold E to lasso it:
-- a rope flies from your hand to a loop round its middle and it sails over the fence into a free
-- stall of yours. Luck (rebirths, horseshoes) and Golden Hour tilt what trots out; a stampede
-- tramples whatever is still on the drive.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Critters = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Critters"))
local Events = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Events"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local Pens = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Pens"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("World"))

local CattleDrive = {}

CattleDrive.SPAWN_EVERY = 2.2
CattleDrive.TROT_SPEED = 6.5
CattleDrive.LANES = { -3.6, 3.6 }
CattleDrive.paused = false
CattleDrive.lassoFlight = 1 -- seconds the lassoed critter spends in the air (the Showcase slows it)

type DriveEntry = { record: Ledger.CritterRecord, price: number, tween: Tween?, sold: boolean }

local onDrive: { DriveEntry } = {}
local rng = Random.new()
local folder: Folder
local laneTurn = 0
local luckOfRanchers: () -> number
local leaveDrive: (DriveEntry) -> ()
local handOf: (Player) -> BasePart?

-- Lasso: pay the price, the rope flies, and the critter sails to your first free stall. A critter
-- someone else already roped, a full pen or a thin wallet stops the throw before any cash moves.
function CattleDrive.lassoCritter(player: Player, entry: DriveEntry)
	local account = Ledger.accountOf(player)
	if entry.sold or not account or not account.plot then
		return
	end
	local critter = Cast.critterById(entry.record.id)
	local stall = Pens.freeStallOf(account)
	if not stall then
		Ledger.toast(account, "Your pens are full! Rebirth (R) for more stalls.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80))
		Ledger.cue(account, "deny")
		return
	end
	if not Ledger.spendCash(account, entry.price) then
		Ledger.toast(account, "You need " .. Cast.formatCash(entry.price) .. " to lasso the " .. critter.name .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 100))
		Ledger.cue(account, "deny")
		return
	end
	entry.sold = true
	leaveDrive(entry)
	if entry.tween then
		entry.tween:Cancel()
	end
	local prompt = entry.record.model:FindFirstChild("LassoPrompt", true)
	if prompt then
		prompt:Destroy()
	end
	local record = entry.record
	local rate = Cast.formatCash(Cast.incomeOf(record.id, record.mutation, account.rebirths))
	local firstFind = Ledger.discover(account, record.id, record.mutation)
	local mutationText = if record.mutation then string.upper(record.mutation) .. " " else ""
	Ledger.toast(account, "YEEHAW! Lassoed " .. mutationText .. critter.name .. "  +" .. rate .. "/s", Cast.mutationTint(record.mutation) or Cast.rarityColor(critter.rarity))
	if firstFind then
		Ledger.toast(account, "NEW in your RanchDex: " .. mutationText .. critter.name .. "! (B)", Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 150))
	end
	Ledger.cue(account, "lasso", { rank = Cast.rankOf(record.id), mutation = record.mutation, fresh = firstFind })
	if Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity].rank >= 5 or (record.mutation and Cast.mutationMult(record.mutation) >= 6) then
		Ledger.toastAll(account.name .. " lassoed a " .. string.upper(mutationText .. Cast.rarityLabel(critter.rarity)) .. " " .. critter.name .. "!", Cast.rarityColor(critter.rarity))
	end
	Ledger.syncBoard(account)
	Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "lasso", id = record.id, mutation = record.mutation, amount = entry.price })
	if firstFind then
		Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "discover", id = record.id, mutation = record.mutation })
	end

	-- The rope runs from the rancher's hand to the loop and stays up for the whole flight.
	local hand = handOf(player)
	local cleanup = if hand then Critters.throwLasso(hand, record.model) else nil
	record.model:SetAttribute("Gait", "fly")
	if record.mutation then
		Critters.sparkle((record.model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Cast.mutationTint(record.mutation) :: Color3, 40)
	end
	Pens.placeCritterInPen(account, record, stall, true, CattleDrive.lassoFlight)
	if cleanup then
		cleanup()
	end
	Ledger.cue(account, "land", Cast.rankOf(record.id))
end

function handOf(player: Player): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	return (character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) :: BasePart?
end

-- The luckiest rancher on the server sets the drive's luck: rebirths plus any horseshoe charm.
function luckOfRanchers(): number
	local best = 0
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		best = math.max(best, Ledger.luckOf(account))
	end
	return best
end

function leaveDrive(entry: DriveEntry)
	local i = table.find(onDrive, entry)
	if i then
		table.remove(onDrive, i)
	end
end

-- Sends one rolled critter trotting down the drive with its price tag and Lasso prompt.
function CattleDrive.spawnDriveCritter(forceId: string?, forceMutation: string?): DriveEntry
	local critter, mutation = Cast.rollDriveCritter(rng, luckOfRanchers(), Events.goldenBoost)
	if forceId then
		critter, mutation = Cast.critterById(forceId), forceMutation
	end
	laneTurn += 1
	local z = CattleDrive.LANES[laneTurn % #CattleDrive.LANES + 1]
	local start = Vector3.new(World.DRIVE_START_X, 0.45, z)
	local finish = Vector3.new(World.DRIVE_END_X, 0.45, z)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(start, finish)
	local model = Critters.buildCritter(critter.id, mutation, facing)
	local price = Cast.priceOf(critter.id, mutation)
	Critters.labelCritter(model, critter.id, mutation, 0, price)
	local record: Ledger.CritterRecord = { id = critter.id, mutation = mutation, model = model, owner = nil, stall = nil, carrier = nil }
	local entry: DriveEntry = { record = record, price = price, tween = nil, sold = false }

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "LassoPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Lasso " .. Cast.formatCash(price)
	prompt.ObjectText = (if mutation then mutation .. " " else "") .. critter.name .. " (" .. Cast.rarityLabel(critter.rarity) .. ")"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 13
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt.Parent = (model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart):FindFirstChild("PromptPoint")
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		CattleDrive.lassoCritter(player, entry)
	end)

	model.Parent = folder
	Critters.poof(start + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 90), 14)
	if mutation or Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity].rank >= 5 then
		Ledger.cueAll("rareOnDrive", { rank = Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity].rank, mutation = mutation })
	end
	local trot = TweenService:Create(model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart, TweenInfo.new((finish - start).Magnitude / CattleDrive.TROT_SPEED, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(finish, finish + (finish - start).Unit),
	})
	entry.tween = trot
	trot.Completed:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not entry.sold then
			leaveDrive(entry)
			Critters.poof(finish + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 100), 12)
			model:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	trot:Play()
	table.insert(onDrive, entry)
	return entry
end

-- Jumps a critter `fraction` of the way down the drive (0 = corral, 1 = canyon) and lets it trot on
-- from there; used to fill the drive when the server starts.
function CattleDrive.fastForward(entry: DriveEntry, fraction: number)
	if not entry.tween then
		return
	end
	local root = entry.record.model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	entry.tween:Cancel()
	local z = root.Position.Z
	local start = Vector3.new(World.DRIVE_START_X + (World.DRIVE_END_X - World.DRIVE_START_X) * fraction, 0.45, z)
	local finish = Vector3.new(World.DRIVE_END_X, 0.45, z)
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(start, finish)
	local trot = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new((finish - start).Magnitude / CattleDrive.TROT_SPEED, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(finish, finish + Vector3.xAxis),
	})
	entry.tween = trot
	trot.Completed:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not entry.sold then
			leaveDrive(entry)
			entry.record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	trot:Play()
end

-- The critter on the drive nearest a point (the Showcase lassoes it for the camera).
function CattleDrive.nearestOnDrive(position: Vector3): DriveEntry?
	local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
	for _, entry in onDrive do
		local root = entry.record.model.PrimaryPart
		if root and not entry.sold then
			local d = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if d < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = entry, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The stampede flattens every unsold critter between two x positions on the drive.
function CattleDrive.trampleDriveCritters(fromX: number, toX: number): number
	local count = 0
	for i = #onDrive, 1, -1 do
		local entry = onDrive[i]
		local root = entry.record.model.PrimaryPart
		if root and root.Position.X >= fromX and root.Position.X <= toX then
			entry.sold = true
			if entry.tween then
				entry.tween:Cancel()
			end
			table.remove(onDrive, i)
			Critters.poof(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(170, 130, 90), 18)
			entry.record.model:Destroy()
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

function CattleDrive.startCattleDrive()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CattleDrive"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	-- Fill the drive so the first player sees a full line, then keep it coming.
	local warm = 20
	for i = 1, warm do
		local entry = CattleDrive.spawnDriveCritter()
		CattleDrive.fastForward(entry, (warm - i) / warm * 0.95)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(CattleDrive.SPAWN_EVERY)
			if not CattleDrive.paused then
				CattleDrive.spawnDriveCritter()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CattleDrive

   p.CollisionGroup="Barrier"..plot.index p.CanCollide=false p.Transparency=1
   table.insert(plot.barriers,{part=p,barrier=barrier})
  end
  for _,z in ipairs({-20,20}) do

   for z=-18,18,2 do add("Laser beam",Vector3.new(0.26,9.2,0.26),CFrame.new(x,5,z),false) end
  end
 end
end
function S.character(player,character)
 local plot=B.get(player)
 local group=plot and "Owner"..plot.index or "Default"
 local function set(instance) if instance:IsA("BasePart") then instance.CollisionGroup=group end end
 for _,v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do set(v) end
 character.DescendantAdded:Connect(set)
end
function S.activate(player)
 local plot=B.get(player) if not plot then return "No safehouse available." end
 local activation=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if activation<plot.cooldownUntil then return "Shield is recharging." end
 plot.activeUntil=activation+26
 plot.cooldownUntil=activation+26+48
 player:SetAttribute("ShieldUntil",plot.activeUntil) player:SetAttribute("CooldownUntil",plot.cooldownUntil)
 S.step(activation)
 return "Shield online for 26 seconds!"
end

-- Contracts: the ranch's job board. Every rancher holds three short contracts at a time ("Pen a
-- GOLDEN critter", "Tag a rustler", "Survive 2 events", "Rebirth once"...). Deeds from the rest of
-- the ranch fill them in; a finished one pays cash or a Lucky Horseshoe (extra drive luck for two
-- minutes) with a jingle, and a fresh contract is posted in its place.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))

local Contracts = {}

Contracts.BOARD_SIZE = 3
Contracts.HORSESHOE_SECONDS = 120

type Job = {
	id: string,
	weight: number,
	reward: "cash" | "luck",
	goal: (Ledger.Account) -> number,
	text: (number) -> string,
	counts: (Ledger.Deed, Ledger.Account) -> number,
	pay: ((Ledger.Account) -> number)?,
}

local function rankOf(deed: Ledger.Deed): number
	return if deed.id then Cast.rankOf(deed.id) else 0
end

local function caught(deed: Ledger.Deed): boolean
	return deed.kind == "lasso" or deed.kind == "rustle"
end

-- Pays in proportion to how the ranch is doing, never less than a floor.
local function scaledPay(floor: number, seconds: number): (Ledger.Account) -> number
	return function(account)
		return math.max(floor, math.floor(Ledger.incomeOf(account) * seconds))
	end
end

local JOBS: { Job } = {
	{ id = "lasso", weight = 3, reward = "cash",
		goal = function(a) return if Ledger.herdSize(a) < 3 then 3 else 5 end,
		text = function(n) return "Lasso " .. n .. " critters" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "lasso" then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(120, 25) },
	{ id = "rare", weight = 2, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Pen a RARE or better" end,
		counts = function(d) return if caught(d) and rankOf(d) >= 3 then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(400, 40) },
	{ id = "epic", weight = 1, reward = "luck",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Pen an EPIC or better" end,
		counts = function(d) return if caught(d) and rankOf(d) >= 4 then 1 else 0 end },
	{ id = "mutant", weight = 2, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Pen a MUTATED critter" end,
		counts = function(d) return if caught(d) and d.mutation then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(300, 45) },
	{ id = "golden", weight = 1.5, reward = "luck",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Pen a GOLDEN critter" end,
		counts = function(d) return if caught(d) and d.mutation == "Golden" then 1 else 0 end },
	{ id = "tag", weight = 1.5, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Tag a rustler" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "tag" then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(500, 60) },
	{ id = "rustle", weight = 1.5, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Rustle a critter home" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "rustle" then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(350, 40) },
	{ id = "lock", weight = 1.5, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 2 end,
		text = function(n) return if n == 1 then "Lock your gate" else "Lock your gate " .. n .. " times" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "lock" then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(150, 20) },
	{ id = "survive", weight = 2, reward = "luck",
		goal = function() return 2 end,
		text = function(n) return "Survive " .. n .. " ranch events" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "survive" then 1 else 0 end },
	{ id = "coin", weight = 1, reward = "cash",
		goal = function() return 4 end,
		text = function(n) return "Grab " .. n .. " Dust Devil coins" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "coin" then 1 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(300, 30) },
	{ id = "earn", weight = 2, reward = "cash",
		goal = function(a) return math.max(500, math.floor(Ledger.incomeOf(a) * 90 / 100) * 100) end,
		text = function(n) return "Earn " .. Cast.formatCash(n) .. " from your pens" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "earn" then d.amount or 0 else 0 end,
		pay = scaledPay(200, 30) },
	{ id = "dex", weight = 2, reward = "luck",
		goal = function() return 3 end,
		text = function(n) return "Find " .. n .. " new RanchDex entries" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "discover" then 1 else 0 end },
	{ id = "rebirth", weight = 0.8, reward = "luck",
		goal = function() return 1 end,
		text = function() return "Rebirth once" end,
		counts = function(d) return if d.kind == "rebirth" then 1 else 0 end },
}

local jobById: { [string]: Job } = {}
for _, job in JOBS do
	jobById[job.id] = job
end
local rng = Random.new()
local lastEarnSync: { [Ledger.Account]: number } = {}

local function rewardText(job: Job, account: Ledger.Account): (string, number)
	if job.reward == "luck" then
		return "Lucky Horseshoe", 0
	end
	local cash = (job.pay :: (Ledger.Account) -> number)(account)
	return Cast.formatCash(cash), cash
end

-- Posts a new contract the board does not already hold (rebirth only once a rebirth is in sight).
function Contracts.postContract(account: Ledger.Account): Ledger.Contract
	local held: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, c in account.contracts do
		held[c.kind] = true
	end
	local total = 0
	local open = {}
	for _, job in JOBS do
		local fits = not held[job.id] and (job.id ~= "rebirth" or account.cash >= Cast.rebirthCost(account.rebirths) * 0.25)
		if fits then
			table.insert(open, job)
			total += job.weight
		end
	end
	local pick = rng:NextNumber() * total
	local chosen = open[1]
	for _, job in open do
		pick -= job.weight
		if pick <= 0 then
			chosen = job
			break
		end
	end
	local goal = chosen.goal(account)
	local reward, cash = rewardText(chosen, account)
	local contract: Ledger.Contract = { kind = chosen.id, text = chosen.text(goal), goal = goal, progress = 0, reward = reward, cash = cash }
	table.insert(account.contracts, contract)
	return contract
end

-- Fills a new rancher's board: the first one always starts with the easiest jobs.
function Contracts.dealBoard(account: Ledger.Account)
	account.contracts = {}
	local lasso = jobById.lasso
	table.insert(account.contracts, { kind = "lasso", text = lasso.text(3), goal = 3, progress = 0, reward = Cast.formatCash(150), cash = 150 })
	local lock = jobById.lock
	table.insert(account.contracts, { kind = "lock", text = lock.text(1), goal = 1, progress = 0, reward = Cast.formatCash(100), cash = 100 })
	Contracts.postContract(account)
	Ledger.syncBoard(account)
end

local function payContract(account: Ledger.Account, contract: Ledger.Contract)
	if contract.cash > 0 then
		Ledger.addCash(account, contract.cash)
	else
		local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		account.luckUntil = math.max(now, account.luckUntil) + Contracts.HORSESHOE_SECONDS
	end
	Ledger.cue(account, "contract", contract.reward)
	Ledger.toast(account, "CONTRACT DONE: " .. contract.text .. "  >  " .. contract.reward .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90))
	if contract.cash == 0 then
		Ledger.toast(account, "Lucky Horseshoe! Rarer critters on the drive for 2 minutes.", Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 140))
	end
end

-- A deed moves every contract it counts for; finished ones pay and are replaced a moment later.
function Contracts.recordDeed(account: Ledger.Account, deed: Ledger.Deed)
	local changed = false
	for _, contract in account.contracts do
		local job = jobById[contract.kind]
		if job and contract.progress < contract.goal then
			local n = job.counts(deed, account)
			if n > 0 then
				contract.progress = math.min(contract.goal, contract.progress + n)
				changed = true
				if contract.progress >= contract.goal then
					payContract(account, contract)
					task.delay(3, function()
						local i = table.find(account.contracts, contract)
						if i then
							table.remove(account.contracts, i)
							Contracts.postContract(account)
							Ledger.syncBoard(account)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- "earn" ticks every second: re-send the board for it at most every 2 seconds.
	if changed then
		local now = os.clock()
		if deed.kind ~= "earn" or now - (lastEarnSync[account] or 0) >= 2 then
			lastEarnSync[account] = now
			Ledger.syncBoard(account)
		end
	end
end

function Contracts.forget(account: Ledger.Account)
	lastEarnSync[account] = nil
end

function Contracts.startContractBoard()
	Ledger.onDeed(Contracts.recordDeed)
end

return Contracts

local LuauFutures = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFutures)

local Player = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Player") :: Entity<Player>
local Character = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Character") :: Entity<World.Character>
local Heart = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Heart") :: Entity<World.Heart>

--// ++ Main script ++

local function OnDeath(playerID : Entity<number>, character : Model)
	task.wait(3)
	
	World:remove(playerID, Character)
	World:remove(playerID, Heart)
	
	character:Destroy()
end

--// Initialize players
local function OnPlayerAdded(player : Player)
	local playerID = World:entity()
	World:set(playerID, Player, player)
	World:set(playerID, Heart, {current = 3, max = 3})
	
	--// Initializes character
	local character = workspace.Camera.ToonGurt:Clone()
	
	World:set(playerID, Character, character)
	
	character.Name = player.Name
	character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)) --// Adjust spawn position
	player.Character = character
	character.Parent = workspace.AlivePlayers
	
	character.Humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		OnDeath(playerID, character)
	end)
	
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerAdded)

--// Race condition prevention
local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()

for _, player in World:query(Player) do
	table.remove(allPlayers, table.find(allPlayers, player))
end

for _, player in allPlayers do
	OnPlayerAdded(player)
end

--!strict
--!native
--// Made by Herfdiug

--// ++ Dependencies ++
--// Services
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Jecs = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Jecs)
local World = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.World)
local EntityService = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.EntityService)
local LuauFutures = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFutures)
local LuauFuturesExtension = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LuauFuturesExtension)

--// Types
type Entity<T> = World.Entity<T>

--// ++ Configuration ++
--// General components
local Name = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Name") :: Entity<string>
local Scanning = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Scanning")
local Character = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Character") :: Entity<World.Character>
local VisionInfo = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("VisionInfo") :: Entity<World.VisionInfo>
local InstantChaseRadius = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("InstantChaseRadius") :: Entity<number>

--// Components to be added
local Pathfinding = EntityService:GetOrAddTag("Pathfinding")
local Prey = EntityService:GetOrAddComponent("Prey") :: Entity<World.Character>

--// System only components
local CharacterDistances = World:component() :: Entity<{[World.Character] : number}>

--// ++ Main script ++

return function()
	
	do
		--// Cache every player position
		local characterPositions : {[World.Character] : Vector3} = {}

		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			
			if not character then continue end
			
			characterPositions[character] = character.PrimaryPart.Position
		end

		--// Scan for players
		for entityID, character : World.Character in
			World:query(Character):with(Scanning)
		do
			local humanoidRootPartPosition = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			local characterDistances : {[World.Character] : number} = {}

			for playerCharacter, position in characterPositions do
				characterDistances[playerCharacter] = (position - humanoidRootPartPosition).Magnitude
			end

			table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
				World:set(entityID, CharacterDistances, characterDistances)
			end))
			
		end
		
	end
	
	LuauFuturesExtension:AwaitAll()
	
	--// Check instant radius
	for entityID, characterDistances : {[World.Character] : number}, instantChaseRadius : number in
		World:query(CharacterDistances, InstantChaseRadius):with(Character, Scanning)
	do
		local closestValidCharacter : World.Character
		local closestValidDistance : number = math.huge
		
		for character, distance in characterDistances do
			
			if distance > instantChaseRadius or distance > closestValidDistance then continue end
			
			closestValidCharacter = character
		end
		
		if not closestValidCharacter then continue end
		
		table.insert(LuauFuturesExtension.DeferredFutures, LuauFutures.Future.new(function()
			World:set(entityID, Prey, closestValidCharacter)
			World:add(entityID, Jecs.pair(Pathfinding, Prey))
		end))
		
	end
	
	LuauFuturesExtension:PollAll()
end

-- DustDevil: the ranch's second hazard, and not another stampede. The sky bruises purple, a twister
-- spins up at the edge of the map and snakes along a ROW OF RANCHES (not the drive), swinging in and
-- out of the paddocks. Anyone it catches is flung skyward and spills a cut of their cash as coins;
-- only a rancher standing inside a LOCKED ranch is sheltered. It also spits lucky coins along its
-- path: brave ranchers chase it to grab them, at the risk of being swept up.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Events = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Events"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local Pens = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Pens"))
local Stampede = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Stampede"))
local Mood = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("Mood"))
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Critters = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Critters"))

local DustDevil = {}

DustDevil.WARNING = 7
DustDevil.SPEED = 17
DustDevil.REACH = 9 -- how close (horizontally) the funnel has to be to sweep you up
DustDevil.COIN_EVERY = 0.55
DustDevil.COIN_LIFE = 24

local PURPLE = Color3.fromRGB(190, 140, 255)
local rng = Random.new()

type Twister = { model: Model, core: BasePart, rings: { BasePart }, junk: { BasePart } }
type Coin = { part: BasePart, value: number, born: number, base: Vector3 }

local coins: { Coin } = {}
local coinFolder: Folder? = nil

local function part(parent: Instance, size: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, transparency: number, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = false, false, false
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Transparency = transparency
	if shape then
		p.Shape = shape
	end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- The funnel: stacked spinning rings that widen as they rise, a vortex of dust and orbiting junk.
local function buildTwister(at: Vector3): Twister
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "DustDevil"
	local core = part(model, Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), PURPLE, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 1)
	core.Position = at
	local rings = {}
	for i = 1, 11 do
		local d = 5 + i * 3.4
		local ring = part(model, Vector3.new(4.2, d, d), Color3.fromRGB(120 + i * 6, 80 + i * 5, 165 + i * 6),
			if i % 3 == 0 then Enum.Material.ForceField else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0.12 + i * 0.03, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		table.insert(rings, ring)
	end
	-- a glowing core up the middle of the funnel
	local spine = part(model, Vector3.new(48, 3.5, 3.5), Color3.fromRGB(220, 160, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	spine.Name = "Spine"
	local junk = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local bit = if i % 3 == 0
			then part(model, Vector3.new(3, 1.6, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(226, 190, 100), Enum.Material.Fabric, 0)
			else part(model, Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), Enum.Material.Grass, 0.1, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		table.insert(junk, bit)
	end
	local swirl = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	swirl.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/forcefield_vortex_main.dds"
	swirl.Rate = 30
	swirl.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2)
	swirl.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18)
	swirl.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	swirl.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20)
	swirl.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(200, 400)
	swirl.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 22) })
	swirl.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	swirl.Color = ColorSequence.new(PURPLE, Color3.fromRGB(120, 90, 140))
	swirl.LightEmission = 0.4
	swirl.Parent = core
	local dust = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	dust.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	dust.Rate = 40
	dust.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 2.5)
	dust.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 14)
	dust.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(80, 80)
	dust.Size = NumberSequence.new(4, 12)
	dust.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 1)
	dust.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170, 140, 160))
	dust.Parent = core
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = PURPLE
	light.Range = 40
	light.Brightness = 3
	light.Parent = core
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(16, 60, 3, 14)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 46, 0)
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.MaxDistance = 400
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "DUST DEVIL!"
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 20, 80)
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = core
	model.PrimaryPart = core
	model.Parent = Workspace
	return { model = model, core = core, rings = rings, junk = junk }
end

-- Poses the funnel around a ground point; grow (0..1) lets it spin up during the warning.
local function spinTwister(twister: Twister, at: Vector3, t: number, grow: number)
	twister.core.Position = at + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	local spine = twister.model:FindFirstChild("Spine") :: BasePart?
	if spine then
		spine.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 24 * grow, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 6, math.pi / 2)
		spine.Size = Vector3.new(48 * grow + 1, 3.5, 3.5)
	end
	for i, ring in twister.rings do
		local sway = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 1.7 + i * 0.6), 0, math.cos(t * 1.3 + i * 0.5)) * i * 0.45
		local y = 1.5 + i * 4.4 * grow
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + sway + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * (4 + i * 0.3), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
	end
	for i, bit in twister.junk do
		local a = t * (2.6 - i * 0.15) + i * 1.05
		local r = 9 + (i % 3) * 3
		bit.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, (8 + i * 5) * grow, math.sin(a) * r)) * CFrame.Angles(t * 3, t * 2, i)
	end
end

local function coinValue(): number
	local best = 0
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		best = math.max(best, Ledger.incomeOf(account))
	end
	return math.max(20, math.floor(best * 2.5))
end

-- A spinning gold coin on the ground; whoever touches it first banks its value.
function DustDevil.dropCoin(at: Vector3, value: number, fling: Vector3?)
	if not coinFolder then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "TwisterCoins"
		folder.Parent = Workspace
		coinFolder = folder
	end
	local coin = part(coinFolder :: Folder, Vector3.new(0.5, 2.8, 2.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 50), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	coin.Reflectance = 0.35
	coin.CanTouch = true
	local landing = Vector3.new(at.X, 2.2, at.Z) + (fling or Vector3.zero)
	coin.Position = landing
	local shine = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	shine.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	shine.Rate = 3
	shine.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
	shine.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
	shine.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6)
	shine.LightEmission = 1
	shine.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120))
	shine.Parent = coin
	local entry: Coin = { part = coin, value = value, born = os.clock(), base = landing }
	table.insert(coins, entry)
	coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local account = player and Ledger.accountOf(player)
		if not account or not coin.Parent then
			return
		end
		coin:Destroy()
		Ledger.addCash(account, entry.value)
		Ledger.cue(account, "coin", entry.value)
		Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "coin", amount = entry.value })
	end)
end

-- Spins every coin and clears the old ones (runs for as long as the server does).
local function tickCoins(t: number)
	for i = #coins, 1, -1 do
		local c = coins[i]
		if not c.part.Parent or os.clock() - c.born > DustDevil.COIN_LIFE then
			if c.part.Parent then
				c.part:Destroy()
			end
			table.remove(coins, i)
		else
			c.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.base + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 3 + i, 0)
		end
	end
end

-- Is this rancher sheltered from the twister (inside a ranch whose gate is locked)?
local function sheltered(position: Vector3): boolean
	local _, owner = Pens.ranchAt(position)
	return owner ~= nil and Ledger.isLocked(owner)
end

function DustDevil.startDustDevil(_arg: any?)
	local row = if rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then -42 else 42
	local westToEast = rng:NextNumber() < 0.5
	local fromX, toX = if westToEast then -175 else 175, if westToEast then 175 else -175
	local function pathAt(x: number): Vector3
		return Vector3.new(x, 0, row + math.sin(x / 23) * 16)
	end
	local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	Events.setPhase("dustdevil", "warning", now + DustDevil.WARNING)
	Mood.set("dust", DustDevil.WARNING)
	Ledger.cueAll("dustWarn", DustDevil.WARNING)
	local side = if row < 0 then "NORTH" else "SOUTH"
	Ledger.toastAll("A DUST DEVIL is spinning up on the " .. side .. " ranches! Lock your gate or keep clear!", PURPLE)
	local twister = buildTwister(pathAt(fromX))
	local t = 0
	while t < DustDevil.WARNING do
		t += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		spinTwister(twister, pathAt(fromX), t, math.clamp(t / DustDevil.WARNING, 0.15, 1))
	end

	local travel = math.abs(toX - fromX) / DustDevil.SPEED
	Events.setPhase("dustdevil", "active", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + travel)
	Ledger.cueAll("dustDevil", travel)
	local x = fromX
	local step = if toX > fromX then 1 else -1
	local nextCoin = 0
	while (toX - x) * step > 0 do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		t += dt
		x += step * DustDevil.SPEED * dt
		local at = pathAt(x)
		spinTwister(twister, at, t, 1)
		nextCoin -= dt
		if nextCoin <= 0 then
			nextCoin = DustDevil.COIN_EVERY
			local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
			DustDevil.dropCoin(at, coinValue(), Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * rng:NextNumber(10, 18))
		end
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if root then
				local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - at.X, 0, root.Position.Z - at.Z)
				if flat.Magnitude < DustDevil.REACH and not sheltered(root.Position) then
					local lost = Stampede.trampleRancher(player, Cast.DUST_DEVIL_CASH_SPILLED, "twister")
					local pieces = math.clamp(math.floor(lost / 25), 0, 6)
					for i = 1, pieces do
						local a = i * math.pi * 2 / pieces
						DustDevil.dropCoin(root.Position, math.floor(lost / pieces), Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * 12)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	Critters.poof(twister.core.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), PURPLE, 40)
	twister.model:Destroy()
	Mood.set("normal", 5)
	Ledger.cueAll("allClear")
	Ledger.toastAll("The Dust Devil blew itself out. Grab the coins it left behind!", Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 255))
end

-- Keeps the coins spinning and registers the twister with the calendar.
function DustDevil.startCoinSpinner()
	local t = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		if #coins > 0 then
			tickCoins(t)
		end
	end)
end

Events.register("dustdevil", DustDevil.startDustDevil)

return DustDevil
