-- SOFTWARE.

local W=require(script.Parent.World)
local B=require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local E=require(script.Parent.MoneyService)
local Shield=require(script.Parent.ShieldService)
local S={carriers={}}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
function S.near(player,part)
 local character=player.Character
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and (root.Position-part.Position).Magnitude<=12
end
function S.prompts(item,enabled)
 for _,v in ipairs(item.model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then v.Enabled=enabled end end
end
function S.anchor(item,anchored)
 for _,v in ipairs(item.model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=anchored v.CanCollide=false end end
end
function S.park(item,owner,slot)
 if item.weld then item.weld:Destroy() item.weld=nil end
 item.owner=owner item.slot=slot
 slot.item=item slot.inTransit=false
 S.anchor(item,true) item.model:PivotTo(slot.cf)
 S.prompts(item,true)
end
function S.clearCarry(player)
 local carry=S.carriers[player]
 if not carry then return end
 S.carriers[player]=nil player:SetAttribute("Carrying",false)
 if carry.item.weld then carry.item.weld:Destroy() carry.item.weld=nil end
 return carry
end
function S.restore(player)
 local carry=S.clearCarry(player) if not carry then return end
 local item=carry.item
 if carry.originOwner and carry.originOwner.Parent==Players and carry.originSlot then
  S.park(item,carry.originOwner,carry.originSlot)
 else
  if carry.originSlot then carry.originSlot.item=nil carry.originSlot.inTransit=false end
  item.model:Destroy()
 end
end
function S.carry(player,item,kind)
 if S.carriers[player] or not S.near(player,item.model.PrimaryPart) or not B.get(player) then return false end
 local root=player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
 local own=B.get(player)
 if kind=="raid" and not B.freeSlot(player) then return false end
 local carry={item=item,originSlot=item.slot,originOwner=item.owner,kind=kind,left=not B.isSheltered(own,root.Position)}
 if item.slot then item.slot.inTransit=true end
 S.carriers[player]=carry player:SetAttribute("Carrying",true)
 S.prompts(item,false)
 S.anchor(item,true) item.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,4.45,-0.35))
 for _,part in ipairs(item.model:GetDescendants()) do
  if part:IsA("BasePart") and part~=item.model.PrimaryPart then
   local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint") weld.Part0=item.model.PrimaryPart weld.Part1=part weld.Parent=part
  end
 end
 S.anchor(item,false)
 local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint") weld.Part0=root weld.Part1=item.model.PrimaryPart weld.Parent=item.model.PrimaryPart item.weld=weld
 return true
end
function S.attach(item)
 local root=item.model.PrimaryPart
 W.prompt(root,"Pick Up","Your brainrot",function(player)
  local slot=item.slot
  if item.owner~=player or not slot or slot.item~=item or slot.inTransit then return end
  S.carry(player,item,"pickup")
 end)
 W.prompt(root,"Raid","Steal brainrot",function(player)
  local victim=item.owner local slot=item.slot
  if not victim or victim==player or not slot or slot.item~=item or slot.inTransit then return end
  local plot=B.get(victim)
  if not plot or Shield.active(plot) then return end
  S.carry(player,item,"raid")
 end,1.25)
end
function S.deliver(player)
 local carry=S.carriers[player] if not carry then return end
 local slot=B.freeSlot(player)
 if not slot and carry.originOwner==player then slot=carry.originSlot end
 if not slot then return end
 S.clearCarry(player)
 if carry.originSlot then carry.originSlot.item=nil carry.originSlot.inTransit=false end
 S.park(carry.item,player,slot)
 S.notify(player,"Delivered to your safehouse!")
end
function S.sell(player)
 local carry=S.clearCarry(player)
 if not carry then return "Carry a brainrot to sell it." end
 if carry.originSlot then carry.originSlot.item=nil carry.originSlot.inTransit=false end
 E.add(player,math.floor(carry.item.price*0.5))
 carry.item.model:Destroy()
 return "Sold for 50% of purchase price."
end
function S.step()
 for player,carry in pairs(S.carriers) do
  local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then S.restore(player)
  else
   local own=B.get(player)
   if carry.kind=="raid" then
    local victim=B.get(carry.originOwner)
    if victim and B.isSheltered(victim,root.Position) then
     if carry.exitedVictim then S.restore(player) continue end
    else carry.exitedVictim=true end
   end
   if own then
    local inside=B.isSheltered(own,root.Position)
    if not inside then carry.left=true elseif carry.left then S.deliver(player) end
   end
  end
 end
end
function S.leaving(player)
 S.restore(player)
 local affected={}
 for raider,carry in pairs(S.carriers) do if carry.originOwner==player then table.insert(affected,raider) end end
 for _,raider in ipairs(affected) do S.restore(raider) end
end
function S.init(notify) S.notify=notify end
return S

-- Events: the ranch's calendar. Between calm spells it runs one set-piece at a time, in a rotation:
-- the STAMPEDE (rot bulls down the drive), GOLDEN HOUR (double income, golden light, more Golden
-- critters) and the DUST DEVIL (a purple twister through the ranch rows that flings ranchers and
-- spits coins). Each event registers a runner here; this module publishes what is on now and what
-- is next (Workspace attributes the HUD's timer reads) and rewards everyone who came through unhurt.
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))

local Events = {}

Events.GAP = { 55, 75 } -- seconds of calm between two events
Events.FIRST_GAP = 70 -- a new server gives the first players time to lasso before anything happens
Events.ORDER = { "stampede", "goldenhour", "dustdevil", "stampede", "dustdevil", "goldenhour" }
Events.NAMES = { stampede = "STAMPEDE", goldenhour = "GOLDEN HOUR", dustdevil = "DUST DEVIL" }

-- What the running event does to the economy (Income and the Cattle Drive read these).
Events.incomeBoost = 1
Events.goldenBoost = 1

local runners: { [string]: () -> () } = {}
local running: string? = nil
local turn = 0
local rng = Random.new()

function Events.register(kind: string, runner: () -> ())
	runners[kind] = runner
end

function Events.current(): string?
	return running
end

-- Publishes the running event's phase; endsAt is the server time the phase ends (0 if unknown).
function Events.setPhase(kind: string, phase: string, endsAt: number)
	Workspace:SetAttribute("EventKind", kind)
	Workspace:SetAttribute("EventPhase", phase)
	Workspace:SetAttribute("EventEndsAt", endsAt)
end

local function scheduleNext(delay: number)
	turn = turn % #Events.ORDER + 1
	Workspace:SetAttribute("NextEventKind", Events.ORDER[turn])
	Workspace:SetAttribute("NextEventAt", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + delay)
end

-- Runs one event now (a scheduled one, or one the Showcase asks for). Returns false if one is on.
function Events.trigger(kind: string): boolean
	local runner = runners[kind]
	if running or not runner then
		return false
	end
	running = kind
	local startedAt = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	Workspace:SetAttribute("NextEventAt", 0)
	local ok, err = pcall(runner)
	if not ok then
		warn("Event " .. kind .. " failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	Events.incomeBoost = 1
	Events.goldenBoost = 1
	Events.setPhase("", "calm", 0)
	-- Everyone who was not trampled or flung during it survived the event.
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		if account.trampledUntil < startedAt + 4 then
			Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "survive", id = kind })
		end
	end
	running = nil
	scheduleNext(rng:NextInteger(Events.GAP[1], Events.GAP[2]))
	return true
end

-- The calendar loop: wait for the next event's time, then run it.
function Events.startEventClock()
	Events.setPhase("", "calm", 0)
	turn = 0
	scheduleNext(Events.FIRST_GAP)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			local at = Workspace:GetAttribute("NextEventAt") :: number?
			if not running and at and at > 0 and Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= at then
				Events.trigger(Workspace:GetAttribute("NextEventKind") :: string)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Events

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Iris): Types.Internal
    --[=[
        @class Internal
        An internal class within Iris containing all the backend data and functions for Iris to operate.
        It is recommended that you don't generally interact with Internal unless you understand what you are doing.
    ]=]
    local Internal = {} :: Types.Internal

    --[[
        ---------------------------------
            [SECTION] Properties
        ---------------------------------
    ]]

    Internal._version = [[ 2.5.1 ]]

    Internal._started = false -- has Iris.connect been called yet
    Internal._shutdown = false
    Internal._cycleTick = 0 -- increments for each call to Cycle, used to determine the relative age and freshness of generated widgets
    Internal._deltaTime = 0

    -- Refresh
    Internal._globalRefreshRequested = false -- refresh means that all GUI is destroyed and regenerated, usually because a style change was made and needed to be propogated to all UI
    Internal._refreshCounter = 0 -- if true, when _Insert is called, the widget called will be regenerated
    Internal._refreshLevel = 1
    Internal._refreshStack = table.create(16)

    -- Widgets & Instances
    Internal._widgets = {}
    Internal._stackIndex = 1 -- Points to the index that IDStack is currently in, when computing cycle
    Internal._rootInstance = nil
    Internal._rootWidget = {
        ID = "R",
        type = "Root",
        Instance = Internal._rootInstance,
        ZIndex = 0,
        ZOffset = 0,
    }
    Internal._lastWidget = Internal._rootWidget -- widget which was most recently rendered

    -- Config
    Internal._rootConfig = {} -- root style which all widgets derive from
    Internal._config = Internal._rootConfig

    -- ID
    Internal._IDStack = { "R" }
    Internal._usedIDs = {} -- hash of IDs which are already used in a cycle, value is the # of occurances so that getID can assign a unique ID for each occurance
    Internal._pushedIds = {}
    Internal._newID = false
    Internal._nextWidgetId = nil

    -- State
    Internal._states = {} -- Iris.States

    -- Callback
    Internal._postCycleCallbacks = {}
    Internal._connectedFunctions = {} -- functions which run each Iris cycle, connected by the user
    Internal._connections = {}
    Internal._initFunctions = {}

    -- Error
    Internal._fullErrorTracebacks = game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio()

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @prop _cycleCoroutine thread

        The thread which handles all connected functions. Each connection is within a pcall statement which prevents
        Iris from crashing and instead stopping at the error.
    ]=]
    Internal._cycleCoroutine = coroutine.create(function()
        while Internal._started do
            for _, callback in Internal._connectedFunctions do
                debug.profilebegin("Iris/Connection")
                local status, _error: string = pcall(callback)
                debug.profileend()
                if not status then
                    -- any error reserts the _stackIndex for the next frame and yields the error.
                    Internal._stackIndex = 1
                    coroutine.yield(false, _error)
                end
            end
            -- after all callbacks, we yield so it only runs once a frame.
            coroutine.yield(true)
        end
    end)

    --[[
        -----------------------
            [SECTION] State
        -----------------------
    ]]

    --[=[
        @class State
        This class wraps a value in getters and setters, its main purpose is to allow primatives to be passed as objects.
        Constructors for this class are available in [Iris]

        ```lua
        local state = Iris.State(0) -- we initialise the state with a value of 0

        -- these are equivalent. Ideally you should use `:get()` and ignore `.value`.
        print(state:get())
        print(state.value)

        state:set(state:get() + 1) -- increments the state by getting the current value and adding 1.

        state:onChange(function(newValue)
            print(`The value of the state is now: {newValue}`)
        end)
        ```

        :::caution Caution: Callbacks
        Never call `:set()` on a state when inside the `:onChange()` callback of the same state. This will cause a continous callback.

        Never chain states together so that each state changes the value of another state in a cyclic nature. This will cause a continous callback.
        :::
    ]=]
    local StateClass = {}
    StateClass.__index = StateClass

    --[=[
        @within State
        @method get<T>
        @return T

        Returns the states current value.
    ]=]
    function StateClass:get<T>() -- you can also simply use .value
        return self.value
    end

    --[=[
        @within State
        @method set<T>
        @param newValue T
        @param force boolean? -- force an update to all connections
        @return T

        Allows the caller to assign the state object a new value, and returns the new value.
    ]=]
    function StateClass:set<T>(newValue: T, force: true?)
        if newValue == self.value and force ~= true then
            -- no need to update on no change.
            return self.value
        end
        self.value = newValue
        self.lastChangeTick = Iris.Internal._cycleTick
        for _, thisWidget: Types.Widget in self.ConnectedWidgets do
            if thisWidget.lastCycleTick ~= -1 then
                Internal._widgets[thisWidget.type].UpdateState(thisWidget)
            end
        end

        for _, callback in self.ConnectedFunctions do
            callback(newValue)
        end
        return self.value
    end

    --[=[
        @within State
        @method onChange<T>
        @param callback (newValue: T) -> ()
        @return () -> ()

        Allows the caller to connect a callback which is called when the states value is changed.

        :::caution Caution: Single
        Calling `:onChange()` every frame will add a new function every frame.
        You must ensure you are only calling `:onChange()` once for each callback for the state's entire lifetime.
        :::
    ]=]
    function StateClass:onChange<T>(callback: (newValue: T) -> ())
        local connectionIndex: number = #self.ConnectedFunctions + 1
        self.ConnectedFunctions[connectionIndex] = callback
        return function()
            self.ConnectedFunctions[connectionIndex] = nil
        end
    end

    --[=[
        @within State
        @method changed<T>
        @return boolean

        Returns true if the state was changed on this frame.
    ]=]
    function StateClass:changed<T>()
        return self.lastChangeTick + 1 == Internal._cycleTick
    end

    Internal.StateClass = StateClass

    --[[
        ---------------------------
            [SECTION] Functions
        ---------------------------
    ]]

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _cycle

        Called every frame to handle all of the widget management. Any previous frame data is ammended and everything updates.
    ]=]
    function Internal._cycle(deltaTime: number)
        -- debug.profilebegin("Iris/Cycle")
        if Iris.Disabled then
            return -- Stops all rendering, effectively freezes the current frame with no interaction.
        end

        Internal._rootWidget.lastCycleTick = Internal._cycleTick
        if Internal._rootInstance == nil or Internal._rootInstance.Parent == nil then
            Iris.ForceRefresh()
        end

        for _, widget in Internal._lastVDOM do
            if widget.lastCycleTick ~= Internal._cycleTick and (widget.lastCycleTick ~= -1) then
                -- a widget which used to be rendered was not called last frame, so we discard it.
                -- if the cycle tick is -1 we have already discarded it.
                Internal._DiscardWidget(widget)
            end
        end

        -- represents all widgets created last frame. We keep the _lastVDOM to reuse widgets from the previous frame
        -- rather than creating a new instance every frame.
        setmetatable(Internal._lastVDOM, { __mode = "kv" })
        Internal._lastVDOM = Internal._VDOM
        Internal._VDOM = Internal._generateEmptyVDOM()

        -- anything that wnats to run before the frame.
        task.spawn(function()
            -- debug.profilebegin("Iris/PostCycleCallbacks")
            for _, callback in Internal._postCycleCallbacks do
                callback()
            end
            -- debug.profileend()
        end)

        if Internal._globalRefreshRequested then
            -- rerender every widget
            --debug.profilebegin("Iris Refresh")
            Internal._generateSelectionImageObject()
            Internal._globalRefreshRequested = false
            for _, widget in Internal._lastVDOM do
                Internal._DiscardWidget(widget)
            end
            Internal._generateRootInstance()
            Internal._lastVDOM = Internal._generateEmptyVDOM()
            --debug.profileend()
        end

        -- update counters
        Internal._cycleTick += 1
        Internal._deltaTime = deltaTime
        table.clear(Internal._usedIDs)

        -- if Internal.parentInstance:IsA("GuiBase2d") and math.min(Internal.parentInstance.AbsoluteSize.X, Internal.parentInstance.AbsoluteSize.Y) < 100 then
        --     error("Iris Parent Instance is too small")
        -- end
        local compatibleParent = (Internal.parentInstance:IsA("GuiBase2d") or Internal.parentInstance:IsA("BasePlayerGui"))
        if compatibleParent == false then
            error("The Iris parent instance will not display any GUIs.")
        end

        -- if we are running in Studio, we want full error tracebacks, so we don't have
        -- any pcall to protect from an error.
        if Internal._fullErrorTracebacks then
            -- debug.profilebegin("Iris/Cycle/Callback")
            for _, callback in Internal._connectedFunctions do
                callback()
            end
        else
            -- debug.profilebegin("Iris/Cycle/Coroutine")

            -- each frame we check on our thread status.
            local coroutineStatus = coroutine.status(Internal._cycleCoroutine)
            if coroutineStatus == "suspended" then
                -- suspended means it yielded, either because it was a complete success
                -- or it caught an error in the code. We run it again for this frame.
                local _, success, result = coroutine.resume(Internal._cycleCoroutine)
                if success == false then
                    -- Connected function code errored
                    error(result, 0)
                end
            elseif coroutineStatus == "running" then
                -- still running (probably because of an asynchronous method inside a connection).
                error("Iris cycleCoroutine took to long to yield. Connected functions should not yield.")
            else
                -- should never reach this (nothing you can do).
                error("unrecoverable state")
            end
            -- debug.profileend()
        end

        if Internal._stackIndex ~= 1 then
            -- has to be larger than 1 because of the check that it isnt below 1 in Iris.End
            Internal._stackIndex = 1
            error("Too few calls to Iris.End().", 0)
        end

        -- Errors if the end user forgot to pop all their ids as they would leak over into the next frame
        -- could also just clear, but that might be confusing behaviour.
        if #Internal._pushedIds ~= 0 then
            error("Too few calls to Iris.PopId().", 0)
        end

        -- debug.profileend()
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @ignore
        @function _NoOp

        A dummy function which does nothing. Used as a placeholder for optional methods in a widget class.
        Used in `Internal.WidgetConstructor`
    ]=]
    function Internal._NoOp() end

    --  Widget

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function WidgetConstructor
        @param type string -- name used to denote the widget class.
        @param widgetClass Types.WidgetClass -- table of methods for the new widget.

        For each widget, a widget class is created which handles all the operations of a widget. This removes the class nature
        of widgets, and simplifies the available functions which can be applied to any widget. The widgets themselves are
        dumb tables containing all the data but no methods to handle any of the data apart from events.
    ]=]
    function Internal.WidgetConstructor(type: string, widgetClass: Types.WidgetClass)
        local Fields = {
            All = {
                Required = {
                    "Generate", -- generates the instance.
                    "Discard",
                    "Update",

                    -- not methods !
                    "Args",
                    "Events",
                    "hasChildren",
                    "hasState",
                },
                Optional = {},
            },
            IfState = {
                Required = {
                    "GenerateState",
                    "UpdateState",
                },
                Optional = {},
            },
            IfChildren = {
                Required = {
                    "ChildAdded", -- returns the parent of the child widget.
                },
                Optional = {
                    "ChildDiscarded",
                },
            },
        }

        -- we ensure all essential functions and properties are present, otherwise the code will break later.
        -- some functions will only be needed if the widget has children or has state.
        local thisWidget = {} :: Types.WidgetClass
        for _, field in Fields.All.Required do
            assert(widgetClass[field] ~= nil, `field {field} is missing from widget {type}, it is required for all widgets`)
            thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
        end

        for _, field in Fields.All.Optional do
            if widgetClass[field] == nil then
                -- assign a dummy function which does nothing.
                thisWidget[field] = Internal._NoOp
            else
                thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
            end
        end

        if widgetClass.hasState then
            for _, field in Fields.IfState.Required do
                assert(widgetClass[field] ~= nil, `field {field} is missing from widget {type}, it is required for all widgets with state`)
                thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
            end
            for _, field in Fields.IfState.Optional do
                if widgetClass[field] == nil then
                    thisWidget[field] = Internal._NoOp
                else
                    thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
                end
            end
        end

        if widgetClass.hasChildren then
            for _, field in Fields.IfChildren.Required do
                assert(widgetClass[field] ~= nil, `field {field} is missing from widget {type}, it is required for all widgets with children`)
                thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
            end
            for _, field in Fields.IfChildren.Optional do
                if widgetClass[field] == nil then
                    thisWidget[field] = Internal._NoOp
                else
                    thisWidget[field] = widgetClass[field]
                end
            end
        end

        -- an internal table of all widgets to the widget class.
        Internal._widgets[type] = thisWidget
        -- allowing access to the index for each widget argument.
        Iris.Args[type] = thisWidget.Args

        local ArgNames = {}
        for index, argument in thisWidget.Args do
            ArgNames[argument] = index
        end
        thisWidget.ArgNames = ArgNames

        for index, _ in thisWidget.Events do
            if Iris.Events[index] == nil then
                Iris.Events[index] = function()
                    return Internal._EventCall(Internal._lastWidget, index)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _Insert
        @param widgetType: string -- name of widget class.
        @param arguments { [string]: number } -- arguments of the widget.
        @param states { [string]: States<any> }? -- states of the widget.
        @return Widget -- the widget.

        Every widget is created through _Insert. An ID is generated based on the line of the calling code and is used to
        find the previous frame widget if it exists. If no widget exists, a new one is created.
    ]=]
    function Internal._Insert(widgetType: string, args: Types.WidgetArguments?, states: Types.WidgetStates?)
        local ID = Internal._getID(3)
        --debug.profilebegin(ID)

        -- fetch the widget class which contains all the functions for the widget.
        local thisWidgetClass = Internal._widgets[widgetType]

        if Internal._VDOM[ID] then
            -- widget already created once this frame, so we can append to it.
            return Internal._ContinueWidget(ID, widgetType)
        end

        local arguments = {} :: Types.Arguments
        if args ~= nil then
            if type(args) ~= "table" then
                args = { args }
            end

            -- convert the arguments to a key-value dictionary so arguments can be referred to by their name and not index.
            for index, argument in args do
                assert(index > 0, `Widget Arguments must be a positive number, not {index} of type {typeof(index)} for {argument}.`)
                arguments[thisWidgetClass.ArgNames[index]] = argument
            end
        end
        -- prevents tampering with the arguments which are used to check for changes.
        table.freeze(arguments)

        local lastWidget = Internal._lastVDOM[ID]
        if lastWidget then
            if Internal._refreshCounter > 0 or widgetType ~= lastWidget.type then
                -- every widget is being redrawn, or this widget type has changed
                Internal._DiscardWidget(lastWidget)
                lastWidget = nil
            end
        end
        local thisWidget = if lastWidget == nil then Internal._GenNewWidget(widgetType, arguments, states, ID) else lastWidget

        local parentWidget = thisWidget.parentWidget

        if thisWidget.type ~= "Window" and thisWidget.type ~= "Tooltip" then
            if thisWidget.ZIndex ~= parentWidget.ZOffset then
                parentWidget.ZUpdate = true
            end

            if parentWidget.ZUpdate then
                thisWidget.ZIndex = parentWidget.ZOffset
                if thisWidget.Instance then
                    thisWidget.Instance.ZIndex = thisWidget.ZIndex
                    thisWidget.Instance.LayoutOrder = thisWidget.ZIndex
                end
            end
        end

        -- since rows are not instances, but will be removed if not updated, we have to add specific table code.
        if parentWidget.type == "Table" then
            local Table = parentWidget :: Types.Table
            Table._rowCycles[Table._rowIndex] = Internal._cycleTick
        end

        if Internal._deepCompare(thisWidget.providedArguments, arguments) == false then
            -- the widgets arguments have changed, the widget should update to reflect changes.
            -- providedArguments is the frozen table which will not change.
            -- the arguments can be altered internally, which happens for the input widgets.
            thisWidget.arguments = Internal._deepCopy(arguments)
            thisWidget.providedArguments = arguments
            thisWidgetClass.Update(thisWidget)
        end

        thisWidget.lastCycleTick = Internal._cycleTick
        parentWidget.ZOffset += 1

        if thisWidgetClass.hasChildren then
            local thisParent = thisWidget :: Types.ParentWidget
            -- a parent widget, so we increase our depth.
            thisParent.ZOffset = 0
            thisParent.ZUpdate = false
            Internal._stackIndex += 1
            Internal._IDStack[Internal._stackIndex] = thisWidget.ID
        end

        Internal._VDOM[ID] = thisWidget
        Internal._lastWidget = thisWidget

        --debug.profileend()

        return thisWidget
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _GenNewWidget
        @param widgetType string
        @param arguments { [string]: any } -- arguments of the widget.
        @param states { [string]: State<any> }? -- states of the widget.
        @param ID ID -- id of the new widget. Determined in `Internal._Insert`
        @return Widget -- the newly created widget.

        All widgets are created as tables with properties. The widget class contains the functions to create the UI instances and
        update the widget or change state.
    ]=]
    function Internal._GenNewWidget(widgetType: string, arguments: Types.Arguments, states: Types.WidgetStates?, ID: Types.ID)
        local parentId = Internal._IDStack[Internal._stackIndex]
        local parentWidget: Types.ParentWidget = Internal._VDOM[parentId]
        local thisWidgetClass = Internal._widgets[widgetType]

        -- widgets are just tables with properties.
        local thisWidget = {} :: Types.Widget
        setmetatable(thisWidget, thisWidget)

        thisWidget.ID = ID
        thisWidget.type = widgetType
        thisWidget.parentWidget = parentWidget
        thisWidget.trackedEvents = {}
        -- thisWidget.UID = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false):sub(0, 8)

        -- widgets have lots of space to ensure they are always visible.
        thisWidget.ZIndex = parentWidget.ZOffset

        thisWidget.Instance = thisWidgetClass.Generate(thisWidget)
        -- tooltips set their parent in the generation method, so we need to udpate it here
        parentWidget = thisWidget.parentWidget

        if Internal._config.Parent then
            thisWidget.Instance.Parent = Internal._config.Parent
        else
            thisWidget.Instance.Parent = Internal._widgets[parentWidget.type].ChildAdded(parentWidget, thisWidget)
        end

        -- we can modify the arguments table, but keep a frozen copy to compare for user-end changes.
        thisWidget.providedArguments = arguments
        thisWidget.arguments = Internal._deepCopy(arguments)
        thisWidgetClass.Update(thisWidget)

        local eventMTParent
        if thisWidgetClass.hasState then
            local stateWidget = thisWidget :: Types.StateWidget
            if states then
                for index, state in states do
                    if not (type(state) == "table" and getmetatable(state :: any) == Internal.StateClass) then
                        -- generate a new state.
                        states[index] = Internal._widgetState(stateWidget, index, state)
                    end
                    states[index].lastChangeTick = Internal._cycleTick
                end

                stateWidget.state = states
                for _, state in states do
                    state.ConnectedWidgets[stateWidget.ID] = stateWidget
                end
            else
                stateWidget.state = {}
            end

            thisWidgetClass.GenerateState(stateWidget)
            thisWidgetClass.UpdateState(stateWidget)

            -- the state MT can't be itself because state has to explicitly only contain stateClass objects
            stateWidget.stateMT = {}
            setmetatable(stateWidget.state, stateWidget.stateMT)

            stateWidget.__index = stateWidget.state
            eventMTParent = stateWidget.stateMT
        else
            eventMTParent = thisWidget
        end

        eventMTParent.__index = function(_, eventName)
            return function()
                return Internal._EventCall(thisWidget, eventName)
            end
        end
        return thisWidget
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _ContinueWidget
        @param ID ID -- id of the widget.
        @param widgetType string
        @return Widget -- the widget.

        Since the widget has already been created this frame, we can just add it back to the stack. There is no checking of
        arguments or states.
        Basically equivalent to the end of `Internal._Insert`.
    ]=]
    function Internal._ContinueWidget(ID: Types.ID, widgetType: string)
        local thisWidgetClass = Internal._widgets[widgetType]
        local thisWidget = Internal._VDOM[ID]

        if thisWidgetClass.hasChildren then
            -- a parent widget so we increase our depth.
            Internal._stackIndex += 1
            Internal._IDStack[Internal._stackIndex] = thisWidget.ID
        end

        Internal._lastWidget = thisWidget
        return thisWidget
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _DiscardWidget
        @param widgetToDiscard Widget

        Destroys the widget instance and updates any parent. This happens if the widget was not called in the
        previous frame. There is no code which needs to update any widget tables since they are already reset
        at the start before discarding happens.
    ]=]
    function Internal._DiscardWidget(widgetToDiscard: Types.Widget)
        local widgetParent = widgetToDiscard.parentWidget
        if widgetParent then
            -- if the parent needs to update it's children.
            Internal._widgets[widgetParent.type].ChildDiscarded(widgetParent, widgetToDiscard)
        end

        -- using the widget class discard function.
        Internal._widgets[widgetToDiscard.type].Discard(widgetToDiscard)

        -- mark as discarded
        widgetToDiscard.lastCycleTick = -1
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _widgetState
        @param thisWidget Widget -- widget the state belongs to.
        @param stateName string
        @param initialValue any
        @return State<any> -- the state for the widget.

        Connects the state to the widget. If no state exists then a new one is created. Called for every state in every
        widget if the user does not provide a state.
    ]=]
    function Internal._widgetState<T>(thisWidget: Types.StateWidget, stateName: string, initialValue: T)
        local ID = thisWidget.ID .. stateName
        if Internal._states[ID] then
            Internal._states[ID].ConnectedWidgets[thisWidget.ID] = thisWidget
            Internal._states[ID].lastChangeTick = Internal._cycleTick
            return Internal._states[ID]
        else
            local newState = {
                ID = ID,
                value = initialValue,
                lastChangeTick = Internal._cycleTick,
                ConnectedWidgets = { [thisWidget.ID] = thisWidget },
                ConnectedFunctions = {},
            } :: Types.State<T>
            setmetatable(newState, Internal.StateClass)
            Internal._states[ID] = newState
            return newState
        end
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _EventCall
        @param thisWidget Widget
        @param evetName string
        @return boolean -- the value of the event.

        A wrapper for any event on any widget. Automatically, Iris does not initialize events unless they are explicitly
        called so in the first frame, the event connections are set up. Every event is a function which returns a boolean.
    ]=]
    function Internal._EventCall(thisWidget: Types.Widget, eventName: string)
        local Events = Internal._widgets[thisWidget.type].Events
        local Event = Events[eventName]
        assert(Event ~= nil, `widget {thisWidget.type} has no event of name {eventName}`)

        if thisWidget.trackedEvents[eventName] == nil then
            Event.Init(thisWidget)
            thisWidget.trackedEvents[eventName] = true
        end
        return Event.Get(thisWidget)
    end

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _GetParentWidget
        @return Widget -- the parent widget

        Returns the parent widget of the currently active widget, based on the stack depth.
    ]=]
    function Internal._GetParentWidget(): Types.ParentWidget
        return Internal._VDOM[Internal._IDStack[Internal._stackIndex]]
    end

    -- Generate

    --[=[
        @ignore
        @within Internal
        @function _generateEmptyVDOM
        @return { [ID]: Widget }

        Creates the VDOM at the start of each frame containing just the root instance.
    ]=]
    function Internal._generateEmptyVDOM()
        return {
            ["R"] = Internal._rootWidget,
        }
    end

    --[=[
        @ignore
        @within Internal
        @function _generateRootInstance

        Creates the root instance.
    ]=]
    function Internal._generateRootInstance()
        -- unsafe to call before Internal.connect
        Internal._rootInstance = Internal._widgets["Root"].Generate(Internal._widgets["Root"])
        Internal._rootInstance.Parent = Internal.parentInstance
        Internal._rootWidget.Instance = Internal._rootInstance
    end

    --[=[
        @ignore
        @within Internal
        @function _generateSelctionImageObject

        Creates the selection object for buttons.
    ]=]
    function Internal._generateSelectionImageObject()
        if Internal.SelectionImageObject then
            Internal.SelectionImageObject:Destroy()
        end

        local SelectionImageObject = Instance.new("Frame")
        SelectionImageObject.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1, -1)
        SelectionImageObject.Size = UDim2.new(1, 2, 1, 2)
        SelectionImageObject.BackgroundColor3 = Internal._config.SelectionImageObjectColor
        SelectionImageObject.BackgroundTransparency = Internal._config.SelectionImageObjectTransparency
        SelectionImageObject.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Internal._utility.UIStroke(SelectionImageObject, 1, Internal._config.SelectionImageObjectBorderColor, Internal._config.SelectionImageObjectBorderTransparency)
        Internal._utility.UICorner(SelectionImageObject, 2)

        Internal.SelectionImageObject = SelectionImageObject
    end

    -- Utility

    --[=[
        @within Internal
        @function _getID
        @param levelsToIgnore number -- used to skip over internal calls to `_getID`.
        @return ID

        Generates a unique ID for each widget which is based on the line that the widget is
        created from. This ensures that the function is heuristic and always returns the same
        id for the same widget.
    ]=]
    function Internal._getID(levelsToIgnore: number)
        if Internal._nextWidgetId then
            local ID = Internal._nextWidgetId
            Internal._nextWidgetId = nil
            return ID
        end

        local i = 1 + (levelsToIgnore or 1)
        local ID = ""
        local levelInfo = debug.info(i, "l")
        while levelInfo ~= -1 and levelInfo ~= nil do
            ID ..= "+" .. levelInfo
            i += 1
            levelInfo = debug.info(i, "l")
        end

        local discriminator = Internal._usedIDs[ID]
        if discriminator then
            Internal._usedIDs[ID] += 1
            discriminator += 1
        else
            Internal._usedIDs[ID] = 1
            discriminator = 1
        end

        if #Internal._pushedIds == 0 then
            return ID .. ":" .. discriminator
        elseif Internal._newID then
            Internal._newID = false
            return ID .. "::" .. table.concat(Internal._pushedIds, "\\")
        else
            return ID .. ":" .. discriminator .. ":" .. table.concat(Internal._pushedIds, "\\")
        end
    end

    --[=[
        @ignore
        @within Internal
        @function _deepCompare
        @param t1 {}
        @param t2 {}
        @return boolean

        Compares two tables to check if they are the same. It uses a recursive iteration through one table
        to compare against the other. Used to determine if the arguments of a widget have changed since last
        frame.
    ]=]
    function Internal._deepCompare(t1: {}, t2: {})
        -- unoptimized ?
        for i, v1 in t1 do
            local v2 = t2[i]
            if type(v1) == "table" then
                if v2 and type(v2) == "table" then
                    if Internal._deepCompare(v1, v2) == false then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
            else
                if type(v1) ~= type(v2) or v1 ~= v2 then
                    return false
                end
            end
        end

        return true
    end

    --[=[
        @ignore
        @within Internal
        @function _deepCopy
        @param t {}
        @return {}

        Performs a deep copy of a table so that neither table contains a shared reference.
    ]=]
    function Internal._deepCopy(t: {}): {}
        local copy: {} = table.clone(t)

        for k, v in t do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                copy[k] = Internal._deepCopy(v)
            end
        end

        return copy
    end

    -- VDOM
    Internal._lastVDOM = Internal._generateEmptyVDOM()
    Internal._VDOM = Internal._generateEmptyVDOM()

    Iris.Internal = Internal
    Iris._config = Internal._config
    return Internal
end

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local B=require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local W=require(script.Parent.World)
local V={phase="CALM",hit={}}
function V.init(notify,now)
 V.notify=notify V.next=now+52
 V.wall=W.part(W.root,"Tsunami",Vector3.new(11,16,200),CFrame.new(-146,8,0),Color3.fromRGB(35,172,235),Enum.Material.Glass)
 V.wall.Transparency=1 V.wall.CanCollide=false
 V.crest=W.part(W.root,"Wave crest",Vector3.new(12,2,200),CFrame.new(-146,16,0),W.aqua,Enum.Material.Neon)
 V.crest.Transparency=1 V.crest.CanCollide=false
 workspace:SetAttribute("WavePhase","CALM") workspace:SetAttribute("WaveDeadline",V.next)
end
function V.step(now)
 if V.phase=="CALM" and now>=V.next then
  V.phase="EVACUATE" V.next=now+14
  for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do V.notify(p,"Tsunami incoming! Reach your safehouse.") end
  workspace:SetAttribute("WavePhase",V.phase) workspace:SetAttribute("WaveDeadline",V.next)
 elseif V.phase=="EVACUATE" and now>=V.next then
  V.phase="SWEEP" V.started=now V.hit={} V.wall.Transparency=0.24 V.crest.Transparency=0.08
  workspace:SetAttribute("WavePhase",V.phase) workspace:SetAttribute("WaveDeadline",now+8)
 end
 if V.phase=="SWEEP" then
  local progress=math.clamp((now-V.started)/8,0,1)
  local x=-146+292*progress
  V.wall.CFrame=CFrame.new(x,8,0) V.crest.CFrame=CFrame.new(x,16,0)
  for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local hum=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if root and hum and hum.Health>0 and not V.hit[player] and math.abs(root.Position.X-x)<=8 and math.abs(root.Position.Z)<=100 then
    V.hit[player]=true
    local safe=false
    for _,plot in ipairs(B.plots) do if B.isSheltered(plot,root.Position) then safe=true break end end
    if safe then V.notify(player,"Safehouse held.") else hum.Health=0 V.notify(player,"Swept away!") end
   end
  end
  if progress>=1 then
   V.wall.Transparency=1 V.crest.Transparency=1 V.phase="CALM" V.next=now+54
   workspace:SetAttribute("WavePhase","CALM") workspace:SetAttribute("WaveDeadline",V.next)
  end
 end
end
return V

-- GoldenHour: the ranch's good-news event. A five-second fanfare, then for thirty seconds the sun
-- sinks gold, glitter falls along the whole Cattle Drive, every pen pays DOUBLE, and critters on the
-- drive come out Golden four times as often. The stake: get out there and lasso while it lasts.
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Events = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Events"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local Mood = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("Mood"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("World"))

local GoldenHour = {}

GoldenHour.WARNING = 5
GoldenHour.LASTS = 30
GoldenHour.INCOME_BOOST = 2
GoldenHour.GOLDEN_BOOST = 4

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)

-- Glitter curtains along the drive and a ring of light over the barn, gone when the hour ends.
local function hangGlitter(): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "GoldenHourGlitter"
	for x = World.DRIVE_START_X + 10, World.DRIVE_END_X - 10, 26 do
		local cloud = Instance.new("Part")
		cloud.Anchored = true
		cloud.CanCollide, cloud.CanQuery, cloud.CanTouch = false, false, false
		cloud.Transparency = 1
		cloud.Size = Vector3.new(24, 1, 34)
		cloud.Position = Vector3.new(x, 20, 0)
		local glitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		glitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		glitter.Rate = 18
		glitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2.5, 4)
		glitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
		glitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
		glitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		glitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
		glitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.15) })
		glitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD, Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 200))
		glitter.LightEmission = 0.7
		glitter.Parent = cloud
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = GOLD
		light.Range = 30
		light.Brightness = 1.2
		light.Parent = cloud
		cloud.Parent = folder
	end
	-- A golden ribbon of neon down the middle of the drive
	local ribbon = Instance.new("Part")
	ribbon.Anchored = true
	ribbon.CanCollide, ribbon.CanQuery, ribbon.CanTouch = false, false, false
	ribbon.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ribbon.Color = GOLD
	ribbon.Transparency = 0.6
	ribbon.Size = Vector3.new(World.DRIVE_END_X - World.DRIVE_START_X, 0.1, 1.4)
	ribbon.Position = Vector3.new((World.DRIVE_END_X + World.DRIVE_START_X) / 2, 0.46, 0)
	ribbon.Parent = folder
	folder.Parent = Workspace
	return folder
end

function GoldenHour.startGoldenHour(_arg: any?)
	local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	Events.setPhase("goldenhour", "warning", now + GoldenHour.WARNING)
	Ledger.toastAll("The sun is turning GOLD... Golden Hour in 5!", GOLD)
	Ledger.cueAll("goldenWarn")
	Mood.set("golden", GoldenHour.WARNING + 1)
	task.wait(GoldenHour.WARNING)

	Events.incomeBoost = GoldenHour.INCOME_BOOST
	Events.goldenBoost = GoldenHour.GOLDEN_BOOST
	Events.setPhase("goldenhour", "active", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + GoldenHour.LASTS)
	Ledger.cueAll("golden")
	Ledger.toastAll("GOLDEN HOUR! Pens pay x" .. GoldenHour.INCOME_BOOST .. " and Golden critters roam the drive!", GOLD)
	local glitter = hangGlitter()
	task.wait(GoldenHour.LASTS)
	glitter:Destroy()
	Events.incomeBoost = 1
	Events.goldenBoost = 1
	Mood.set("normal", 5)
	local goldens = 0
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		for _, record in account.stalls do
			if record.mutation == "Golden" then
				goldens += 1
			end
		end
	end
	Ledger.toastAll(string.format("The golden hour fades. %d Golden critter%s penned on this ranch.", goldens, if goldens == 1 then "" else "s"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 170))
end

Events.register("goldenhour", GoldenHour.startGoldenHour)

return GoldenHour

-- Guide: the first-time trail boss. A new rancher gets four steps, one at a time, each ticked off by
-- doing it: LASSO a critter off the drive, get it HOME to your pens, LOCK your gate, and SURVIVE a
-- ranch event. The HUD shows the current step; finishing the trail pays a bonus and a horseshoe.
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("World"))

local Guide = {}

Guide.STEPS = { "lasso", "home", "lock", "survive" }
Guide.DONE = #Guide.STEPS + 1
Guide.BONUS = 300

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90)

local function advance(account: Ledger.Account)
	account.guideStep += 1
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
	Ledger.cue(account, "guide", account.guideStep)
	if account.guideStep == Guide.DONE then
		Ledger.addCash(account, Guide.BONUS)
		account.luckUntil = math.max(workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), account.luckUntil) + 60
		Ledger.syncRancher(account)
		Ledger.toast(account, "TRAIL COMPLETE! +$" .. Guide.BONUS .. " and a Lucky Horseshoe for 60s. You're a real rancher now!", GOLD)
	end
end

-- Ticks the current step when the matching deed happens. Rustling a critter home counts for the
-- LASSO step too, so a rancher who starts out as a thief isn't stuck on step one.
function Guide.recordDeed(account: Ledger.Account, deed: Ledger.Deed)
	local step = Guide.STEPS[account.guideStep]
	if not step then
		return
	end
	if (step == "lasso" and (deed.kind == "lasso" or deed.kind == "rustle"))
		or (step == "lock" and deed.kind == "lock")
		or (step == "survive" and deed.kind == "survive") then
		advance(account)
	end
end

-- "home" has no deed: it ticks off once you stand inside your own ranch with at least one critter
-- in a stall, checked twice a second.
local function checkHome()
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		if Guide.STEPS[account.guideStep] == "home" and account.plot and Ledger.herdSize(account) > 0 then
			local character = account.player and account.player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if root and World.ranchContains(account.plot, root.Position) then
				advance(account)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- A rancher who already owns a herd (the Showcase, a returning tester) skips what they've done.
function Guide.skipTo(account: Ledger.Account, step: number)
	account.guideStep = math.clamp(step, 1, Guide.DONE)
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
end

function Guide.startGuide()
	Ledger.onDeed(Guide.recordDeed)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			checkHome()
		end
	end)
end

return Guide

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Replicated=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local World=require(script.World)
local Bases=require(script.BaseService)
local Money=require(script.MoneyService)
local Steal=require(script.StealService)
local Shield=require(script.ShieldService)
local Conveyor=require(script.ConveyorService)
local Waves=require(script.WaveService)
local Merchant=require(script.MerchantService)
local remotes=Instance.new("Folder") remotes.Name="BlitzRemotes" remotes.Parent=Replicated
local notice=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") notice.Name="Notice" notice.Parent=remotes
local action=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") action.Name="Action" action.Parent=remotes
local function notify(player,message) notice:FireClient(player,message) end
World.build() Bases.build() Shield.build() Steal.init(notify)
Conveyor.init(notify) Waves.init(notify,workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) Merchant.build(notify)
for _,plot in ipairs(Bases.plots) do
 World.prompt(plot.shieldTerminal,"Activate","SHIELD · 26s active / 48s recharge",function(player)
  if plot.owner==player and Steal.near(player,plot.shieldTerminal) then notify(player,Shield.activate(player)) end
 end)
 World.prompt(plot.upgradeTerminal,"Expand","EXPAND BASE",function(player)
  if plot.owner==player and Steal.near(player,plot.upgradeTerminal) then notify(player,Money.upgrade(player)) end
 end)
end
local function join(player)
 local plot=Bases.claim(player)
 if not plot then player:Kick("All six safehouses are occupied. Please join another server.") return end
 local function character(char)
  Shield.character(player,char)
  local root=char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
  local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
  if root then char:PivotTo(plot.origin*CFrame.new(0,4,6)) end
  if hum then hum.Died:Connect(function() Steal.restore(player) end) end
 end
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(character)
 if player.Character then task.spawn(character,player.Character) end
 Money.join(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(join)
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(join,p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
 Steal.leaving(player) Money.save(player) Bases.free(player)
end)
local lastAction={}
action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,kind)
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-(lastAction[player] or 0)<0.5 then return end
 lastAction[player]=now
 if kind=="Rebirth" then notify(player,Money.rebirth(player)) end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastAction[player]=nil end)
game:BindToClose(function() for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do Money.save(p) end end)
local income,conveyor=0,0
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 income+=dt conveyor+=dt
 while income>=1 do income-=1 Money.income() end
 if conveyor>=1/24 then
  Conveyor.step(conveyor,now) conveyor=0
  Steal.step() Shield.step(now)
 end
 Waves.step(now)
end)

-- Income: the ranch's payday. Once a second every rancher is paid the $/s of every critter standing
-- in their stalls (mutations and rebirths multiplied in, doubled during Golden Hour), the HUD's
-- cash ticks up, and the payday is counted toward "earn" contracts.
local Events = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Events"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))

local Income = {}

Income.PAY_EVERY = 1

-- What one rancher earns this tick, with the running event's boost.
function Income.paydayOf(account: Ledger.Account): number
	return math.floor(Ledger.incomeOf(account) * Events.incomeBoost * Income.PAY_EVERY)
end

-- Pays each player rancher one tick of their pens' income; returns what was paid in all.
function Income.payRanchIncome(): number
	local paid = 0
	for _, account in Ledger.players() do
		local amount = Income.paydayOf(account)
		if amount > 0 then
			Ledger.addCash(account, amount)
			Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "earn", amount = amount })
			paid += amount
		end
		if account.player then
			account.player:SetAttribute("Boost", Events.incomeBoost)
		end
	end
	return paid
end

function Income.startIncomeClock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Income.PAY_EVERY)
			Income.payRanchIncome()
		end
	end)
end

return Income

}
function D.make(id, mutate)
 local roll = mutate and math.random(100) or 100
 local multiplier = roll <= 4 and 3 or (roll <= 19 and 2 or 1)
 local c = D.cast[id]
 return {id=id,mutation=multiplier==3 and "Diamond" or (multiplier==2 and "Gold" or ""),rate=c[4]*multiplier,price=math.floor(c[3]*(1+(multiplier-1)*0.35))}
end
function D.random(mutate)
 local roll, tier = math.random(100), 1
 for i,r in ipairs(D.rarities) do
  roll -= r.weight
  if roll <= 0 then tier=i break end
 end
 local pool={}
 for i,c in ipairs(D.cast) do if c[2]==tier then table.insert(pool,i) end end
 return D.make(pool[math.random(#pool)],mutate)
end
return D

-- Ledger: the one place ranch state lives. Every rancher (a Player or a rival bot) has an account:
-- cash, rebirths, their ranch plot, the critters in their stalls, the gate lock, what they carry,
-- their RanchDex, their contracts, their guide step and any luck charm. Other modules change state
-- only through here; syncRancher pushes it to the attributes the HUD reads, cue() plays a sound on a
-- rancher's client, and deed() tells the contract board, the guide and the dex what just happened.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))

local Ledger = {}

export type CritterRecord = {
	id: string,
	mutation: string?,
	model: Model,
	owner: any?, -- the Account that keeps it, nil while on the Cattle Drive
	stall: number?,
	carrier: Player?,
}

export type Contract = { kind: string, text: string, goal: number, progress: number, reward: string, cash: number }

export type Account = {
	key: string,
	name: string,
	player: Player?,
	isBot: boolean,
	cash: number,
	rebirths: number,
	plot: any?,
	stalls: { [number]: CritterRecord },
	lockedUntil: number,
	carrying: CritterRecord?,
	trampledUntil: number,
	luckUntil: number,
	dex: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } },
	contracts: { Contract },
	guideStep: number,
	earned: number,
}

-- What a deed tells its listeners: lasso, pen, lock, rustle, tag, survive, coin, rebirth, home...
export type Deed = { kind: string, id: string?, mutation: string?, amount: number? }

local accounts: { [string]: Account } = {}
local deedListeners: { (Account, Deed) -> () } = {}
local toastRemote: RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RanchToast") :: RemoteEvent
local cueRemote: RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RanchCue") :: RemoteEvent
local keyOf: (Player | string) -> string

Ledger.LUCK_CHARM = 2 -- a horseshoe counts as two rebirths' worth of luck while it lasts

local function newAccount(key: string, name: string, player: Player?, cash: number, rebirths: number): Account
	return {
		key = key, name = name, player = player, isBot = player == nil,
		cash = cash, rebirths = rebirths, plot = nil, stalls = {},
		lockedUntil = 0, carrying = nil, trampledUntil = 0, luckUntil = 0,
		dex = {}, contracts = {}, guideStep = 1, earned = 0,
	}
end

-- Opens an account with starting cash and a leaderstats board for a joining player.
function Ledger.openAccount(player: Player)
	local account = newAccount(keyOf(player), player.DisplayName, player, Cast.START_CASH, 0)
	accounts[account.key] = account
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local cash = Instance.new("StringValue")
	cash.Name = "Cash"
	cash.Parent = stats
	local rebirths = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirths.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirths.Parent = stats
	local found = Instance.new("StringValue")
	found.Name = "Dex"
	found.Parent = stats
	stats.Parent = player
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
	return account
end

function keyOf(who: Player | string): string
	if typeof(who) == "Instance" then
		return "player:" .. who.UserId
	end
	return "bot:" .. who
end

function Ledger.openBotAccount(name: string, cash: number, rebirths: number): Account
	local account = newAccount(keyOf(name), name, nil, cash, rebirths)
	accounts[account.key] = account
	return account
end

function Ledger.closeAccount(account: Account)
	accounts[account.key] = nil
end

function Ledger.accountOf(player: Player): Account?
	return accounts[keyOf(player)]
end

function Ledger.allAccounts(): { Account }
	local list = {}
	for _, account in accounts do
		table.insert(list, account)
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	return list
end

-- Income a second of everything in the account's stalls (before any event boost).
function Ledger.incomeOf(account: Account): number
	local total = 0
	for _, record in account.stalls do
		total += Cast.incomeOf(record.id, record.mutation, account.rebirths)
	end
	return total
end

-- Luck tilts the Cattle Drive toward rarer rungs: one point a rebirth, more with a horseshoe.
function Ledger.luckOf(account: Account): number
	local charm = if account.luckUntil > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then Ledger.LUCK_CHARM else 0
	return account.rebirths + charm
end

function Ledger.addCash(account: Account, amount: number)
	account.cash += amount
	if amount > 0 then
		account.earned += amount
	end
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
end

function Ledger.spendCash(account: Account, amount: number): boolean
	if account.cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	account.cash -= amount
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
	return true
end

function Ledger.isLocked(account: Account): boolean
	return account.lockedUntil > workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

function Ledger.herdSize(account: Account): number
	local n = 0
	for _ in account.stalls do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- Marks a critter (and its mutation, or "Normal") as found in the account's RanchDex.
-- Returns true when this is the first time this critter or this mutation of it was found.
function Ledger.discover(account: Account, id: string, mutation: string?): boolean
	local entry = account.dex[id]
	local isNew = entry == nil
	if not entry then
		entry = {}
		account.dex[id] = entry
	end
	local key = mutation or "Normal"
	local newMutation = not entry[key]
	entry[key] = true
	return isNew or (mutation ~= nil and newMutation)
end

function Ledger.dexCount(account: Account): number
	local n = 0
	for _ in account.dex do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- Pushes an account to its player's attributes and leaderstats, the only state the client sees.
function Ledger.syncRancher(account: Account)
	local player = account.player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Cash", account.cash)
	player:SetAttribute("Income", Ledger.incomeOf(account))
	player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", account.rebirths)
	player:SetAttribute("RebirthCost", Cast.rebirthCost(account.rebirths))
	player:SetAttribute("Multiplier", Cast.rebirthMultiplier(account.rebirths))
	player:SetAttribute("StallsUsed", Ledger.herdSize(account))
	player:SetAttribute("StallsOpen", Cast.stallsFor(account.rebirths))
	player:SetAttribute("LockedUntil", account.lockedUntil)
	player:SetAttribute("LuckUntil", account.luckUntil)
	player:SetAttribute("Luck", Ledger.luckOf(account))
	player:SetAttribute("GuideStep", account.guideStep)
	player:SetAttribute("Carrying", if account.carrying then Cast.critterById(account.carrying.id).name else "")
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats then
		(stats :: any).Cash.Value = Cast.formatCash(account.cash);
		(stats :: any).Rebirths.Value = account.rebirths;
		(stats :: any).Dex.Value = Ledger.dexCount(account) .. "/" .. #Cast.CRITTERS
	end
end

-- The board and the dex change less often than cash: sent as JSON only when they change.
function Ledger.syncBoard(account: Account)
	local player = account.player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Contracts", HttpService:JSONEncode(account.contracts))
	local dex = {}
	for id, found in account.dex do
		local list = {}
		for key in found do
			table.insert(list, key)
		end
		dex[id] = list
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Dex", HttpService:JSONEncode(dex))
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
end

-- A one-line message on a rancher's screen (bots have no screen).
function Ledger.toast(account: Account?, text: string, color: Color3?)
	if account and account.player then
		toastRemote:FireClient(account.player, text, color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200))
	end
end

function Ledger.toastAll(text: string, color: Color3?)
	toastRemote:FireAllClients(text, color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200))
end

-- A sound (and sometimes a flourish) on one rancher's client: RanchAudio plays the named cue.
function Ledger.cue(account: Account?, name: string, data: any?)
	if account and account.player then
		cueRemote:FireClient(account.player, name, data)
	end
end

function Ledger.cueAll(name: string, data: any?)
	cueRemote:FireAllClients(name, data)
end

-- Something worth counting happened to a rancher: contracts, the guide and the dex listen.
function Ledger.deed(account: Account?, deed: Deed)
	if not account or account.isBot then
		return
	end
	for _, listener in deedListeners do
		task.spawn(listener, account, deed)
	end
end

function Ledger.onDeed(listener: (Account, Deed) -> ())
	table.insert(deedListeners, listener)
end

function Ledger.players(): { Account }
	local list = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local account = Ledger.accountOf(player)
		if account then
			table.insert(list, account)
		end
	end
	return list
end

return Ledger

-- Pens: who owns which ranch, which critter stands in which stall. Claims a ranch for each
-- rancher, flies a lassoed critter on its rope into a free stall (where it settles into an idle
-- sway), hangs a Rustle prompt on every penned critter, stocks the three rival ranches with
-- mutated herds worth rustling, and sends a rancher home when they spawn.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Critters = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Critters"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("World"))

local Pens = {}

local plots: { World.Plot } = {}
local plotOwner: { [number]: Ledger.Account } = {}
-- Ranch claim order (indices into World's plot centres): players start in the middle north ranch
-- and then fill the south row; rival bots take the remaining north ranches and the south middle.
local PLAYER_ORDER = { 1, 5, 6, 2, 4, 3 }
local BOT_ORDER = { 3, 4, 2 }
local addRustlePrompt: (Ledger.CritterRecord) -> ()

-- Set by Rustling: what a Rustle prompt does when another rancher holds it.
Pens.rustleHandler = nil :: ((Player, Ledger.CritterRecord) -> ())?

-- The rival ranchers: each herd shows off a different corner of the cast and a mutation or two,
-- so a walk past the open gates is a preview of what the drive can roll.
local RIVALS = {
	{ name = "Dusty Dolores", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120), rebirths = 1,
		herd = { { "toastallion" }, { "baagel", "Moldy" }, { "jackalope", "Spicy" }, { "cactopus" }, { "llamplighter" }, { "spudmoo", "Golden" } } },
	{ name = "Clem Two-Spurs", color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), rebirths = 2,
		herd = { { "tractortoise" }, { "banjobuzzard" }, { "hamwich", "Golden" }, { "wienerbago", "Crystal" }, { "beanburro" }, { "rattlesnack" }, { "tumbleweasel" } } },
	{ name = "Granny Gristle", color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 160, 255), rebirths = 0,
		herd = { { "haybalehydra" }, { "goatcho", "Ghost" }, { "tumbleweasel" }, { "cluckaroni", "Moldy" }, { "duckwaffle" } } },
}

-- Puts a critter in a stall: it flies there on a lasso arc when `fly` (over `flight` seconds), then
-- settles into its idle sway and earns for its owner.
function Pens.placeCritterInPen(account, record, stall: number, fly: boolean?, flight: number?)
	local plot = account.plot :: World.Plot
	record.owner = account
	record.stall = stall
	record.carrier = nil
	account.stalls[stall] = record
	local model = record.model
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerKey", account.key)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", if account.player then account.player.UserId else 0)
	model:SetAttribute("Stall", stall)
	model.Parent = plot.folder
	local root = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	root.Anchored = true
	local target = plot.stallCFrames[stall]
	if fly then
		local seconds = flight or 1
		local from = root.CFrame
		local apex = CFrame.new(from.Position:Lerp(target.Position, 0.5) + Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)) * target.Rotation * CFrame.Angles(0.5, 0, 0.3)
		local up = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(seconds * 0.56, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CFrame = apex })
		up:Play()
		up.Completed:Wait()
		if record.owner ~= account or record.stall ~= stall then
			return
		end
		local down = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(seconds * 0.44, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = target })
		down:Play()
		down.Completed:Wait()
		Critters.poof(target.Position, Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 140), 16)
	else
		root.CFrame = target
	end
	model:SetAttribute("Gait", "idle")
	Critters.labelCritter(model, record.id, record.mutation, account.rebirths, nil)
	if not model:FindFirstChild("RustlePrompt", true) then
		addRustlePrompt(record)
	end
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
end

function Pens.setup(builtPlots: { World.Plot })
	plots = builtPlots
	for _, plot in plots do
		World.paintStallLocks(plot, Cast.BASE_STALLS)
		World.paintGate(plot, false, 0)
	end
end

function Pens.plots(): { World.Plot }
	return plots
end

-- Paints a ranch's sign, stall locks and gate for whoever owns it now.
function Pens.paintRanch(account: Ledger.Account)
	local plot = account.plot
	if not plot then
		return
	end
	local sign = if account.isBot then string.upper(account.name) else string.upper(account.name) .. "'S RANCH"
	World.paintRanchSign(plot, sign, if account.isBot then Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 170) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 140))
	World.paintStallLocks(plot, Cast.stallsFor(account.rebirths))
end

function Pens.releaseRanch(account: Ledger.Account)
	for stall, record in account.stalls do
		record.model:Destroy()
		account.stalls[stall] = nil
	end
	if account.carrying then
		account.carrying.model:Destroy()
		account.carrying = nil
	end
	local plot = account.plot
	if plot then
		plotOwner[plot.index] = nil
		World.paintRanchSign(plot, "FOR SALE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 235))
		World.paintStallLocks(plot, Cast.BASE_STALLS)
		World.paintGate(plot, false, 0)
	end
	account.plot = nil
end

-- Gives an account the first free ranch; a player evicts a rival bot when every ranch is taken.
function Pens.claimRanch(account: Ledger.Account): World.Plot?
	local order = if account.isBot then BOT_ORDER else PLAYER_ORDER
	for _, index in order do
		if plots[index] and not plotOwner[index] then
			plotOwner[index] = account
			account.plot = plots[index]
			Pens.paintRanch(account)
			return plots[index]
		end
	end
	if not account.isBot then
		for _, index in BOT_ORDER do
			local bot = plotOwner[index]
			if bot and bot.isBot then
				Pens.releaseRanch(bot)
				Ledger.closeAccount(bot)
				return Pens.claimRanch(account)
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Pens.freeStallOf(account: Ledger.Account): number?
	for i = 1, Cast.stallsFor(account.rebirths) do
		if not account.stalls[i] then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Pens.ownerOfPlot(index: number): Ledger.Account?
	return plotOwner[index]
end

-- Which ranch (and owner) a world position is inside, if any.
function Pens.ranchAt(position: Vector3): (World.Plot?, Ledger.Account?)
	for _, plot in plots do
		if World.ranchContains(plot, position) then
			return plot, plotOwner[plot.index]
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- Lifts a critter out of its stall (for a rustler or a rebirth); it stops earning at once.
function Pens.takeCritterFromPen(record: Ledger.CritterRecord): Ledger.Account?
	local owner = record.owner
	if owner and record.stall and owner.stalls[record.stall] == record then
		owner.stalls[record.stall] = nil
		Ledger.syncRancher(owner)
	end
	return owner
end

function addRustlePrompt(record: Ledger.CritterRecord)
	local root = record.model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "RustlePrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Rustle!"
	-- Name the mutation too, the same way the drive's Lasso prompt does, so a Golden one stands out.
	prompt.ObjectText = (if record.mutation then record.mutation .. " " else "") .. Cast.critterById(record.id).name
	prompt.HoldDuration = 1.2
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 11
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute("Rustle", true)
	prompt.Parent = root:FindFirstChild("PromptPoint") or root
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local handler = Pens.rustleHandler
		if handler and record.owner and record.owner.player ~= player then
			handler(player, record)
		end
	end)
end

-- Builds a critter record already standing in an account's stall (rival herds, Showcase stocking):
-- no lasso flight, but a player's stocked critter still lands in their RanchDex.
function Pens.stockCritter(account: Ledger.Account, id: string, mutation: string?, stall: number?): Ledger.CritterRecord?
	local slot = stall or Pens.freeStallOf(account)
	if not slot or not account.plot then
		return nil
	end
	local model = Critters.buildCritter(id, mutation, account.plot.stallCFrames[slot])
	local record: Ledger.CritterRecord = { id = id, mutation = mutation, model = model, owner = nil, stall = nil, carrier = nil }
	Pens.placeCritterInPen(account, record, slot, false)
	if not account.isBot then
		Ledger.discover(account, id, mutation)
		Ledger.syncBoard(account)
	end
	return record
end

-- The three rival ranchers: bots with herds worth rustling and gates that open and close.
function Pens.openRivalRanches()
	for _, rival in RIVALS do
		local account = Ledger.openBotAccount(rival.name, 0, rival.rebirths)
		if Pens.claimRanch(account) then
			for _, entry in rival.herd do
				Pens.stockCritter(account, entry[1], entry[2])
			end
		else
			Ledger.closeAccount(account)
		end
	end
end

-- Puts a character's parts in its ranch's rancher group (so its own locked gate lets it through)
-- and drops it in the middle of its ranch.
function Pens.sendRancherHome(player: Player, character: Model)
	local account = Ledger.accountOf(player)
	if not account or not account.plot then
		return
	end
	local plot = account.plot
	local function group(part: Instance)
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CollisionGroup = plot.rancherGroup
		end
	end
	for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
		group(d)
	end
	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(group)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5) :: BasePart?
	if root then
		task.wait()
		character:PivotTo(plot.cf * CFrame.new(0, 4, 2))
	end
end

function Pens.playerOfRecord(record: Ledger.CritterRecord): Player?
	return record.owner and record.owner.player or nil
end

function Pens.anyPlayer(): Player?
	return Players:GetPlayers()[1]
end

return Pens

-- Small Luau sample used to prove the editor toolchain works.
-- Not part of the game: the real script is src/CoinSpawner.server.luau.
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local function spawnCoin(position: Vector3): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Coin"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace
	return part
end

return spawnCoin

-- Rebirth: trade the whole herd and your cash for a permanent cash multiplier, two more stalls,
-- a longer gate lock and better luck on the Cattle Drive. The price quadruples every time. Your
-- RanchDex and your contract board survive it; the ranch goes up in a golden shockwave.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Cast = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Critters = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Critters"))
local Ledger = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Ledger"))
local Pens = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Pens"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Workshop"):WaitForChild("World"))

local Rebirth = {}

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)

-- A ring of golden light that sweeps out across the ranch from its centre.
local function shockwave(at: CFrame)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide, ring.CanQuery, ring.CanTouch = false, false, false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = GOLD
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 4)
	ring.CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
	ring.Transparency = 0.1
	ring.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 70, 70), Transparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	local beam = Instance.new("Part")
	beam.Anchored = true
	beam.CanCollide, beam.CanQuery, beam.CanTouch = false, false, false
	beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 170)
	beam.Size = Vector3.new(6, 120, 6)
	beam.CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 60, 0)
	beam.Transparency = 0.3
	beam.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(beam, TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 160, 0.2), Transparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(ring, 1.3)
	Debris:AddItem(beam, 1.8)
end

-- Rebirths a player if they can pay: herd released, cash reset, multiplier and stalls raised.
function Rebirth.rebirthRancher(player: Player): boolean
	local account = Ledger.accountOf(player)
	if not account or not account.plot then
		return false
	end
	local cost = Cast.rebirthCost(account.rebirths)
	if account.cash < cost then
		Ledger.toast(account, "Rebirth costs " .. Cast.formatCash(cost) .. " - " .. Cast.formatCash(cost - account.cash) .. " to go. Keep ranching!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80))
		Ledger.cue(account, "deny")
		return false
	end
	if account.carrying then
		Ledger.toast(account, "Put down what you're carrying first!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80))
		Ledger.cue(account, "deny")
		return false
	end
	for stall, record in account.stalls do
		Critters.sparkle((record.model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), GOLD, 14)
		record.model:Destroy()
		account.stalls[stall] = nil
	end
	account.rebirths += 1
	account.cash = Cast.START_CASH
	Pens.paintRanch(account)
	World.paintStallLocks(account.plot, Cast.stallsFor(account.rebirths))
	shockwave(account.plot.cf)
	Critters.sparkle(account.plot.cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), GOLD, 80)
	Ledger.syncRancher(account)
	Ledger.cue(account, "rebirth", account.rebirths)
	Ledger.deed(account, { kind = "rebirth", amount = account.rebirths })
	local mult = Cast.rebirthMultiplier(account.rebirths)
	Ledger.toast(account, string.format("REBIRTH %d! Cash x%.1f forever, %d stalls, rarer critters on the drive.", account.rebirths, mult, Cast.stallsFor(account.rebirths)), GOLD)
	Ledger.toastAll(account.name .. " was REBORN as a x" .. string.format("%.1f", mult) .. " rancher!", GOLD)
	return true
end

return Rebirth

-- RCC source attribution
-- Original file: https://github.com/SirMallard/Iris/blob/main/lib/init.lua
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
