-- Baagel Bleatski: a sesame bagel standing on its edge, with a woolly sheep head on the front.
BUILDERS.sheep = function(ctx, body, accent)
	for i = 0, 11 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 6
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.9, 1.9, 1.9), Vector3.new(0, 3.6 + math.sin(a) * 1.8, math.cos(a) * 1.8), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "blob")
	end
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 3 + 0.3
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.15, 0.35), Vector3.new(0.95, 3.6 + math.sin(a) * 1.8, math.cos(a) * 1.8), WHITE)
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.15, 0.35), Vector3.new(-0.95, 3.6 + math.sin(a + 0.5) * 1.8, math.cos(a + 0.5) * 1.8), WHITE)
	end
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 4.6, -3.2), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric, "blob")
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.3, 1.6, 1), Vector3.new(0, 4.1, -4.1), BLACK)
	for _, x in { -1, 1 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.4, 0.5), Vector3.new(x * 1.2, 4.7, -3.7), BLACK)
	end
	eyes(ctx, 4.5, -4.62, 0.35, 0.35, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	legs(ctx, 0.5, 1.9, 0.6, -1.6, 1.6, BLACK)
end

-- Beanburro: a donkey whose body is a fat burrito, beans and lettuce spilling out of both ends.
BUILDERS.burro = function(ctx, body, accent)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(5.6, 3.2, 3.2), CFrame.new(0, 3.6, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "cyl")
	for i, z in { -2.55, 3.15 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.4, 2.7, 2.7), CFrame.new(0, 3.6, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(110, 60, 40), Enum.Material.Sand, "cyl")
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(0.6, 4.1, z + (if i == 1 then -0.2 else 0.2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 70), Enum.Material.Grass, "cyl")
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.new(-0.7, 3.2, z + (if i == 1 then -0.2 else 0.2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 50), nil, "cyl")
	end
	for _, z in { -1, 0.6, 2.2 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(3.3, 0.25, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 5.15, z), Color3.fromRGB(200, 170, 120), Enum.Material.Sand)
	end
	legs(ctx, 0.7, 2.2, 1.1, -1.4, 2, accent)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.3, 2.4, 1.3), CFrame.new(0, 5.2, -2.6) * CFrame.Angles(0.35, 0, 0), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 2.6), Vector3.new(0, 6.2, -3.4), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric, "blob")
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.4, 1.1, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 5.8, -4.5), Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 185), Enum.Material.Fabric, "blob")
	for _, x in { -0.5, 0.5 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.45, 2.4, 0.35), CFrame.new(x, 7.6, -3) * CFrame.Angles(0.2, 0, x * 0.5), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	end
	googly(ctx, 6.6, -4.2, 0.5, 0.5)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 1.4), CFrame.new(0, 4.4, 3.6) * CFrame.Angles(0.9, 0, 0), BLACK, Enum.Material.Fabric)
end

-- Cactopus Rex: a saguaro octopus with a pink desert flower on its head.
BUILDERS.cactopus = function(ctx, body, accent)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(3.6, 4.4, 3.6), Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0), body, Enum.Material.Grass, "blob")
	for i = 0, 7 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 4
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a))
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(3, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.lookAt(dir * 2.2 + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), dir * 6 + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), body, Enum.Material.Grass, "cyl")
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.75, 1.5, 0.75), CFrame.new(dir * 3.8 + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.3 * math.cos(a)), body, Enum.Material.Grass, "blob")
	end
	for i = 0, 11 do
		local a = i * 0.9
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.6, 0.12), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 1.75, 3.2 + (i % 4) * 0.7, math.sin(a) * 1.75) * CFrame.Angles(0, -a, math.pi / 2), WHITE)
	end
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local a = i * math.pi * 2 / 5
		keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.3, 0.9), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 0.55, 6.5, math.sin(a) * 0.55), accent, nil, "blob"))
	end
	keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 6.65, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80), Enum.Material.Neon, "ball"))
	googly(ctx, 4.8, -1.55, 0.7, 0.8)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1, 0.25, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, 3.7, -1.75), BLACK)
end

-- Goatcho Supremo: a goat bristling with tortilla-chip wedges and dripping cheese.
BUILDERS.goat = function(ctx, body, accent)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(3.4, 2.8, 4.8), Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0), accent, nil, "blob")
	for i = 0, 9 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 5
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.25, 1.8, 1.8), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 1.5, 3.6 + math.sin(a) * 1.3, (i % 3 - 1) * 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(a, 0.3 * i, a), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "wedge")
	end
	for _, x in { -1.2, 0.3, 1.4 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.6, 1.2, 0.6), Vector3.new(x, 2.4, x * 0.8), ORANGE, nil, "blob")
	end
	legs(ctx, 0.6, 2.4, 1, -1.5, 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70))
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.8, 2.4), Vector3.new(0, 5.2, -2.8), Color3.fromRGB(200, 160, 110))
	for _, x in { -1, 1 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.8, 0.4), CFrame.new(x * 0.7, 6.8, -2.4) * CFrame.Angles(-0.5, 0, x * 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 60))
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.35, 1.2, 0.35), CFrame.new(x * 1.1, 7.6, -1.6) * CFrame.Angles(-1.4, 0, x * 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 60))
	end
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.4, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 3.9, -3.9), Color3.fromRGB(250, 240, 210))
	eyes(ctx, 5.6, -4.05, 0.5, 0.4)
end

-- Rattlesnack: a coiled rattlesnake made of soft pretzel, salted, in a tiny cowboy hat.
BUILDERS.snake = function(ctx, body, accent)
	for i = 0, 29 do
		local a = i * 0.55
		local r = 2.4 - i * 0.05
		local y = 0.8 + i * 0.12
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.4, 1.2, 1.4), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, y, math.sin(a) * r + 0.6), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "ball")
		if i % 3 == 0 then
			piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.2, 0.25), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, y + 0.6, math.sin(a) * r + 0.6), accent)
		end
	end
	for j = 1, 4 do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1), Vector3.new(0, 4.4 + j * 0.45, -0.6 - j * 0.35), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "ball")
	end
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.8, 1.2, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 6.6, -2.4), body, Enum.Material.Sand, "blob")
	keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 1), CFrame.new(0, 6.3, -3.8), Color3.fromRGB(230, 40, 50), Enum.Material.Neon))
	googly(ctx, 7, -3.2, 0.5, 0.5)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.8, 0.15, 2.6), Vector3.new(0, 7.3, -2.2), Color3.fromRGB(90, 55, 30))
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.5, 0.9, 1.4), Vector3.new(0, 7.75, -2.2), Color3.fromRGB(90, 55, 30))
	for k = 0, 3 do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.7 - k * 0.1, 0.45, 0.7 - k * 0.1), Vector3.new(2.6, 1.2 + k * 0.45, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(220, 200, 150), Enum.Material.Sand, "blob")
	end
end

-- Tractortoise: a tortoise shell on tractor wheels with a smoking exhaust stack.
BUILDERS.tortoise = function(ctx, body, accent)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(5.2, 3.8, 6.2), Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), body, Enum.Material.Slate, "blob")
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(1.6, 4.2, 1.4), Vector3.new(-1.6, 4.2, -1.4), Vector3.new(1.5, 4.3, -1.6), Vector3.new(-1.5, 4.3, 1.5) } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.4, 0.5, 1.4), spot, Color3.fromRGB(40, 100, 45), Enum.Material.Slate, "blob")
	end
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(5.6, 0.7, 6.6), Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 40))
	for _, x in { -2.9, 2.9 } do
		for _, z in { -2, 2 } do
			local big = z > 0
			local d = if big then 3.4 else 2.4
			piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1, d, d), Vector3.new(x, d / 2, z), accent, Enum.Material.Rubber, "cyl")
			piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.1, d * 0.45, d * 0.45), Vector3.new(x, d / 2, z), Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 40), nil, "cyl")
		end
	end
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.7, 1.5, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 2.3, -3.8), Color3.fromRGB(130, 160, 80), nil, "blob")
	eyes(ctx, 2.7, -4.8, 0.4, 0.35)
	local stack = piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.5, 2.6, 0.5), Vector3.new(1.3, 6, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), Enum.Material.Metal)
	local smoke = emitter(stack, SMOKE, Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90), 4, 1.4, 3)
	smoke.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, 10)
	smoke.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
end

-- Haybale Hydra: a square hay bale with three green serpent necks, one chewing a straw.

	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(6, 3.6, 4.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.9, 0.6), body, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	for _, x in { -1.6, 1.6 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.25, 3.7, 4.5), Vector3.new(x, 1.9, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	end
	for i = 0, 9 do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.1, 0.6, 0.1), CFrame.new(-2.6 + i * 0.6, 3.9, -1.5 + (i % 3)) * CFrame.Angles(0.4, 0, (i % 2 - 0.5)), Color3.fromRGB(240, 210, 120), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	end
	for k = -1, 1 do
		local lean = k * 0.8
		local tall = if k == 0 then 1.25 else 1
		for j = 1, 6 do
			piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3.new(k * 1.6 + lean * j * 0.35, 3.6 + j * 0.85 * tall, 0.2 - j * 0.3), accent, Enum.Material.Grass, "ball")

		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.2, 2.2), head, accent, Enum.Material.Grass, "blob")
		googly(ctx, head.Y + 0.45, head.Z - 0.6, 0.45, 0.45)
		if k == 0 then
			piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 2), CFrame.new(head + Vector3.new(0.5, -0.3, -1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(240, 210, 120))

	for i = 0, 9 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 5
		keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 3.7, 4.8, math.sin(a) * 3.7), if i % 2 == 0 then accent else Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120), Enum.Material.Neon, "ball"))
	end
	-- the pilot, under a glass dome
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.6, 1.8, 2.4), Vector3.new(0, 6.3, 0.3), WHITE, nil, "blob")
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.8, 1.6, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 7.1, -0.7), WHITE)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.7, 0.5, 0.6), Vector3.new(0.5, 7.5, -0.6), BLACK)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(1.4, 0.7, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 6.7, -1.5), PINK)
	eyes(ctx, 7.4, -1.5, 0.45, 0.35)
	for _, x in { -0.6, 0.6 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.8, 0.3), Vector3.new(x, 8.1, -0.6), WHITE)
	end
	local dome = keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(4.4, 4.4, 4.4), Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(180, 240, 255), Enum.Material.Glass, "ball"))
	dome.Transparency = 0.6
	glow(beam, accent, 16, 2.5)
end

-- A rot bull: the Grand Rotfather wears a crown; the stampede's bulls do not.
local function bullBody(ctx: Ctx, body: Color3, accent: Color3, crowned: boolean)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(5, 4, 7), Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0.4), body, Enum.Material.Slate, "blob")
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(4.4, 3, 3.6), Vector3.new(0, 5.6, -1.8), body, Enum.Material.Slate, "blob")
	legs(ctx, 1.2, 2.6, 1.5, -2.2, 2.4, Color3.fromRGB(40, 30, 26))
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(3, 2.7, 2.8), Vector3.new(0, 4.9, -4.3), body, Enum.Material.Slate)
	piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.4, 1.3, 0.8), Vector3.new(0, 4.1, -5.7), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 70))
	for _, x in { -1, 1 } do
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.6, 0.6, 0.6), Vector3.new(x * 2.6, 6, -4.3), WHITE)
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.6, 1.6, 0.6), Vector3.new(x * 3.6, 6.9, -4.3), WHITE)
	end
	eyes(ctx, 5.6, -5.75, 0.8, 0.6, accent)
	keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.9), Vector3.new(0, 3.5, -6.1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40), Enum.Material.Metal, "cyl"))
	if crowned then
		keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(2.6, 0.8, 2.4), Vector3.new(0, 6.7, -4.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), Enum.Material.Foil))
		for _, x in { -1, 0, 1 } do
			keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.2, 0.5), CFrame.new(x * 0.9, 7.6, -4.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), Enum.Material.Foil))
		end
	end
	for _, drip in { Vector3.new(2.2, 3, -1), Vector3.new(-2.3, 3.6, 1.5), Vector3.new(0.8, 2.4, 3) } do
		keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7), drip, accent, Enum.Material.Neon, "blob"))
	end
	local fumes = emitter(ctx.root, SMOKE, accent, 6, 2, 2)
	fumes.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.5, 1)
end

BUILDERS.bull = function(ctx, body, accent)
	bullBody(ctx, body, accent, true)
end

-- Skelecow Supreme: a cow skeleton in a sheriff's hat, a purple soul-heart glowing in its ribs.

-- The finishes: each mutation is obvious from across the ranch, even in a screenshot.
local MUTATION_FX: { [string]: (Ctx, Color3) -> () } = {}

MUTATION_FX.Golden = function(ctx, tint)
	for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, 0.8)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
			p.Reflectance = 0.25
		end
	end
	emitter(ctx.body, SPARKLES, tint, 8, 0.6 * ctx.scale, 3)
	glow(ctx.body, tint, 12 * ctx.scale, 1.5)
end

MUTATION_FX.Moldy = function(ctx, tint)
	for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, 0.5)
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local a = i * 1.7
		piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.5, 0.9), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 1.6, 3 + (i % 3) * 0.8, math.sin(a) * 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 90), Enum.Material.Grass, "blob")
	end
	emitter(ctx.body, SMOKE, tint, 6, 1.4 * ctx.scale, 2)
end

MUTATION_FX.Spicy = function(ctx, tint)
	for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, 0.45)
		end
	end
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40)
	fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 20)
	fire.Size = 5 * ctx.scale
	fire.Heat = 12
	fire.Parent = ctx.body
	local embers = emitter(ctx.body, EMBERS, Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60), 16, 0.4 * ctx.scale, 6)
	embers.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	glow(ctx.body, tint, 14 * ctx.scale, 2.5)
end

MUTATION_FX.Crystal = function(ctx, tint)
	for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, 0.65)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
			p.Transparency = math.max(p.Transparency, 0.2)
			p.Reflectance = 0.35
		end
	end
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local a = i * 1.25
		keep(piece(ctx, Vector3.new(0.6, 2.2, 0.6), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 1.2, 5.4 + (i % 2) * 0.5, math.sin(a) * 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(0.3 * math.cos(a), a, 0.3 * math.sin(a)), Color3.fromRGB(200, 245, 255), Enum.Material.Neon))
	end
	emitter(ctx.body, SPARKLES, Color3.fromRGB(220, 250, 255), 12, 0.7 * ctx.scale, 4)
	glow(ctx.body, tint, 16 * ctx.scale, 3)
end

MUTATION_FX.Ghost = function(ctx, tint)
	for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, 0.75)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			p.Transparency = 0
		end
	end
	local wisps = emitter(ctx.body, GLOW, tint, 10, 1.6 * ctx.scale, 2)
	wisps.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	wisps.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
	wisps.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	glow(ctx.body, tint, 18 * ctx.scale, 2)
end

local function applyMutation(ctx: Ctx, mutation: string?)
	local tint = Cast.mutationTint(mutation)
	local fx = mutation and MUTATION_FX[mutation]
	if tint and fx then
		fx(ctx, tint)
	end
end

-- A model with an invisible anchored Root on the ground and a Body on a Motor6D ("Gait") above it.
local function newCtx(name: string, scale: number, at: CFrame): Ctx
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "Root"
	root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 2) * scale
	root.CFrame = at
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.CanTouch = false
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = Vector3.one * 0.2
	body.CFrame = at
	body.Anchored = false
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.CanTouch = false
	body.CanQuery = false
	body.Massless = true
	body.Transparency = 1
	body.Parent = model
	local gait = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	gait.Name = "Gait"
	gait.Part0, gait.Part1 = root, body
	gait.Parent = root
	return { model = model, root = root, body = body, scale = scale }
end

function Critters.heightOf(id: string): number
	local critter = Cast.critterById(id)
	return HEIGHTS[critter.shape] * Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity].scale
end

-- Builds a critter model of a cast id and mutation at a ground-level CFrame (it faces -Z).
function Critters.buildCritter(id: string, mutation: string?, at: CFrame): Model
	local critter = Cast.critterById(id)
	local ctx = newCtx(critter.name, Cast.RARITIES[critter.rarity].scale, at)
	BUILDERS[critter.shape](ctx, critter.body, critter.accent)
	applyMutation(ctx, mutation)
	ctx.model:SetAttribute("CritterId", id)
	ctx.model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation or "")
	ctx.model:SetAttribute("Gait", "trot")
	local point = Instance.new("Attachment")
	point.Name = "PromptPoint"
	point.Position = Vector3.new(0, Critters.heightOf(id) * 0.5, 0)
	point.Parent = ctx.root
	CollectionService:AddTag(ctx.model, "Critter")
	return ctx.model
end

-- A RanchDex portrait: the same critter, or an all-black silhouette when it is still undiscovered.
function Critters.buildPortrait(id: string, mutation: string?, silhouette: boolean): Model
	local critter = Cast.critterById(id)
	local ctx = newCtx(critter.name, 1, CFrame.new())
	BUILDERS[critter.shape](ctx, critter.body, critter.accent)
	if silhouette then
		for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 20, 16)
				p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				p.Reflectance = 0
			end
		end
	elseif mutation then
		-- ViewportFrames draw neither ForceField nor reflections, so a portrait gets a plain tint.
		local tint = Cast.mutationTint(mutation) :: Color3
		for _, p in ctx.model:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= ctx.root and p ~= ctx.body and not p:GetAttribute("Keep") then
				p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(tint, if mutation == "Moldy" then 0.45 else 0.65)
				if mutation == "Crystal" or mutation == "Ghost" then
					p.Transparency = math.max(p.Transparency, if mutation == "Ghost" then 0.35 else 0.2)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return ctx.model
end

-- A charging bull for the stampede: big, dark, glowing-eyed, no crown.
function Critters.buildRotbull(at: CFrame): Model
	local ctx = newCtx("Rotbull", 1.9, at)
	bullBody(ctx, Color3.fromRGB(80, 56, 44), Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 70), false)
	return ctx.model
end

-- A masked rustler: denim, a vest, a bandana and a black hat, built from parts on a moving root.
function Critters.buildRustler(at: CFrame): (Model, BasePart)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Rustler"
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "Root"
	root.Size = Vector3.new(3, 6, 2)
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.CanTouch = true
	root.CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	local function limb(size: Vector3, offset: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, ball: boolean?)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		if ball then
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		end
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.Massless = true
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = root, p
		weld.Parent = p
		p.Parent = model
	end
	local denim, vest, skin = Color3.fromRGB(50, 70, 120), Color3.fromRGB(90, 55, 30), Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 140)
	limb(Vector3.new(0.9, 2.8, 0.9), Vector3.new(-0.5, -1.6, 0), denim, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(0.9, 2.8, 0.9), Vector3.new(0.5, -1.6, 0), denim, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(1, 0.6, 1.4), Vector3.new(-0.5, -2.9, -0.2), Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 20))
	limb(Vector3.new(1, 0.6, 1.4), Vector3.new(0.5, -2.9, -0.2), Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 20))
	limb(Vector3.new(2.2, 2.4, 1.1), Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), vest, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(0.8, 2.2, 0.8), Vector3.new(-1.5, 0.9, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 50), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(0.8, 2.2, 0.8), Vector3.new(1.5, 0.9, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 50), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0), skin, nil, true)
	limb(Vector3.new(1.6, 0.6, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	limb(Vector3.new(3, 0.2, 3), Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(25, 20, 18))
	limb(Vector3.new(1.6, 1, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(25, 20, 18))
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(9, 2.4)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "RUSTLER!"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 80)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = root
	return model, root
end

-- The floating label: name, rarity (and mutation with its multiplier), money a second, and the
-- price while the critter is still on the drive.
function Critters.labelCritter(model: Model, id: string, mutation: string?, rebirths: number, price: number?)
	local old = model:FindFirstChild("CritterLabel")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local critter = Cast.critterById(id)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "CritterLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model.PrimaryPart
	-- Studs plus a few pixels: big up close, still legible across the ranch.
	gui.Size = if price then UDim2.new(7, 40, 4, 22) else UDim2.new(6, 52, 3, 28)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, Critters.heightOf(id) + (if price then 3.4 else 2.6), 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.MaxDistance = if price then 110 else 150
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent = gui
	local function line(order: number, text: string, color: Color3, height: number, font: Enum.Font?)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.LayoutOrder = order
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, height)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = color
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = font or Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		label.Parent = gui
		return label
	end
	local total = if price then 5.6 else 4.4
	line(1, critter.name, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1.5 / total, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy)
	local tag = Cast.rarityLabel(critter.rarity)
	if mutation then
		tag = string.upper(mutation) .. " x" .. Cast.mutationMult(mutation) .. "  " .. tag
	end
	line(2, tag, Cast.mutationTint(mutation) or Cast.rarityColor(critter.rarity), 1.2 / total, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy)
	line(3, Cast.formatCash(Cast.incomeOf(id, mutation, rebirths)) .. "/s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 110), 1.2 / total, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy)
	if price then
		local tagLabel = line(4, Cast.formatCash(price), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 80), 1.6 / total, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy)
		tagLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
		tagLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 30, 15)
	end
	gui.Parent = model
end

-- The lasso: a rope from the rancher's hand to a loop around the critter, left up while it flies
-- home. Returns a cleanup function.
function Critters.throwLasso(hand: BasePart, model: Model): () -> ()
	local root = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local height = Critters.heightOf(model:GetAttribute("CritterId") :: string)
	local rope = Instance.new("Folder")
	rope.Name = "LassoRope"
	local from = Instance.new("Attachment")
	from.Name = "LassoHand"
	from.Parent = hand
	local loopCenter = Instance.new("Attachment")
	loopCenter.Name = "LassoLoop"
	loopCenter.Position = Vector3.new(0, height * 0.55, 0)
	loopCenter.Parent = root
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = from, loopCenter
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(225, 175, 105))
	beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 0.7, 0.6
	beam.Segments = 24
	beam.CurveSize0, beam.CurveSize1 = 6, -3
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightInfluence = 0.2
	beam.LightEmission = 0.15
	beam.Parent = rope
	-- the loop: a ring of rope segments around the critter's middle
	local radius = math.max(2.2, height * 0.32)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 0, 13 do
		local a = i * math.pi * 2 / 14
		local seg = Instance.new("Part")
		seg.Name = "LoopSegment"
		seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, radius * 0.5)
		seg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 175, 105)
		seg.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
		seg.CanCollide, seg.CanQuery, seg.CanTouch, seg.Massless = false, false, false, true
		seg.Anchored = false
		seg.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, height * 0.55, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.new(radius, 0, 0)
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = root, seg
		weld.Parent = seg
		seg.Parent = model
		table.insert(parts, seg)
	end
	rope.Parent = hand
	return function()
		rope:Destroy()
		from:Destroy()
		loopCenter:Destroy()
		for _, seg in parts do
			seg:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

-- A burst of dust or sparkle where a critter appears or vanishes.
function Critters.poof(position: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number?, texture: string?)
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Size = Vector3.one
	anchor.Position = position
	local burst = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	burst.Texture = texture or SMOKE
	burst.Rate = 0
	burst.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
	burst.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12)
	burst.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	burst.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.5, 4)
	burst.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	burst.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	burst.LightEmission = if texture then 0.8 else 0
	burst.Parent = anchor
	anchor.Parent = workspace
	burst:Emit(count or 24)
	Debris:AddItem(anchor, 2)
end

-- A bright sparkle shower (mutated lasso, rebirth, contracts).
function Critters.sparkle(position: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number?)
	Critters.poof(position, color, count, SPARKLES)
end

return Critters

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    local AnyMenuOpen = false
    local ActiveMenu: Types.Menu? = nil
    local MenuStack: { Types.Menu } = {}

    local function EmptyMenuStack(menuIndex: number?)
        for index = #MenuStack, menuIndex and menuIndex + 1 or 1, -1 do
            local widget = MenuStack[index]
            widget.state.isOpened:set(false)

            widget.Instance.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.HeaderColor
            widget.Instance.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            table.remove(MenuStack, index)
        end

        if #MenuStack == 0 then
            AnyMenuOpen = false
            ActiveMenu = nil
        end
    end

    local function UpdateChildContainerTransform(thisWidget: Types.Menu)
        local submenu = thisWidget.parentWidget.type == "Menu"

        local Menu = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
        local ChildContainer = thisWidget.ChildContainer :: ScrollingFrame
        ChildContainer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Menu.AbsoluteSize.X, 0)
        if ChildContainer.Parent == nil then
            return
        end

        local menuPosition = Menu.AbsolutePosition - widgets.GuiOffset
        local menuSize = Menu.AbsoluteSize
        local containerSize = ChildContainer.AbsoluteSize
        local borderSize = Iris._config.PopupBorderSize
        local screenSize: Vector2 = ChildContainer.Parent.AbsoluteSize

        local x = menuPosition.X
        local y
        local anchor = Vector2.zero

        if submenu then
            if menuPosition.X + containerSize.X > screenSize.X then
                anchor = Vector2.xAxis
            else
                x = menuPosition.X + menuSize.X
            end
        end

        if menuPosition.Y + containerSize.Y > screenSize.Y then
            -- too low.
            y = menuPosition.Y - borderSize + (submenu and menuSize.Y or 0)
            anchor += Vector2.yAxis
        else
            y = menuPosition.Y + borderSize + (submenu and 0 or menuSize.Y)
        end

        ChildContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        ChildContainer.AnchorPoint = anchor
    end

    widgets.registerEvent("InputBegan", function(inputObject: InputObject)
        if not Iris._started then
            return
        end
        if inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
            return
        end
        if AnyMenuOpen == false then
            return
        end
        if ActiveMenu == nil then
            return
        end

        -- this only checks if we clicked outside all the menus. If we clicked in any menu, then the hover function handles this.
        local isInMenu = false
        local MouseLocation = widgets.getMouseLocation()
        for _, menu in MenuStack do
            for _, container in { menu.ChildContainer, menu.Instance } do
                local rectMin = container.AbsolutePosition - widgets.GuiOffset
                local rectMax = rectMin + container.AbsoluteSize
                if widgets.isPosInsideRect(MouseLocation, rectMin, rectMax) then
                    isInMenu = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if isInMenu then
                break
            end
        end

        if not isInMenu then
            EmptyMenuStack()
        end
    end)

    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("MenuBar", {
        hasState = false,
        hasChildren = true,
        Args = {},
        Events = {},
        Generate = function(_thisWidget: Types.MenuBar)

        end,

        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.MenuBar, _thisChild: Types.Widget)
            return thisWidget.Instance

    } :: Types.WidgetClass)

    Iris.WidgetConstructor("Menu", {

                local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                TextLabel.Name = "TextLabel"
                TextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
                TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0

                widgets.applyTextStyle(TextLabel)

                TextLabel.Parent = Menu

                local frameSize = Iris._config.TextSize + 2 * Iris._config.FramePadding.Y
                local padding = math.round(0.2 * frameSize)

                widgets.applyTextStyle(Menu)

            end
            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", Menu, Menu, thisWidget.ButtonColors)

            widgets.applyButtonClick(Menu, function()
                local openMenu = if #MenuStack <= 1 then not thisWidget.state.isOpened.value else true
                thisWidget.state.isOpened:set(openMenu)

                AnyMenuOpen = openMenu
                ActiveMenu = openMenu and thisWidget or nil
                -- the hovering should handle all of the menus after the first one.
                if #MenuStack <= 1 then
                    if openMenu then

                    else
                        table.remove(MenuStack)
                    end
                end
            end)

            widgets.applyMouseEnter(Menu, function()
                if AnyMenuOpen and ActiveMenu and ActiveMenu ~= thisWidget then

                    local parentIndex = table.find(MenuStack, parentMenu)

                    thisWidget.state.isOpened:set(true)

                end
            end)

            local ChildContainer = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
            ChildContainer.Name = "MenuContainer"
            ChildContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            ChildContainer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            ChildContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PopupBgColor
            ChildContainer.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PopupBgTransparency
            ChildContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0

            ChildContainer.ZIndex = 6
            ChildContainer.LayoutOrder = 6
            ChildContainer.ClipsDescendants = true

            -- Unfortunatley, ScrollingFrame does not work with UICorner
            -- if Iris._config.PopupRounding > 0 then
            --     widgets.UICorner(ChildContainer, Iris._config.PopupRounding)
            -- end

            widgets.UIStroke(ChildContainer, Iris._config.WindowBorderSize, Iris._config.BorderColor, Iris._config.BorderTransparency)
            widgets.UIPadding(ChildContainer, Vector2.new(2, Iris._config.WindowPadding.Y - Iris._config.ItemSpacing.Y))
            
            widgets.UIListLayout(ChildContainer, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new(0, 1)).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top

            local RootPopupScreenGui = Iris._rootInstance and Iris._rootInstance:FindFirstChild("PopupScreenGui") :: GuiObject
            ChildContainer.Parent = RootPopupScreenGui
            
            
            thisWidget.ChildContainer = ChildContainer
            return Menu
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.Menu)
            local Menu = thisWidget.Instance :: TextButton
            local TextLabel: TextLabel
            if thisWidget.parentWidget.type == "Menu" then
                TextLabel = Menu.TextLabel
            else
                TextLabel = Menu
            end
            TextLabel.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Text or "Menu"
        end,
        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.Menu, _thisChild: Types.Widget)
            UpdateChildContainerTransform(thisWidget)
            return thisWidget.ChildContainer
        end,
        ChildDiscarded = function(thisWidget: Types.Menu, _thisChild: Types.Widget)
            UpdateChildContainerTransform(thisWidget)
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Menu)
            if thisWidget.state.isOpened == nil then
                thisWidget.state.isOpened = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "isOpened", false)
            end
        end,
        UpdateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Menu)
            local ChildContainer = thisWidget.ChildContainer :: ScrollingFrame

            if thisWidget.state.isOpened.value then
                thisWidget.lastOpenedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
                thisWidget.ButtonColors.Transparency = Iris._config.HeaderTransparency
                ChildContainer.Visible = true

                    if #MenuStack ~= 0 then

                        AnyMenuOpen = true
                    end
                end
            end

        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)

--[[
	The whole interface and its logic, independent of where it is shown.

	App.mount(host) builds the panel inside `host` (the plugin's dock widget, or any
	GUI container — that is how we look at the interface in tests) and returns a
	controller with the same actions the buttons have.

	- click a finding  -> opens the script at that line
	- "Fix"            -> applies the safe replacement for one finding
	- "Fix N safe"     -> asks once more, then applies every safe replacement in the place
	- "Undo fixes"     -> puts back the text replaced by the last fix (press again for the
	                      one before); kept in memory until Studio closes

	All analysis lives in Core/Checker (pure Luau, tested outside Studio).
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")

local Checker = require(script.Parent.Core.Checker)

local App = {}

export type Options = {
	-- the Plugin object, when running as a plugin (only used as a fallback to open scripts)
	plugin: any?,
	-- instances to scan instead of the usual services (tests)
	roots: { Instance }?,
}

export type Controller = {
	scan: () -> (),
	fixAll: () -> (),
	undoFixes: () -> (),
	fixOneAt: (LuaSourceContainer, number) -> (),
	destroy: () -> (),
}

local APP_NAME = "Script Doctor"
local MAX_ROWS = 300
-- how many fix steps "Undo fixes" can take back
local MAX_UNDO_STEPS = 20
-- how long "Fix N safe" waits for the confirming second click, and how soon it may come:
-- a quick double click is one gesture, not a confirmation
local CONFIRM_SECONDS = 6
local CONFIRM_MIN_SECONDS = 1

-- Every service of the place is scanned (backdoors hide in Chat, TextChatService and other
-- odd places), except these: Roblox's own code and plugin internals, not the game's.
local SKIPPED_SERVICES = {
	CoreGui = true,
	CorePackages = true,
	RobloxReplicatedStorage = true,
	RobloxPluginGuiService = true,
	PluginGuiService = true,
	PluginDebugService = true,
}

-- Containers whose ModuleScripts run on the client.
local CLIENT_CONTAINERS = {
	"StarterPlayerScripts",
	"StarterCharacterScripts",
	"StarterGui",
	"StarterPack",
	"ReplicatedFirst",
}
local SERVER_CONTAINERS = { "ServerScriptService", "ServerStorage" }

local SEVERITIES = {
	{ id = "security", label = "Security", color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 69, 69) },
	{ id = "bug", label = "Bugs", color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 126, 36) },
	{ id = "deprecated", label = "Deprecated", color = Color3.fromRGB(163, 137, 26) },
	{ id = "advice", label = "Advice", color = Color3.fromRGB(74, 124, 186) },
}
local SEVERITY_ORDER = {}
local SEVERITY_COLOR = {}
for order, severity in SEVERITIES do
	SEVERITY_ORDER[severity.id] = order
	SEVERITY_COLOR[severity.id] = severity.color
end

local PRIMARY = Color3.fromRGB(0, 116, 204)
local SUCCESS = Color3.fromRGB(46, 140, 82)
local WARNING = Color3.fromRGB(176, 106, 20)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

type Result = { script: LuaSourceContainer, finding: Checker.Finding }
type Change = { script: LuaSourceContainer, before: string, after: string, count: number, fixes: { Checker.Fix } }

local function themeColor(style: Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor, fallback: Color3): Color3
	local ok, color = pcall(function()
		return settings().Studio.Theme:GetColor(style)
	end)
	return if ok then color else fallback
end

local function create(className: string, properties: { [string]: any }, children: { Instance }?): any
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in properties do
		instance[key] = value
	end
	if children then
		for _, child in children do
			child.Parent = instance
		end
	end
	return instance
end

local function corner(radius: number): UICorner
	return create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
end

local function padding(horizontal: number, vertical: number): UIPadding
	return create("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, horizontal),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, horizontal),
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, vertical),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, vertical),
	})
end

-- "client" / "server" from the script class, and for a ModuleScript from where it lives;
-- nil for a ModuleScript in a shared place (ReplicatedStorage), the checker then guesses.
local function scriptKindOf(container: LuaSourceContainer): string?
	if container:IsA("LocalScript") then
		return "client"
	elseif container:IsA("Script") then
		return if (container :: Script).RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then "client" else "server"
	end
	for _, className in CLIENT_CONTAINERS do
		if container:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(className) then
			return "client"
		end
	end
	for _, className in SERVER_CONTAINERS do
		if container:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(className) then
			return "server"
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function readSource(container: LuaSourceContainer): string?
	local ok, source = pcall(function()
		return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(container)
	end)
	return if ok then source else nil
end

-- Changes the text of a script from `source` to `newSource`; `fixes` are the edits that make
-- that change (in apply order, end of text first).
--
-- A script open in the editor gets each edit applied on its own, so the cursor and the scroll
-- position stay where they are (replacing the whole text makes the editor jump to the last
-- line). A closed script is changed through Source.
local function writeChange(
	container: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string,
	newSource: string,
	fixes: { Checker.Fix }
): boolean
	local document = nil
	pcall(function()
		document = ScriptEditorService:FindScriptDocument(container)
	end)
	if not document then
		-- a closed script: UpdateSourceAsync is the way Roblox asks plugins to change scripts
		-- (it keeps Team Create collaborative editing in sync); no cursor to keep here
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(container, function(current: string): string?
				-- changed by someone since we read it: leave it alone
				return if current == source then newSource else nil
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return readSource(container) == newSource
		end
		-- the API refused: write Source directly, but only over the text we read
		if readSource(container) == source then
			ok, message = pcall(function()
				(container :: any).Source = newSource
			end)
		end
		if not ok then
			warn(`[{APP_NAME}] could not change {container:GetFullName()}: {message}`)
		end
		return ok and readSource(container) == newSource
	end

	local selection = { pcall(document.GetSelection, document) }
	pcall(function()
		for _, fix in fixes do
			local startLine, startCol = Checker.position(source, fix.from)
			local endLine, endCol = Checker.position(source, fix.to + 1)
			document:EditTextAsync(fix.text, startLine, startCol, endLine, endCol)
		end
	end)
	if readSource(container) ~= newSource then
		-- the edits did not land as expected: set the whole text instead
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(container, function()
				return newSource
			end)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(`[{APP_NAME}] could not change {container:GetFullName()}: {message}`)
			return false
		end
	end
	-- put the cursor back where the user had it
	if selection[1] and typeof(selection[2]) == "number" and typeof(selection[3]) == "number" then
		pcall(function()
			document:RequestSetSelectionAsync(selection[2], selection[3])
		end)
	end
	return true
end

local function plural(count: number, word: string): string
	return `{count} {word}{if count == 1 then "" else "s"}`
end

function App.mount(host: Instance, options: Options?): Controller
	local pluginObject = options and options.plugin
	local customRoots = options and options.roots

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- State
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	local results: { Result } = {}
	local scannedScripts = 0
	local hasScanned = false
	-- a scan, fix or undo is running; every other action waits for it to finish (an edit of an
	-- open script yields, and a second click would otherwise fix half-changed text)
	local busy = false
	local progress: string? = nil
	local enabledSeverity = { security = true, bug = true, deprecated = true, advice = true }
	-- Studio's own undo (Ctrl+Z) does not bring back script text changed by a plugin, so we
	-- remember the text we replaced and offer our own "Undo fixes", one step per press.
	local undoSteps: { { Change } } = {}
	-- method names defined by any script of the place (see Checker.definedMembers), and a
	-- cache of them per script so a scan after a fix does not parse every script again
	local knownMembers: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local memberCache: { [LuaSourceContainer]: { source: string, members: { [string]: boolean } } } = setmetatable(
		{},
		{ __mode = "k" }
	) :: any
	-- what the last fix or undo did, shown in the banner until the next scan
	local notice: string? = nil
	local noticeColor = SUCCESS
	-- "Fix N safe" was clicked once at confirmFrom; a second click after
	-- confirmFrom + CONFIRM_MIN_SECONDS and before confirmUntil applies the fixes
	local confirmFrom = 0
	local confirmUntil = 0
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	local destroyed = false

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Layout
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	local root = create("Frame", {
		Name = "ScriptDoctor",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = host,
	})

	local header = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Header",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = root,
	}, {
		padding(12, 12),
		create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
	})

	local buttonRow = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Buttons",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Parent = header,
	}, {
		create("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Wraps = true,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}),
	})

	local function makeButton(name: string, label: string, order: number): (TextButton, UIStroke)
		local stroke = create("UIStroke", { ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Thickness = 1 })
		local button = create("TextButton", {
			Name = name,
			Text = label,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,
			TextSize = 15,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32),
			AutoButtonColor = true,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Parent = buttonRow,
		}, { corner(6), padding(14, 0), stroke })
		return button, stroke
	end

	local scanButton, scanStroke = makeButton("Scan", "Scan place", 1)
	local fixAllButton, fixAllStroke = makeButton("FixAll", "Fix safe issues", 2)
	local undoButton, undoStroke = makeButton("Undo", "Undo fixes", 3)
	fixAllButton.Visible = false
	undoButton.Visible = false

	local noticeLabel = create("TextLabel", {
		Name = "Notice",
		Text = "",
		Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = SUCCESS,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Visible = false,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Parent = header,
	}, { corner(6), padding(10, 8) })

	local statusLabel = create("TextLabel", {
		Name = "Status",
		Text = "",
		Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Parent = header,
	})

	local filterRow = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Filters",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 4,

	}, {
		create("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,

		Name = "List",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 8,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		Parent = root,
	}, {
		padding(12, 4),
		create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
	})

	local function layoutList()
		local top = header.AbsoluteSize.Y
		list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top)
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top)
	end
	table.insert(connections, header:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layoutList))
	layoutList()

	local filterButtons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
	local render: () -> ()

	-- Fixes change the scripts of this DataModel. During a test (Play / Run) that is a copy
	-- thrown away on Stop, so fixing is switched off there.
	local function canEdit(): boolean
		local ok, isEdit = pcall(function()
			return RunService:IsEdit()
		end)
		return not ok or isEdit
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Scanning and fixing
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	local function collectScripts(): { LuaSourceContainer }
		local scripts = {}
		local roots: { Instance } = {}
		if customRoots then
			roots = customRoots
		else
			for _, service in game:GetChildren() do
				if not SKIPPED_SERVICES[service.ClassName] then
					table.insert(roots, service)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, scanRoot in roots do
			-- some services refuse plugins; skip them instead of stopping the scan
			local ok, descendants = pcall(scanRoot.GetDescendants, scanRoot)
			if not ok then
				continue
			end
			for _, descendant in descendants do
				if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
					table.insert(scripts, descendant)
				end
			end
		end
		return scripts
	end

	local function checkOptions(container: LuaSourceContainer): Checker.Options
		return { scriptKind = scriptKindOf(container), knownMembers = knownMembers }
	end

	local function setProgress(text: string?)
		progress = text
		if text then
			statusLabel.Text = text
		end
	end

	local function runScan()
		local scripts = collectScripts()
		-- 1. the method names every script defines, so that a `:destroy()` on a class from
		--    another ModuleScript is not offered for renaming
		local sources: { [LuaSourceContainer]: string } = {}
		local members: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for index, container in scripts do
			local source = readSource(container)
			if source then
				sources[container] = source
				local cached = memberCache[container]
				if not cached or cached.source ~= source then
					local ok, defined = pcall(Checker.definedMembers, source)
					cached = { source = source, members = if ok then defined else {} }
					memberCache[container] = cached
				end
				for name in (cached :: any).members do
					members[name] = true
				end
			end
			if index % 50 == 0 then
				setProgress(`Reading… {index} / {#scripts} scripts`)
				task.wait()
			end
		end
		knownMembers = members
		-- 2. the findings
		local fresh: { Result } = {}
		for index, container in scripts do
			local source = sources[container]
			if source then
				local ok, findings = pcall(Checker.check, source, checkOptions(container))
				if ok then
					for _, finding in findings do
						table.insert(fresh, { script = container, finding = finding })
					end
				else
					warn(`[{APP_NAME}] could not check {container:GetFullName()}: {findings}`)
				end
			end
			if index % 25 == 0 then
				setProgress(`Scanning… {index} / {#scripts} scripts`)
				task.wait()
			end
		end
		setProgress(nil)
		results = fresh
		scannedScripts = #scripts
		hasScanned = true
	end

	-- Runs one action at a time: a click during a scan, fix or undo does nothing. An error
	-- inside the action is reported in the banner instead of leaving the panel stuck.
	local function exclusive(action: () -> ())
		if busy or destroyed then
			return
		end
		busy = true
		confirmUntil = 0
		render()
		local ok, message = pcall(action)
		busy = false
		setProgress(nil)
		if not ok then
			warn(`[{APP_NAME}] {message}`)
			notice = `Something went wrong: {message}`
			noticeColor = WARNING
		end
		if not destroyed then
			render()
		end
	end

	-- Rewrites one script. `pick` chooses which current findings to fix. A failure in one
	-- script is reported and the others go on, so every change made is kept for undo.
	local function fixScript(container: LuaSourceContainer, pick: (Checker.Finding) -> boolean, changes: { Change })
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			local source = readSource(container)
			if not source then
				return
			end
			local chosen = {}
			for _, finding in Checker.check(source, checkOptions(container)) do
				if finding.fix and pick(finding) then
					table.insert(chosen, finding)
				end
			end
			local fixes = Checker.orderedFixes(chosen)
			local newSource, applied = Checker.applyFixes(source, chosen)
			if applied > 0 and writeChange(container, source, newSource, fixes) then
				table.insert(
					changes,
					{ script = container, before = source, after = newSource, count = applied, fixes = fixes }
				)
			end
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(`[{APP_NAME}] could not fix {container:GetFullName()}: {message}`)
		end
	end

	-- Opens the script with the new text of one fix selected, so the change is in plain view.
	local function reveal(change: Change)
		local fix = change.fixes[1]
		if not fix then
			return
		end
		local line, col = Checker.position(change.before, fix.from)
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:OpenScriptDocumentAsync(change.script)
				local document = ScriptEditorService:FindScriptDocument(change.script)
				if document then
					document:ForceSetSelectionAsync(line, col + #fix.text, line, col)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- "Fixed 13 places in 5 scripts: a, b, c and 2 more."
	local function describe(changes: { Change }): string
		local total = 0
		local names = {}
		for index, change in changes do
			total += change.count
			if index <= 3 then
				table.insert(names, change.script.Name)
			end
		end
		local more = if #changes > 3 then ` and {#changes - 3} more` else ""
		return `Fixed {plural(total, "place")} in {plural(#changes, "script")}: {table.concat(names, ", ")}{more}.`
	end

	local function finishFix(changes: { Change })
		noticeColor = SUCCESS
		if #changes == 0 then
			notice = "Nothing was changed: these scripts no longer have that issue. Scanned again."
		else
			table.insert(undoSteps, changes)
			if #undoSteps > MAX_UNDO_STEPS then
				table.remove(undoSteps, 1)
			end
			notice = describe(changes)
				.. " Ctrl+Z does not undo this; “Undo fixes” here does, until Studio is closed."
		end
		runScan()
	end

	local function scan()
		exclusive(function()
			notice = nil
			runScan()
		end)
	end

	local function fixAll()
		exclusive(function()
			if not canEdit() then
				return
			end
			local touched: { [LuaSourceContainer]: boolean } = {}
			for _, result in results do
				if result.finding.fix then
					touched[result.script] = true
				end
			end
			local changes: { Change } = {}
			local done = 0
			for container in touched do
				fixScript(container, function()
					return true
				end, changes)
				done += 1
				setProgress(`Fixing… {done} scripts`)
			end
			finishFix(changes)
		end)
	end

	local function fixOne(result: Result)
		local changes: { Change } = {}
		exclusive(function()
			if not canEdit() then
				return
			end
			local finding = result.finding
			fixScript(result.script, function(candidate)
				return candidate.rule == finding.rule
					and candidate.line == finding.line
					and candidate.col == finding.col
			end, changes)
			finishFix(changes)
		end)
		if changes[1] then
			reveal(changes[1])
		end
	end

	-- Same as pressing "Fix" on the finding at this line (used by tests).
	local function fixOneAt(container: LuaSourceContainer, line: number)
		for _, result in results do
			if result.script == container and result.finding.line == line and result.finding.fix then
				fixOne(result)
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- Takes back the last fix step: every script it changed gets its old text, unless the
	-- script was edited after the fix.
	local function undoFixes()
		exclusive(function()
			if #undoSteps == 0 or not canEdit() then
				return
			end
			local step = table.remove(undoSteps) :: { Change }
			local restored, skipped = 0, 0
			for _, change in step do
				local ok, done = pcall(function()
					local stillOurs = change.script.Parent ~= nil and readSource(change.script) == change.after
					local undoing = Checker.reverseFixes(change.before, change.fixes)
					return stillOurs and writeChange(change.script, change.after, change.before, undoing)
				end)
				if ok and done then
					restored += 1
				else
					skipped += 1
				end
			end
			local text = `Put the old text back in {plural(restored, "script")}.`
			if skipped > 0 then
				text ..= ` {plural(skipped, "script")} changed after the fix and were left alone.`
			end
			if #undoSteps > 0 then
				text ..= ` Press “Undo fixes” again to take back the fix before that ({#undoSteps} left).`
			end
			notice = text
			noticeColor = SUCCESS
			runScan()
		end)
	end

	local function openAt(container: LuaSourceContainer, line: number, col: number)
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:OpenScriptDocumentAsync(container)
				local document = ScriptEditorService:FindScriptDocument(container)
				if document then
					document:RequestSetSelectionAsync(line, col)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and pluginObject then
				pcall(function()
					pluginObject:OpenScript(container, line)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Rendering
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	local function applyTheme()
		local buttonColor = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Button, Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240))
		local buttonText = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.ButtonText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30))
		local border = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Border, Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180))
		root.BackgroundColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainBackground, WHITE)
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30))
		list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.ScrollBar, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))
		scanButton.BackgroundColor3 = PRIMARY
		scanButton.TextColor3 = WHITE
		scanStroke.Color = PRIMARY
		for _, pair in { { fixAllButton, fixAllStroke }, { undoButton, undoStroke } } do
			pair[1].BackgroundColor3 = buttonColor
			pair[1].TextColor3 = buttonText
			pair[2].Color = border
		end
	end

	-- While "Fix N safe" waits for the second click it takes the colour of the question above it.
	local function paintConfirm(confirming: boolean)
		if confirming then
			fixAllButton.BackgroundColor3 = WARNING
			fixAllButton.TextColor3 = WHITE
			fixAllStroke.Color = WARNING
		else
			fixAllButton.BackgroundColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Button, Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240))
			fixAllButton.TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.ButtonText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30))
			fixAllStroke.Color = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Border, Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180))
		end
	end

	-- Buttons look pressed-out while an action runs; clicks are ignored then anyway.
	local function setEnabled(button: TextButton, enabled: boolean)
		button.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		button.BackgroundTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.5
		button.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.5
	end

	local function makeRow(result: Result, order: number)
		local finding = result.finding
		local color = SEVERITY_COLOR[finding.severity]
		local row = create("TextButton", {
			Name = "Finding",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = true,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Item, Color3.fromRGB(246, 246, 246)),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Parent = list,
		}, {
			corner(6),
			create("UIStroke", {
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
				Thickness = 1,
				Color = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Border, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
			}),
			create("Frame", {
				Name = "Stripe",
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = color,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, { corner(2) }),
		})

		local body = create("Frame", {
			Name = "Body",
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = row,
		}, {
			padding(10, 8),
			create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),

		create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Title",
			Text = finding.title,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, if finding.fix then -60 else 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			Parent = body,
		})

		create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Message",
			Text = finding.message,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 2,
			Parent = body,
		})

		-- the line number goes first so a long script name can never push it out of view
		create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Where",
			Text = `line {finding.line}  ·  {result.script.Name}`,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)),
			TextTransparency = 0.35,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 3,
			Parent = body,
		})

		row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			openAt(result.script, finding.line, finding.col)
		end)

		if finding.fix and canEdit() then
			local fixButton = create("TextButton", {
				Name = "Fix",
				Text = "Fix",
				Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,
				TextSize = 13,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 22),
				BackgroundColor3 = PRIMARY,
				TextColor3 = WHITE,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ZIndex = 2,
				Parent = row,
			}, { corner(5) })
			setEnabled(fixButton, not busy)
			fixButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				task.spawn(fixOne, result)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function makeEmptyRow(text: string)
		create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Empty",
			Text = text,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextColor3 = themeColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.DimmedText, Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110)),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = list,
		})
	end

	function render()
		for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end

		table.sort(results, function(a, b)
			local orderA, orderB = SEVERITY_ORDER[a.finding.severity], SEVERITY_ORDER[b.finding.severity]
			if orderA ~= orderB then
				return orderA < orderB
			end
			local pathA, pathB = a.script:GetFullName(), b.script:GetFullName()
			if pathA ~= pathB then
				return pathA < pathB
			end
			return a.finding.line < b.finding.line
		end)

		local counts = { security = 0, bug = 0, deprecated = 0, advice = 0 }
		local fixable, shown, visibleTotal = 0, 0, 0
		for _, result in results do
			local severity = result.finding.severity
			counts[severity] += 1
			if result.finding.fix then
				fixable += 1
			end
			if enabledSeverity[severity] then
				visibleTotal += 1
				if shown < MAX_ROWS then
					shown += 1
					makeRow(result, shown)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, severity in SEVERITIES do
			local button = filterButtons[severity.id]
			local isOn = enabledSeverity[severity.id]
			button.Text = `{severity.label}  {counts[severity.id]}`
			button.BackgroundColor3 = severity.color
			button.BackgroundTransparency = if isOn then 0 else 0.8
			button.TextColor3 = if isOn then WHITE else severity.color
		end
		filterRow.Visible = hasScanned and #results > 0

		local editable = canEdit()
		local confirming = os.clock() < confirmUntil
		local fixScripts: { [LuaSourceContainer]: boolean } = {}
		local fixScriptCount = 0
		for _, result in results do
			if result.finding.fix and not fixScripts[result.script] then
				fixScripts[result.script] = true
				fixScriptCount += 1
			end
		end

		if confirming then
			noticeLabel.Text = `This changes {plural(fixable, "place")} in {plural(fixScriptCount, "script")}. `
				.. "Ctrl+Z will not undo it; “Undo fixes” in this panel will, until Studio is closed. "
				.. "Click the button again to go ahead."
			noticeLabel.BackgroundColor3 = WARNING
		else
			noticeLabel.Text = notice or ""
			noticeLabel.BackgroundColor3 = noticeColor
		end
		noticeLabel.Visible = confirming or notice ~= nil

		if busy and progress then
			statusLabel.Text = progress
		elseif busy then
			statusLabel.Text = "Working…"
		elseif not hasScanned then
			statusLabel.Text = "Checks every script in this place: free models you inserted, old code and new code."
			makeEmptyRow("Press “Scan place” to start. Nothing is changed until you press a Fix button.")
		elseif scannedScripts == 0 then
			statusLabel.Text = "No scripts found in this place."
		elseif #results == 0 then
			statusLabel.Text = `Checked {plural(scannedScripts, "script")}. Nothing to fix.`
		else
			local manual = #results - fixable
			local text = `Checked {plural(scannedScripts, "script")}: {plural(#results, "finding")}.`
			if fixable > 0 then
				text ..= ` {fixable} can be fixed with a button, {manual} need a manual change.`
			else
				text ..= " None can be fixed automatically: click one to open the code and read what to change."
			end
			if visibleTotal > shown then
				text ..= ` Showing the first {shown}.`
			end
			if not editable then
				text ..= " The game is running: fixes are off until you stop it (changes now would be lost)."
			end
			statusLabel.Text = text
			if visibleTotal == 0 then
				makeEmptyRow("All findings are hidden by the filters above. Click a filter to show it again.")
			end
		end

		fixAllButton.Text = if confirming then `Yes, fix {fixable}` else `Fix {fixable} safe`
		paintConfirm(confirming)
		fixAllButton.Visible = fixable > 0 and editable
		undoButton.Visible = #undoSteps > 0 and editable
		for _, button in { scanButton, fixAllButton, undoButton } do
			setEnabled(button, not busy)
		end
	end

	for order, severity in SEVERITIES do
		local filterButton = create("TextButton", {
			Name = severity.id,
			Text = severity.label,
			Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
			BackgroundColor3 = severity.color,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Parent = filterRow,
		}, { corner(12), padding(10, 0) })
		filterButtons[severity.id] = filterButton
		filterButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			enabledSeverity[severity.id] = not enabledSeverity[severity.id]
			render()
		end)
	end

	scanButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		task.spawn(scan)
	end)
	-- the first click asks, the second (after a second, within a few) fixes
	fixAllButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if busy then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now < confirmUntil then
			if now - confirmFrom >= CONFIRM_MIN_SECONDS then
				task.spawn(fixAll)
			end
			return
		end
		confirmFrom = now
		confirmUntil = now + CONFIRM_SECONDS
		render()
		task.delay(CONFIRM_SECONDS, function()
			if not destroyed and not busy and confirmUntil ~= 0 and os.clock() >= confirmUntil then
				confirmUntil = 0
				render()
			end
		end)
	end)
	undoButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		task.spawn(undoFixes)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		table.insert(
			connections,
			settings().Studio.ThemeChanged:Connect(function()
				applyTheme()
				render()
			end)
		)
	end)

	applyTheme()
	render()

	return {
		scan = scan,
		fixAll = fixAll,
		undoFixes = undoFixes,
		fixOneAt = fixOneAt,
		destroy = function()
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			destroyed = true
			for _, connection in connections do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
			root:Destroy()
		end,
	}
end

return App

-- Mood: the ranch's light, built from source. Sets a low golden-hour sun, a sky, a dusty prairie
-- atmosphere, bloom, sun rays and colour grading, then tweens between moods when an event changes
-- the air: warm gold for Golden Hour, brown dust for the stampede, bruised purple for the Dust Devil.
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Mood = {}

type MoodSpec = {
	clock: number, brightness: number, shiftTop: Color3, ambient: Color3, outdoor: Color3,
	density: number, haze: number, air: Color3, decay: Color3, glare: number,
	tint: Color3, saturation: number, contrast: number, exposure: number, bloom: number, rays: number,
}

local C = Color3.fromRGB
Mood.MOODS = {
	normal = {
		clock = 16.9, brightness = 2.6, shiftTop = C(255, 222, 170), ambient = C(92, 76, 66), outdoor = C(158, 134, 110),
		density = 0.3, haze = 1.6, air = C(245, 212, 160), decay = C(220, 140, 90), glare = 0.35,
		tint = C(255, 246, 232), saturation = 0.2, contrast = 0.08, exposure = 0.02, bloom = 0.4, rays = 0.06,
	},
	golden = {
		clock = 17.6, brightness = 2.7, shiftTop = C(255, 190, 100), ambient = C(110, 82, 52), outdoor = C(185, 140, 90),
		density = 0.34, haze = 2, air = C(255, 196, 120), decay = C(255, 140, 70), glare = 0.6,
		tint = C(255, 232, 190), saturation = 0.32, contrast = 0.12, exposure = 0, bloom = 0.55, rays = 0.16,
	},
	stampede = {
		clock = 16.4, brightness = 2.2, shiftTop = C(255, 200, 150), ambient = C(90, 66, 50), outdoor = C(140, 104, 80),
		density = 0.5, haze = 3, air = C(200, 150, 100), decay = C(160, 100, 60), glare = 0.2,
		tint = C(255, 225, 200), saturation = -0.05, contrast = 0.22, exposure = -0.02, bloom = 0.35, rays = 0.04,
	},
	dust = {
		clock = 17.5, brightness = 2.3, shiftTop = C(220, 180, 255), ambient = C(112, 92, 124), outdoor = C(170, 142, 182),
		density = 0.42, haze = 2.2, air = C(205, 175, 225), decay = C(160, 110, 175), glare = 0.2,
		tint = C(242, 228, 255), saturation = 0.08, contrast = 0.16, exposure = 0, bloom = 0.5, rays = 0.03,
	},
} :: { [string]: MoodSpec }

local atmosphere: Atmosphere
local bloom: BloomEffect
local rays: SunRaysEffect
local grade: ColorCorrectionEffect
local current = "normal"

local function make(className: string, name: string): Instance
	local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	inst.Name = name
	inst.Parent = Lighting
	return inst
end

-- Builds the sky and the effects once, at the normal mood.
function Mood.lightTheRanch()
	for _, child in Lighting:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("Sky") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 34
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.6
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.5
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.25
	Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = C(80, 50, 30)
	local sky = make("Sky", "PrairieSky") :: Sky
	sky.SunAngularSize = 16
	sky.MoonAngularSize = 9
	sky.StarCount = 1500
	sky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
	atmosphere = make("Atmosphere", "PrairieHaze") :: Atmosphere
	atmosphere.Offset = 0.12
	bloom = make("BloomEffect", "SunGlow") :: BloomEffect
	bloom.Size = 28
	bloom.Threshold = 1.3
	rays = make("SunRaysEffect", "SunRays") :: SunRaysEffect
	rays.Spread = 0.6
	grade = make("ColorCorrectionEffect", "Grade") :: ColorCorrectionEffect
	Mood.set("normal", 0)
end

-- Tweens the whole sky to a mood over `seconds` (0 snaps).
function Mood.set(name: string, seconds: number)
	local spec = Mood.MOODS[name]
	if not spec or not atmosphere then
		return
	end
	current = name
	local info = TweenInfo.new(math.max(seconds, 0.01), Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local function to(inst: Instance, goal: { [string]: any })
		if seconds <= 0 then
			for k, v in goal do
				(inst :: any)[k] = v
			end
		else
			TweenService:Create(inst, info, goal):Play()
		end
	end
	to(Lighting, {
		ClockTime = spec.clock, Brightness = spec.brightness, ColorShift_Top = spec.shiftTop,
		Ambient = spec.ambient, OutdoorAmbient = spec.outdoor,
	})
	to(atmosphere, { Density = spec.density, Haze = spec.haze, Color = spec.air, Decay = spec.decay, Glare = spec.glare })
	to(grade, { TintColor = spec.tint, Saturation = spec.saturation, Contrast = spec.contrast, Brightness = spec.exposure })
	to(bloom, { Intensity = spec.bloom })
	to(rays, { Intensity = spec.rays })
end

function Mood.current(): string
	return current
end

return Mood
