local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    -- stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("ProgressBar", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = false,
        Args = {
            ["Text"] = 1,
            ["Format"] = 2,
        },
        Events = {
            ["hovered"] = widgets.EVENTS.hover(function(thisWidget: Types.Widget)
                return thisWidget.Instance
            end),
            ["changed"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
                    return thisWidget.lastChangedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
        },
        Generate = function(_thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
            local ProgressBar = Instance.new("Frame")
            ProgressBar.Name = "Iris_ProgressBar"
            ProgressBar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(Iris._config.ItemWidth, UDim.new())
            ProgressBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            widgets.UIListLayout(ProgressBar, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemInnerSpacing.X)).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

            local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            Bar.Name = "Bar"
            Bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            Bar.Size = UDim2.new(Iris._config.ContentWidth, Iris._config.ContentHeight)
            Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.FrameBgColor
            Bar.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.FrameBgTransparency
            Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Bar.ClipsDescendants = true

            widgets.applyFrameStyle(Bar, true)

            Bar.Parent = ProgressBar

            local Progress = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            Progress.Name = "Progress"
            Progress.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            Progress.Size = UDim2.new(UDim.new(0, 0), Iris._config.ContentHeight)
            Progress.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PlotHistogramColor
            Progress.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PlotHistogramTransparency
            Progress.BorderSizePixel = 0

            widgets.applyTextStyle(Progress)
            widgets.UIPadding(Progress, Iris._config.FramePadding)
            widgets.UICorner(Progress, Iris._config.FrameRounding)

            Progress.Text = ""
            Progress.Parent = Bar

            local Value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            Value.Name = "Value"
            Value.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            Value.Size = UDim2.new(UDim.new(0, 0), Iris._config.ContentHeight)
            Value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Value.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Value.ZIndex = 1

            widgets.applyTextStyle(Value)
            widgets.UIPadding(Value, Iris._config.FramePadding)

            Value.Parent = Bar

            local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            TextLabel.Name = "TextLabel"
            TextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            TextLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
            TextLabel.LayoutOrder = 1

            widgets.applyTextStyle(TextLabel)
            widgets.UIPadding(Value, Iris._config.FramePadding)

            TextLabel.Parent = ProgressBar

            return ProgressBar
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
            if thisWidget.state.progress == nil then
                thisWidget.state.progress = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "Progress", 0)
            end
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
            local Progress = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local TextLabel: TextLabel = Progress.TextLabel
            local Bar = Progress.Bar :: Frame
            local Value: TextLabel = Bar.Value

            if thisWidget.arguments.Format ~= nil and typeof(thisWidget.arguments.Format) == "string" then
                Value.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Format
            end

            TextLabel.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Text or "Progress Bar"
        end,
        UpdateState = function(thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
            local ProgressBar = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local Bar = ProgressBar.Bar :: Frame
            local Progress: TextLabel = Bar.Progress
            local Value: TextLabel = Bar.Value

            local progress = math.clamp(thisWidget.state.progress.value, 0, 1)
            local totalWidth = Bar.AbsoluteSize.X
            local textWidth = Value.AbsoluteSize.X
            if totalWidth * (1 - progress) < textWidth then
                Value.AnchorPoint = Vector2.xAxis
                Value.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            else
                Value.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
                Value.Position = UDim2.fromScale(progress, 0)
            end

            Progress.Size = UDim2.new(UDim.new(progress, 0), Progress.Size.Height)
            if thisWidget.arguments.Format ~= nil and typeof(thisWidget.arguments.Format) == "string" then
                Value.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Format
            else
                Value.Text = string.format("%d%%", progress * 100)
            end
            thisWidget.lastChangedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.ProgressBar)
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
            widgets.discardState(thisWidget)
        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)

    local function createLine(parent: Frame, index: number)
        local Block = Instance.new("Frame")
        Block.Name = tostring(index)
        Block.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        Block.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PlotLinesColor
        Block.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PlotLinesTransparency
        Block.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Block.Parent = parent

        return Block
    end

    local function clearLine(thisWidget: Types.PlotLines)
        if thisWidget.HoveredLine then
            thisWidget.HoveredLine.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PlotLinesColor
            thisWidget.HoveredLine.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PlotLinesTransparency
            thisWidget.HoveredLine = false
            thisWidget.state.hovered:set(nil)
        end
    end

    local function updateLine(thisWidget: Types.PlotLines, silent: true?)
        local PlotLines = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
        local Background = PlotLines.Background :: Frame
        local Plot = Background.Plot :: Frame

        local mousePosition = widgets.getMouseLocation()

        local position = Plot.AbsolutePosition - widgets.GuiOffset
        local scale = (mousePosition.X - position.X) / Plot.AbsoluteSize.X
        local index = math.ceil(scale * #thisWidget.Lines)
        local line: Frame? = thisWidget.Lines[index]

        if line then
            if line ~= thisWidget.HoveredLine and not silent then
                clearLine(thisWidget)
            end
            local start: number? = thisWidget.state.values.value[index]
            local stop: number? = thisWidget.state.values.value[index + 1]
            if start and stop then
                if math.floor(start) == start and math.floor(stop) == stop then
                    thisWidget.Tooltip.Text = ("%d: %d\n%d: %d"):format(index, start, index + 1, stop)
                else
                    thisWidget.Tooltip.Text = ("%d: %.3f\n%d: %.3f"):format(index, start, index + 1, stop)
                end
            end
            thisWidget.HoveredLine = line
            line.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PlotLinesHoveredColor
            line.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PlotLinesHoveredTransparency
            if silent then
                thisWidget.state.hovered.value = { start, stop }
            else
                thisWidget.state.hovered:set({ start, stop })
            end
        end
    end

    -- stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("PlotLines", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = false,
        Args = {
            ["Text"] = 1,
            ["Height"] = 2,
            ["Min"] = 3,
            ["Max"] = 4,
            ["TextOverlay"] = 5,
        },
        Events = {
            ["hovered"] = widgets.EVENTS.hover(function(thisWidget: Types.Widget)
                return thisWidget.Instance
            end),

                    local a = size * Vector2.new((index - 1) / count, (max - start) / range)

        end

    local function updateBlock(thisWidget: Types.PlotHistogram, silent: true?)
        local PlotHistogram = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
        local Background = PlotHistogram.Background :: Frame
        local Plot = Background.Plot :: Frame

        local mousePosition = widgets.getMouseLocation()

        local position = Plot.AbsolutePosition - widgets.GuiOffset
        local scale = (mousePosition.X - position.X) / Plot.AbsoluteSize.X
        local index = math.ceil(scale * #thisWidget.Blocks)
        local block: Frame? = thisWidget.Blocks[index]

        if block then
            if block ~= thisWidget.HoveredBlock and not silent then
                clearBlock(thisWidget)
            end
            local value: number? = thisWidget.state.values.value[index]
            if value then
                thisWidget.Tooltip.Text = if math.floor(value) == value then ("%d: %d"):format(index, value) else ("%d: %.3f"):format(index, value)
            end
            thisWidget.HoveredBlock = block
            block.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.PlotHistogramHoveredColor
            block.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.PlotHistogramHoveredTransparency
            if silent then
                thisWidget.state.hovered.value = value
            else
                thisWidget.state.hovered:set(value)
            end
        end
    end

--[[
	Script Doctor — plugin entry point.

	Creates the toolbar button and the dock widget, then hands the widget to App,
	which builds the interface and does the work.
]]

local App = require(script.App)

local PLUGIN_NAME = "Script Doctor"
-- assets/icon-64.png, uploaded to Roblox 17.11.2026 (assets/icon.py draws it)
local ICON = "rbxassetid://112052844064040"

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar(PLUGIN_NAME)
local openButton = toolbar:CreateButton(
	"ScriptDoctorOpen",
	"Check every script for unsafe remotes, data-loss bugs and deprecated API",
	ICON,
	PLUGIN_NAME
)
openButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGuiAsync(
	"ScriptDoctorWidget",
	DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(Enum.InitialDockState.Right, false, false, 440, 560, 320, 240)
)
widget.Title = PLUGIN_NAME
widget.Name = "ScriptDoctorWidget"
widget.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

local app = App.mount(widget, { plugin = plugin })

openButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
end)
openButton:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
widget:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
	openButton:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
end)

-- Clean up when the plugin is turned off, updated or Studio closes.
plugin.Unloading:Connect(app.destroy)

-- Only the test build (test.project.json) has this module: commands for automated tests.
local testHooks = script:FindFirstChild("TestHooks")
if testHooks then
	-- never to be confused with the release build
	widget.Title = PLUGIN_NAME .. " (test build)"
	require(testHooks :: ModuleScript)(widget, app)
end

-- World: builds the six fenced ranch plots along the Cattle Drive (dirt paddock, ten hay stalls, a
-- gate with a lock pad, an owner's sign), dresses the prairie (a neon ROT RANCH arch over the drive,
-- a chuckwagon camp, pines, dead trees, cacti, rocks, flowers, lantern posts, a windmill and a water
-- tower with a spinning vane), keeps it moving (tumbleweeds, twinkling arch lights), and answers
-- where things are: which ranch holds a point, and whether a point is out on the open drive.
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local World = {}

World.PLOT_HALF_W = 28
World.PLOT_HALF_D = 22
World.DRIVE_HALF_WIDTH = 20 -- |z| below this is the open drive: the stampede's path
World.DRIVE_START_X = -128
World.DRIVE_END_X = 132

-- Plot centres: north row faces south onto the drive, south row faces north.
local PLOT_CENTERS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 0, -42), Vector3.new(0, 0, 42),
	Vector3.new(-72, 0, -42), Vector3.new(72, 0, -42),
	Vector3.new(-72, 0, 42), Vector3.new(72, 0, 42),
}
local STALL_X = { -20, -10, 0, 10, 20 }
local STALL_ROW_Z = { -6, 10 }

local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(122, 84, 52)
local DARK_WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(86, 58, 36)
local HAY = Color3.fromRGB(222, 186, 98)
local DIRT = Color3.fromRGB(150, 108, 68)

-- Moving bits of the ranchland, animated by startRanchlandMotion.
local archLights: { BasePart } = {}
local vane: BasePart? = nil
local tumbleFolder: Folder? = nil

export type Plot = {
	index: number, cf: CFrame, folder: Model,
	stallCFrames: { CFrame }, stallPads: { BasePart }, stallLocks: { BillboardGui },
	gateBars: { BasePart }, gateLabel: TextLabel, lockPad: BasePart, signLabel: TextLabel,
	gateGroup: string, rancherGroup: string,
}

local function block(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Wood
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- Painted lettering on a part's face. TextScaled stops at 100 px, so the canvas is kept coarse
-- (20 pixels a stud, fewer for a big sign) for the words to fill the board.
local function signText(part: BasePart, face: Enum.NormalId, text: string, color: Color3, font: Enum.Font?, pixelsPerStud: number?): TextLabel
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = face
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = pixelsPerStud or 20
	gui.LightInfluence = 0.2
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = font or Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 22, 10)
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = part
	return label
end

local function fenceRun(parent: Instance, from: Vector3, to: Vector3, cf: CFrame)
	local span = to - from
	local length = span.Magnitude
	local mid = cf * CFrame.new((from + to) / 2)
	local along = CFrame.lookAt(mid.Position, mid.Position + cf:VectorToWorldSpace(span.Unit))
	for _, y in { 1.8, 3.8 } do
		block(parent, "Rail", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, length), along + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), WOOD)
	end
	local posts = math.max(1, math.floor(length / 7))
	for i = 0, posts do
		local p = from:Lerp(to, i / posts)
		block(parent, "Post", Vector3.new(1, 5, 1), cf * CFrame.new(p.X, 2.5, p.Z), DARK_WOOD)
	end
end

-- Builds one fenced ranch at a centre, its stalls facing the gate and the gate facing the drive.
local function buildRanchPlot(index: number, center: Vector3): Plot
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(center, Vector3.new(center.X, 0, 0))
	local folder = Instance.new("Model")
	folder.Name = "Ranch" .. index
	local hw, hd = World.PLOT_HALF_W, World.PLOT_HALF_D

	block(folder, "Paddock", Vector3.new(hw * 2, 0.4, hd * 2), cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 0), DIRT, Enum.Material.Ground)
	fenceRun(folder, Vector3.new(-hw, 0, hd), Vector3.new(hw, 0, hd), cf)
	fenceRun(folder, Vector3.new(-hw, 0, -hd), Vector3.new(-hw, 0, hd), cf)
	fenceRun(folder, Vector3.new(hw, 0, -hd), Vector3.new(hw, 0, hd), cf)
	fenceRun(folder, Vector3.new(-hw, 0, -hd), Vector3.new(-6.5, 0, -hd), cf)
	fenceRun(folder, Vector3.new(6.5, 0, -hd), Vector3.new(hw, 0, -hd), cf)

	-- The gate: two tall posts, a beam carrying the owner's sign, and lock bars across the gap.

-- Registers each ranch's gate/rancher collision pair so a locked gate stops everyone but its owner.
local function registerGateGroups()
	for i = 1, #PLOT_CENTERS do
		local gate, rancher = "Gate" .. i, "Rancher" .. i
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(gate)
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(rancher)
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(gate, rancher, false)
	end
end

function World.buildRanchPlots(): { Plot }
	registerGateGroups()
	local plots = {}
	for i, center in PLOT_CENTERS do
		plots[i] = buildRanchPlot(i, center)
	end
	return plots
end

-- Greys out the stalls a rancher has not unlocked yet (more open with each rebirth).
function World.paintStallLocks(plot: Plot, openStalls: number)
	for i, pad in plot.stallPads do
		local open = i <= openStalls
		pad.Color = if open then HAY else Color3.fromRGB(110, 100, 90)
		plot.stallLocks[i].Enabled = not open
	end
end

-- Shows a gate as locked (red bars, countdown) or open (bars down, green "OPEN").
function World.paintGate(plot: Plot, locked: boolean, secondsLeft: number)
	for _, bar in plot.gateBars do
		bar.Transparency = if locked then 0.05 else 1
		bar.CanCollide = locked
	end
	if locked then
		plot.gateLabel.Text = string.format("LOCKED %ds", math.ceil(secondsLeft))
		plot.gateLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 70)
		plot.lockPad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 50)
	else
		plot.gateLabel.Text = "GATE OPEN"
		plot.gateLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
		plot.lockPad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90)
	end
end

-- Rolls one tumbleweed across the open prairie behind a row of ranches.
local function rollTumbleweed(t: number)
	local folder = tumbleFolder
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	local side = if math.random() < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	local z = side * (78 + math.random() * 50)
	local ball = block(folder, "Tumbleweed", Vector3.one * 3, CFrame.new(-190, 1.5, z), Color3.fromRGB(170, 130, 80), Enum.Material.Grass)
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Transparency = 0.25
	ball.CanCollide = false
	ball:SetAttribute("Born", t)
	ball:SetAttribute("Z", z)
	ball:SetAttribute("Speed", 14 + math.random() * 10)
end

-- Keeps the ranchland alive: tumbleweeds bounce by, the arch's bulbs chase, the weathervane turns.
function World.startRanchlandMotion()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Tumbleweeds"
	folder.Parent = Workspace
	tumbleFolder = folder
	local t, nextWeed = 0, 2
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		nextWeed -= dt
		if nextWeed <= 0 then
			nextWeed = 6 + math.random() * 6
			rollTumbleweed(t)
		end
		for _, weed in folder:GetChildren() do
			local born = weed:GetAttribute("Born") :: number
			local x = -190 + (t - born) * (weed:GetAttribute("Speed") :: number)
			if x > 200 then
				weed:Destroy()
			else
				local hop = math.abs(math.sin((t - born) * 3)) * 2.4
				local z = weed:GetAttribute("Z") :: number;
				(weed :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(x, 1.5 + hop, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -(t - born) * 5)
			end
		end
		for i, bulb in archLights do
			local on = math.floor(t * 4 + i) % 3 ~= 0
			bulb.Color = if on then Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120) else Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 50)
		end
		local turning = vane
		if turning then
			turning.CFrame = CFrame.new(turning.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 0.4) * 2.5, 0)
		end
	end)
end

function World.paintRanchSign(plot: Plot, text: string, color: Color3)
	plot.signLabel.Text = text
	plot.signLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

function World.ranchContains(plot: Plot, position: Vector3): boolean
	local p = plot.cf:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	return math.abs(p.X) < World.PLOT_HALF_W and math.abs(p.Z) < World.PLOT_HALF_D and p.Y < 40
end

function World.isOnTheDrive(position: Vector3): boolean
	return math.abs(position.Z) < World.DRIVE_HALF_WIDTH and position.X > World.DRIVE_START_X - 30 and position.X < World.DRIVE_END_X + 10
end

-- The water tower gets a turning rooster weathervane, a neon band, a sign and a dripping leak.
local function dressWaterTower()
	local tower = Workspace:FindFirstChild("WaterTower")
	local cap = tower and tower:FindFirstChild("TankCap") :: BasePart?
	local tank = tower and tower:FindFirstChild("Tank") :: BasePart?
	if not tower or not cap or not tank then
		return
	end
	local top = cap.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
	block(tower, "VaneRod", Vector3.new(0.3, 4, 0.3), CFrame.new(top + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70), Enum.Material.Metal)
	vane = block(tower, "Vane", Vector3.new(0.3, 2.4, 4.4), CFrame.new(top + Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(40, 36, 34), Enum.Material.Metal)
	local band = block(tower, "TankBand", Vector3.new(1.2, 12.6, 12.6), tank.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 70), Enum.Material.Neon)
	band.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	band.CanCollide = false
	local sign = block(tower, "TankSign", Vector3.new(8, 2.6, 0.3), CFrame.new(tank.Position + Vector3.new(0, -1.8, -6.3)), Color3.fromRGB(110, 70, 40))
	signText(sign, Enum.NormalId.Front, "ROT WATER", Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 120))
	local drip = Instance.new("Attachment")
	drip.Position = Vector3.new(-4.6, 0, -2)
	drip.Parent = tank
	local leak = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	leak.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	leak.Rate = 14
	leak.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.4)
	leak.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 1)
	leak.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
	leak.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
	leak.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255))
	leak.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
	leak.Parent = drip
end

-- Dresses the prairie around the ranches and writes the barn and corral signs.
function World.decorateRanchland()
	local decor = Instance.new("Folder")
	decor.Name = "Ranchland"
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(-120, 0, -80), Vector3.new(-100, 0, -120), Vector3.new(-140, 0, 60), Vector3.new(110, 0, -100),
		Vector3.new(120, 0, 90), Vector3.new(-110, 0, 110), Vector3.new(60, 0, -130), Vector3.new(-30, 0, -140),
		Vector3.new(30, 0, 120), Vector3.new(90, 0, 130), Vector3.new(-80, 0, 140), Vector3.new(-150, 0, -30) } do
		tree(decor, spot, 12 + (math.abs(spot.X + spot.Z) % 7))
	end
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(-120, 0, 30), Vector3.new(118, 0, -30), Vector3.new(124, 0, 34), Vector3.new(-118, 0, -34), Vector3.new(36, 0, -24.5), Vector3.new(-36, 0, 24.5) } do
		cactus(decor, spot, 6)
	end
	for i, spot in { Vector3.new(-26, 0, -80), Vector3.new(-22, 0, -82), Vector3.new(26, 0, 80), Vector3.new(40, 0, -76), Vector3.new(-36, 0, 76) } do
		local bale = block(decor, "HayBale", Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), CFrame.new(spot + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2), HAY, Enum.Material.Fabric)
		bale.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		bale.Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 4 + i % 2, 4 + i % 2)
	end
	windmill(decor, Vector3.new(-60, 0, -104))
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(-160, 0, -110), Vector3.new(150, 0, -130), Vector3.new(160, 0, 120), Vector3.new(-170, 0, 100),
		Vector3.new(70, 0, 150), Vector3.new(-50, 0, 160), Vector3.new(10, 0, -160), Vector3.new(-130, 0, 150), Vector3.new(130, 0, 160) } do
		pine(decor, spot, 16 + math.abs(spot.X) % 9)
	end
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(140, 0, -78), Vector3.new(-90, 0, -90), Vector3.new(96, 0, 96), Vector3.new(-160, 0, 70) } do
		deadTree(decor, spot, 13)
	end
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(-126, 0, -60), Vector3.new(132, 0, 64), Vector3.new(60, 0, -96), Vector3.new(-64, 0, 96), Vector3.new(100, 0, -150), Vector3.new(-20, 0, 120) } do
		rocks(decor, spot, 3.4)
	end
	for _, spot in { Vector3.new(-40, 0, -70), Vector3.new(44, 0, 70), Vector3.new(-110, 0, 76), Vector3.new(108, 0, -74), Vector3.new(-10, 0, -78), Vector3.new(12, 0, 82) } do
		flowers(decor, spot)
	end
	for _, x in { -118, -36, 36, 110 } do
		lanternPost(decor, Vector3.new(x + 4, 0, -19))
		lanternPost(decor, Vector3.new(x - 4, 0, 19))
	end
	neonArch(decor, -36)
	chuckwagon(decor, CFrame.new(62, 0, -84) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0.35, 0))
	decor.Parent = Workspace
	dressWaterTower()

	local barn = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RedBarn")
	if barn and barn:FindFirstChild("RanchSign") then
		signText(barn.RanchSign, Enum.NormalId.Back, "ROT RANCH", Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 25))
	end
	local corral = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RotCorral")
	if corral and corral:FindFirstChild("ChuteSign") then
		signText(corral.ChuteSign, Enum.NormalId.Right, "ROT CORRAL", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230))
	end
	local canyon = Workspace:FindFirstChild("DustCanyon")
	if canyon and canyon:FindFirstChild("ButteNorth") then
		signText(canyon.ButteNorth, Enum.NormalId.Left, "DUST CANYON", Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 200))
	end
end

return World

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("RadioButton", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = false,
        Args = {
            ["Text"] = 1,
            ["Index"] = 2,
        },
        Events = {
            ["selected"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.RadioButton) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
                    return thisWidget.lastSelectedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
            ["unselected"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.RadioButton) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
                    return thisWidget.lastUnselectedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
            ["active"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.RadioButton) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
                    return thisWidget.state.index.value == thisWidget.arguments.Index
                end,
            },
            ["hovered"] = widgets.EVENTS.hover(function(thisWidget: Types.Widget)
                return thisWidget.Instance
            end),
        },
        Generate = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
            local RadioButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
            RadioButton.Name = "Iris_RadioButton"
            RadioButton.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            RadioButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            RadioButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            RadioButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
            RadioButton.Text = ""
            RadioButton.AutoButtonColor = false

            widgets.UIListLayout(RadioButton, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemInnerSpacing.X)).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

            local buttonSize = Iris._config.TextSize + 2 * (Iris._config.FramePadding.Y - 1)
            local Button = Instance.new("Frame")
            Button.Name = "Button"
            Button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize)
            Button.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.FrameBgColor
            Button.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.FrameBgTransparency
            Button.Parent = RadioButton

            widgets.UICorner(Button)
            widgets.UIPadding(Button, Vector2.new(math.max(1, math.floor(buttonSize / 5)), math.max(1, math.floor(buttonSize / 5))))

            local Circle = Instance.new("Frame")
            Circle.Name = "Circle"
            Circle.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            Circle.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.CheckMarkColor
            Circle.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.CheckMarkTransparency
            widgets.UICorner(Circle)
            
            Circle.Parent = Button

            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", RadioButton, Button, {
                Color = Iris._config.FrameBgColor,
                Transparency = Iris._config.FrameBgTransparency,
                HoveredColor = Iris._config.FrameBgHoveredColor,
                HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.FrameBgHoveredTransparency,
                ActiveColor = Iris._config.FrameBgActiveColor,
                ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.FrameBgActiveTransparency,
            })

            widgets.applyButtonClick(RadioButton, function()
                thisWidget.state.index:set(thisWidget.arguments.Index)
            end)

            local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            TextLabel.Name = "TextLabel"
            TextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
            TextLabel.LayoutOrder = 1
            
            widgets.applyTextStyle(TextLabel)
            TextLabel.Parent = RadioButton

            return RadioButton
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
            local RadioButton = thisWidget.Instance :: TextButton
            local TextLabel: TextLabel = RadioButton.TextLabel

            TextLabel.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Text or "Radio Button"
            if thisWidget.state then
                thisWidget.state.index.lastChangeTick = Iris._cycleTick
                Iris._widgets[thisWidget.type].UpdateState(thisWidget)
            end
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
            widgets.discardState(thisWidget)
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
            if thisWidget.state.index == nil then
                thisWidget.state.index = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "index", thisWidget.arguments.Index)
            end
        end,
        UpdateState = function(thisWidget: Types.RadioButton)
            local RadioButton = thisWidget.Instance :: TextButton
            local Button = RadioButton.Button :: Frame
            local Circle: Frame = Button.Circle

            if thisWidget.state.index.value == thisWidget.arguments.Index then
                -- only need to hide the circle
                Circle.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.CheckMarkTransparency
                thisWidget.lastSelectedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
            else
                Circle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                thisWidget.lastUnselectedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
            end
        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)
end

-- Game.client: Brainrot Base Rush HUD.
-- Shows money, $/s, brainrot count, the next spawn preview, the wave
-- countdown, a Rebirth button and a help panel. Everything sits clear of
-- the top-left corner, where Roblox puts its menu buttons. Also wires the
-- Slap tool: clicking it fires SlapHit to the server, which checks range.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local updateHud = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UpdateHUD")
local announceEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Announce")
local slapEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SlapHit")
local rebirthEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RequestRebirth")

local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BrainrotHud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function makeLabel(name, parent, position, size, textSize, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Position = position
	label.Size = size
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Text = ""
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextSize = textSize
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

-- Top-right stats panel (clear of the top-left Roblox menu).
local stats = Instance.new("Frame")
stats.Name = "StatsPanel"
stats.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
stats.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12)
stats.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 190)
stats.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
stats.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
stats.BorderSizePixel = 0
stats.Parent = gui

local title = makeLabel("Title", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), 22, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0))
title.Text = "BRAINROT BASE RUSH"
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextAlignment.Center

local moneyLabel = makeLabel("Money", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30), 26, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120))
local rateLabel = makeLabel("Rate", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 72), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
local countLabel = makeLabel("Count", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
local nextLabel = makeLabel("NextSpawn", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 128), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), 20, Color3.fromRGB(160, 200, 255))
local waveLabel = makeLabel("Wave", stats, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 156), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30))

-- Center announcement banner (below the top bar, above the action).
local banner = Instance.new("TextLabel")
banner.Name = "Banner"
banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 70)
banner.Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 44)
banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
banner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
banner.BorderSizePixel = 0
banner.Text = ""
banner.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
banner.TextSize = 24
banner.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
banner.Visible = false
banner.Parent = gui

local bannerUntil = 0
local function showBanner(text, color)
	banner.Text = text
	banner.TextColor3 = color
	banner.Visible = true
	bannerUntil = os.clock() + 5
end

-- Bottom-right Rebirth button (hidden until $25,000 lifetime earned).
local rebirthButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
rebirthButton.Name = "RebirthButton"
rebirthButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
rebirthButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
rebirthButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 56)
rebirthButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30)
rebirthButton.Text = "REBIRTH (+50% earnings)"
rebirthButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 0)
rebirthButton.TextSize = 20
rebirthButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
rebirthButton.Visible = false
rebirthButton.Parent = gui

rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	rebirthEvent:FireServer()
end)

-- Bottom-left help panel.
local help = Instance.new("Frame")
help.Name = "HelpPanel"
help.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -108)
help.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 96)
help.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
help.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
help.BorderSizePixel = 0
help.Parent = gui

local helpText = makeLabel("HelpText", help, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -12), 16, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))
helpText.Text = "Touch a brainrot on the path to BUY it.\nIt earns $ every second on your base.\nTsunami wave? Run to the GREEN base!\nSlap the Noob Nabber before he steals!"
helpText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextAlignment.Left
helpText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextAlignment.Top
helpText.BackgroundTransparency = 1

updateHud.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	moneyLabel.Text = "Money: " .. BrainrotData.formatMoney(data.money)
	local multText = ""
	if data.multiplier > 1 then
		multText = "  (x" .. string.format("%.1f", data.multiplier) .. ")"
	end
	rateLabel.Text = "Income: " .. BrainrotData.formatMoney(data.rate) .. "/s" .. multText
	countLabel.Text = "Brainrots: " .. tostring(data.count) .. "/" .. tostring(data.maxSlots)
	local mutationText = ""
	if data.nextMutation ~= "Normal" then
		mutationText = " [" .. data.nextMutation .. "]"
	end
	nextLabel.Text = "Next: " .. data.nextName .. " (" .. data.nextRarity .. ")" .. mutationText
	if data.waveIn <= 10 then
		waveLabel.Text = "TSUNAMI IN " .. tostring(data.waveIn) .. "s - GET TO BASE!"
		waveLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
	else
		waveLabel.Text = "Tsunami in " .. tostring(data.waveIn) .. "s"
		waveLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30)
	end
	if data.thiefActive then
		waveLabel.Text = waveLabel.Text .. "  |  THIEF!"
	end
	if data.rebirthReady then
		rebirthButton.Visible = true
		rebirthButton.Text = "REBIRTH! +" .. tostring(data.rebirths + 1) .. " (x" .. string.format("%.1f", data.multiplier + 0.5) .. " earnings)"
	else
		rebirthButton.Visible = false
	end
end)

announceEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text, color)
	showBanner(text, color)
end)

-- Hide the banner again a few seconds after it appears.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		if banner.Visible and os.clock() > bannerUntil then
			banner.Visible = false
		end
	end
end)

-- Slap tool: the Tool lives in StarterPack; when the player clicks with it
-- equipped, tell the server (which checks the thief is actually in range).
local function hookSlapTool(tool)
	if tool.Name ~= "Slap" then
		return
	end
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		slapEvent:FireServer()
		showBanner("SLAP!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80))
	end)
end

local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
	hookSlapTool(tool)
end
backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(hookSlapTool)

print("Brainrot Base Rush HUD ready.")

            local TooltipContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

            MenuBarContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            MenuBarContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            MenuBarContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0

            MenuBarContainer.Parent = PopupScreenGui

            local PseudoWindow = Instance.new("Frame")
            PseudoWindow.Name = "PseudoWindow"
            PseudoWindow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            PseudoWindow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            PseudoWindow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
            PseudoWindow.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.WindowBgTransparency
            PseudoWindow.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.WindowBgColor
            PseudoWindow.BorderSizePixel = Iris._config.WindowBorderSize
            PseudoWindow.BorderColor3 = Iris._config.BorderColor

            PseudoWindow.Selectable = false
            PseudoWindow.SelectionGroup = true
            PseudoWindow.SelectionBehaviorUp = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
            PseudoWindow.SelectionBehaviorDown = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
            PseudoWindow.SelectionBehaviorLeft = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
            PseudoWindow.SelectionBehaviorRight = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop

            PseudoWindow.Visible = false

            widgets.UIPadding(PseudoWindow, Iris._config.WindowPadding)
            widgets.UIListLayout(PseudoWindow, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemSpacing.Y))

            PseudoWindow.Parent = PseudoWindowScreenGui

            return Root
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.Root)
            if NumNonWindowChildren > 0 then
                local Root = thisWidget.Instance :: any
                local PseudoWindowScreenGui = Root.PseudoWindowScreenGui :: any
                local PseudoWindow: Frame = PseudoWindowScreenGui.PseudoWindow
                PseudoWindow.Visible = true
            end
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.Root)
            NumNonWindowChildren = 0
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
        end,
        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.Root, thisChild: Types.Widget)
            local Root = thisWidget.Instance :: any

            if thisChild.type == "Window" then
                return thisWidget.Instance
            elseif thisChild.type == "Tooltip" then
                return Root.PopupScreenGui.TooltipContainer
            elseif thisChild.type == "MenuBar" then
                return Root.PopupScreenGui.MenuBarContainer
            else
                local PseudoWindowScreenGui = Root.PseudoWindowScreenGui :: any
                local PseudoWindow: Frame = PseudoWindowScreenGui.PseudoWindow

                NumNonWindowChildren += 1
                PseudoWindow.Visible = true

                return PseudoWindow
            end
        end,
        ChildDiscarded = function(thisWidget: Types.Root, thisChild: Types.Widget)
            if thisChild.type ~= "Window" and thisChild.type ~= "Tooltip" and thisChild.type ~= "MenuBar" then
                NumNonWindowChildren -= 1
                if NumNonWindowChildren == 0 then
                    local Root = thisWidget.Instance :: any
                    local PseudoWindowScreenGui = Root.PseudoWindowScreenGui :: any
                    local PseudoWindow: Frame = PseudoWindowScreenGui.PseudoWindow
                    PseudoWindow.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)
end

-- Fixture: BindToClose that waits a fixed time.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("Fixture")

local function save(player)
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync(player.UserId, 5)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
	task.wait(3) --! bindtoclose-fixed-wait
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	wait(5) --! bindtoclose-fixed-wait, deprecated-global
end)

-- Fine: saves one by one, so the callback returns when the work is done.
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		save(player)
	end
end)

-- Fine: waits until every save has finished.
game:BindToClose(function()
	local pending = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		pending += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			save(player)
			pending -= 1
		end)
	end
	while pending > 0 do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

-- BrainrotFactory: builds a brainrot character as a simple Part-assembled
-- Model (body + head + eyes + one distinctive accessory) plus a
-- BillboardGui name / rarity label. No Humanoid: the server moves the model
-- along the path with PivotTo.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local BrainrotFactory = {}

local function makePart(name, shape, size, color, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Shape = shape
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = true
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function buildAccessory(def, model, body, head)
	local kind = def.accessory
	if kind == "log" then
		-- Tung Tung: a wooden log held across the body.
		local log = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1, 4.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(101, 67, 33), model)
		log.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	elseif kind == "banana" then
		-- Chimpanzini: a big yellow banana on the head.
		local banana = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.7, 2.2, 0.7), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 40), model)
		banana.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.8, 1.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-30))
	elseif kind == "fin" then
		-- Tralalero: a shark fin on top of the head.
		local fin = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Wedge, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.6, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 160), model)
		fin.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0)
	elseif kind == "hat" then
		-- Ballerina: a pink tutu hat / bun on the head.
		local hat = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.4, 2.4, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 200), model)
		hat.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0)
	elseif kind == "shell" then
		-- Bombardiro: a bomber shell strapped on the back.
		local shell = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80), model)
		shell.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, -1.4)
	elseif kind == "cactus" then
		-- Lirili: a green cactus sprouting from the head.
		local cactus = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(2, 0.9, 0.9), Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 70), model)
		cactus.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0)
	elseif kind == "drum" then
		-- Patapim: a drum on the belly.
		local drum = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1, 1.8, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60), model)
		drum.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
	elseif kind == "crown" then
		-- Giraffa: a golden crown on the head.
		local crown = makePart("Accessory", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.7, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), model)
		crown.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	end
end

-- Builds the model at the given position. mutation tints the label and the
-- effective rate; the caller stores the real numbers as attributes.
function BrainrotFactory.build(def, mutation, position)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = def.name

	local body = makePart("Body", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(3, 3, 2), def.bodyColor, model)
	body.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	body.CanCollide = true

	local head = makePart("Head", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.6, 2.6, 2.6), def.headColor, model)
	head.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)
	head.CanCollide = true

	local eyeLeft = makePart("EyeLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), model)
	eyeLeft.Position = position + Vector3.new(-0.6, 4.4, 1.2)
	local eyeRight = makePart("EyeRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), model)
	eyeRight.Position = position + Vector3.new(0.6, 4.4, 1.2)

	buildAccessory(def, model, body, head)

	-- Feet so the character reads as walking along the path.
	local footLeft = makePart("FootLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1, 0.6, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), model)
	footLeft.Position = position + Vector3.new(-0.8, 0.3, 0)
	local footRight = makePart("FootRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1, 0.6, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), model)
	footRight.Position = position + Vector3.new(0.8, 0.3, 0)

	-- Name / rarity label floating above the head.
	local labelGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	labelGui.Name = "BrainrotLabel"
	labelGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 50)
	labelGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
	labelGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	labelGui.Adornee = head
	labelGui.Parent = model

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.55, 0)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = def.name
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextScaled = true
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	nameLabel.Parent = labelGui

	local rarityLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	rarityLabel.Name = "RarityLabel"
	rarityLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.55, 0)
	rarityLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
	rarityLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local labelText = def.rarity .. "  $" .. tostring(def.rate) .. "/s  " .. BrainrotData.formatMoney(def.cost)
	if mutation ~= "Normal" then
		labelText = mutation .. " " .. labelText
	end
	rarityLabel.Text = labelText
	rarityLabel.TextColor3 = BrainrotData.RARITY_COLORS[def.rarity]
	rarityLabel.TextScaled = true
	rarityLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	rarityLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	rarityLabel.Parent = labelGui

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	model:SetAttribute("BrainrotName", def.name)
	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", def.rarity)
	model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation)
	model:SetAttribute("Cost", def.cost)

	return model
end

-- The Noob Nabber thief: a plain yellow noob with a grabby look.
function BrainrotFactory.buildThief(position)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "NoobNabber"

	local body = makePart("Body", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(3, 3, 2), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0), model)
	body.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	body.CanCollide = true

	local head = makePart("Head", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0), model)
	head.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 4.1, 0)

	local eyeLeft = makePart("EyeLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), model)
	eyeLeft.Position = position + Vector3.new(-0.55, 4.3, 1.1)
	local eyeRight = makePart("EyeRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), model)
	eyeRight.Position = position + Vector3.new(0.55, 4.3, 1.1)

	-- A red bandit mask stripe across the face.
	local mask = makePart("Mask", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.2, 0.6, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30), model)
	mask.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 4.3, 1.1)

	local labelGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	labelGui.Name = "ThiefLabel"
	labelGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 30)
	labelGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
	labelGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	labelGui.Adornee = head
	labelGui.Parent = model

	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Text = "Noob Nabber! SLAP HIM!"
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
	text.TextScaled = true
	text.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	text.Parent = labelGui

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

return BrainrotFactory

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    local function openTab(TabBar: Types.TabBar, Index: number)
        if TabBar.state.index.value > 0 then
            return
        end

        TabBar.state.index:set(Index)
    end

    local function closeTab(TabBar: Types.TabBar, Index: number)
        if TabBar.state.index.value ~= Index then
            return
        end

        -- search left for open tabs
        for i = Index - 1, 1, -1 do
            if TabBar.Tabs[i].state.isOpened.value == true then
                TabBar.state.index:set(i)
                return
            end
        end

        -- search right for open tabs
        for i = Index, #TabBar.Tabs do
            if TabBar.Tabs[i].state.isOpened.value == true then
                TabBar.state.index:set(i)
                return
            end
        end

        -- no open tabs, so wait for one
        TabBar.state.index:set(0)
    end

    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("TabBar", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = true,
        Args = {},
        Events = {},
        Generate = function(thisWidget: Types.TabBar)
            local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame")
            TabBar.Name = "Iris_TabBar"
            TabBar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            TabBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            TabBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TabBar.BorderSizePixel = 0

            widgets.UIListLayout(TabBar, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new()).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
            
            local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            Bar.Name = "Bar"
            Bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            Bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            Bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            
            widgets.UIListLayout(Bar, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemInnerSpacing.X))

            Bar.Parent = TabBar

            local Underline = Instance.new("Frame")
            Underline.Name = "Underline"
            Underline.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
            Underline.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TabActiveColor
            Underline.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TabActiveTransparency
            Underline.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Underline.LayoutOrder = 1

            Underline.Parent = TabBar

            local ChildContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
            ChildContainer.Name = "TabContainer"
            ChildContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            ChildContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            ChildContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ChildContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ChildContainer.LayoutOrder = 2
            ChildContainer.ClipsDescendants = true

            ChildContainer.Parent = TabBar

            thisWidget.ChildContainer = ChildContainer
            thisWidget.Tabs = {}

            return TabBar
        end,
        Update = function(_thisWidget: Types.TabBar) end,
        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.TabBar, thisChild: Types.Tab)
            assert(thisChild.type == "Tab", "Only Iris.Tab can be parented to Iris.TabBar.")
            local TabBar = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            thisChild.ChildContainer.Parent = thisWidget.ChildContainer
            thisChild.Index = #thisWidget.Tabs + 1
            thisWidget.state.index.ConnectedWidgets[thisChild.ID] = thisChild
            table.insert(thisWidget.Tabs, thisChild)

            return TabBar.Bar
        end,
        ChildDiscarded = function(thisWidget: Types.TabBar, thisChild: Types.Tab)
            local Index = thisChild.Index
            table.remove(thisWidget.Tabs, Index)

            for i = Index, #thisWidget.Tabs do
                thisWidget.Tabs[i].Index = i
            end

            closeTab(thisWidget, Index)
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            if thisWidget.state.index == nil then
                thisWidget.state.index = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "index", 1)
            end
        end,
        UpdateState = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab)
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.TabBar)
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)

    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("Tab", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = true,
        Args = {
            ["Text"] = 1,
            ["Hideable"] = 2,
        },
        Events = {
            ["clicked"] = widgets.EVENTS.click(function(thisWidget: Types.Widget)
                return thisWidget.Instance
            end),
            ["hovered"] = widgets.EVENTS.hover(function(thisWidget: Types.Widget)
                return thisWidget.Instance
            end),
            ["selected"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
                    return thisWidget.lastSelectedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
            ["unselected"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
                    return thisWidget.lastUnselectedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
            ["active"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
                    return thisWidget.state.index.value == thisWidget.Index
                end,
            },
            ["opened"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
                    return thisWidget.lastOpenedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
            ["closed"] = {
                ["Init"] = function(_thisWidget: Types.Tab) end,
                ["Get"] = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
                    return thisWidget.lastClosedTick == Iris._cycleTick
                end,
            },
        },
        Generate = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            local Tab = Instance.new("TextButton")
            Tab.Name = "Iris_Tab"
            Tab.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            Tab.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TabColor
            Tab.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TabTransparency
            Tab.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Tab.Text = ""
            Tab.AutoButtonColor = false

            thisWidget.ButtonColors = {
                Color = Iris._config.TabColor,
                Transparency = Iris._config.TabTransparency,
                HoveredColor = Iris._config.TabHoveredColor,
                HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.TabHoveredTransparency,
                ActiveColor = Iris._config.TabActiveColor,
                ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.TabActiveTransparency,
            }

            widgets.UIPadding(Tab, Vector2.new(Iris._config.FramePadding.X, 0))
            widgets.applyFrameStyle(Tab, true, true)
            widgets.UIListLayout(Tab, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemInnerSpacing.X)).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", Tab, Tab, thisWidget.ButtonColors)
            widgets.applyButtonClick(Tab, function()
                thisWidget.state.index:set(thisWidget.Index)
            end)

            local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            TextLabel.Name = "TextLabel"
            TextLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
            TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0

            widgets.applyTextStyle(TextLabel)
            widgets.UIPadding(TextLabel, Vector2.new(0, Iris._config.FramePadding.Y))

            TextLabel.Parent = Tab

            local ButtonSize = Iris._config.TextSize + ((Iris._config.FramePadding.Y - 1) * 2)

            local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
            CloseButton.Name = "CloseButton"
            CloseButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ButtonSize, ButtonSize)
            CloseButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            CloseButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
            CloseButton.Text = ""
            CloseButton.AutoButtonColor = false
            CloseButton.LayoutOrder = 1

            widgets.UICorner(CloseButton)
            widgets.applyButtonClick(CloseButton, function()
                thisWidget.state.isOpened:set(false)
                closeTab(thisWidget.parentWidget, thisWidget.Index)
            end)

            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", CloseButton, CloseButton, {
                Color = Iris._config.TabColor,
                Transparency = 1,
                HoveredColor = Iris._config.ButtonHoveredColor,
                HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.ButtonHoveredTransparency,
                ActiveColor = Iris._config.ButtonActiveColor,
                ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.ButtonActiveTransparency,
            })

            CloseButton.Parent = Tab

            local Icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            Icon.Name = "Icon"
            Icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            Icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(0.7 * ButtonSize), math.floor(0.7 * ButtonSize))
            Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Icon.Image = widgets.ICONS.MULTIPLICATION_SIGN
            Icon.ImageTransparency = 1

            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Image", Tab, Icon, {
                Color = Iris._config.TextColor,
                Transparency = 1,
                HoveredColor = Iris._config.TextColor,
                HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.TextTransparency,
                ActiveColor = Iris._config.TextColor,
                ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.TextTransparency,
            })
            Icon.Parent = CloseButton

            local ChildContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
            ChildContainer.Name = "TabContainer"
            ChildContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            ChildContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            ChildContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ChildContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
            
            ChildContainer.ClipsDescendants = true
            widgets.UIListLayout(ChildContainer, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new(0, Iris._config.ItemSpacing.Y))
            widgets.UIPadding(ChildContainer, Vector2.new(0, Iris._config.ItemSpacing.Y)).PaddingBottom = UDim.new()

            thisWidget.ChildContainer = ChildContainer

            return Tab
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            local Tab = thisWidget.Instance :: TextButton
            local TextLabel: TextLabel = Tab.TextLabel
            local CloseButton: TextButton = Tab.CloseButton

            TextLabel.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Text
            CloseButton.Visible = if thisWidget.arguments.Hideable == true then true else false
        end,
        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab, _thisChild: Types.Widget)
            return thisWidget.ChildContainer
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            thisWidget.state.index = thisWidget.parentWidget.state.index
            thisWidget.state.index.ConnectedWidgets[thisWidget.ID] = thisWidget

            if thisWidget.state.isOpened == nil then
                thisWidget.state.isOpened = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "isOpened", true)
            end
        end,
        UpdateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            local Tab = thisWidget.Instance :: TextButton
            local Container = thisWidget.ChildContainer :: Frame

            if thisWidget.state.isOpened.lastChangeTick == Iris._cycleTick then
                if thisWidget.state.isOpened.value == true then
                    thisWidget.lastOpenedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
                    openTab(thisWidget.parentWidget, thisWidget.Index)
                    Tab.Visible = true
                else
                    thisWidget.lastClosedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
                    closeTab(thisWidget.parentWidget, thisWidget.Index)
                    Tab.Visible = false
                end
            end

            if thisWidget.state.index.lastChangeTick == Iris._cycleTick then
                if thisWidget.state.index.value == thisWidget.Index then
                    thisWidget.ButtonColors.Color = Iris._config.TabActiveColor
                    thisWidget.ButtonColors.Transparency = Iris._config.TabActiveTransparency
            Tab.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TabActiveColor
                    Tab.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TabActiveTransparency
                    Container.Visible = true
                    thisWidget.lastSelectedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
                else
                    thisWidget.ButtonColors.Color = Iris._config.TabColor
                    thisWidget.ButtonColors.Transparency = Iris._config.TabTransparency
                    Tab.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TabColor
                    Tab.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TabTransparency
                    Container.Visible = false
                    thisWidget.lastUnselectedTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
                end
            end
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.Tab)
            if thisWidget.state.isOpened.value == true then
                closeTab(thisWidget.parentWidget, thisWidget.Index)
            end
            
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
            thisWidget.ChildContainer:Destroy()
            widgets.discardState(thisWidget)
        end
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)
end

-- GameServer: Brainrot Base Rush.
-- Spawning (every ~6s a brainrot walks the path from the portal to the
-- base), buying on touch, per-second earnings, the Brainrot Tsunami wave
-- every ~90s, the Noob Nabber thief every ~75s, and Rebirth at $25,000
-- lifetime earned. HUD state is pushed to clients once a second.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService") -- tsunami wall sweep
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))
local BrainrotFactory = require(script:WaitForChild("BrainrotFactory"))

-- Remotes (created here so the place file needs no hand-made instances).
local updateHud = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
updateHud.Name = "UpdateHUD"
updateHud.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local announceEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
announceEvent.Name = "Announce"
announceEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local slapEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
slapEvent.Name = "SlapHit"
slapEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local rebirthEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
rebirthEvent.Name = "RequestRebirth"
rebirthEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- World landmarks (must match the Parts in default.project.json).
local PORTAL_POS = Vector3.new(0, 0, -80)
local BASE_CENTER = Vector3.new(0, 2, 70)
local WAYPOINTS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 0, -40),
	Vector3.new(25, 0, -20),
	Vector3.new(25, 0, 20),
	Vector3.new(0, 0, 50),
}
local SLOT_POSITIONS = {}
for row = 1, 2 do
	for col = 1, 4 do
		local x = -22.5 + (col - 1) * 15
		local z = 62 + (row - 1) * 16
		table.insert(SLOT_POSITIONS, Vector3.new(x, 2, z))
	end
end

local function inSafeZone(pos)
	return math.abs(pos.X) <= 30 and pos.Z >= 50 and pos.Z <= 90
end

local function announceAll(text, color)
	announceEvent:FireAllClients(text, color)
end

-- Per-player state.
local playerState = {}

local function newState()
	return {
		money = BrainrotData.STARTING_MONEY,
		lifetimeEarned = 0,
		rebirths = 0,
		owned = {},
	}
end

local function earningsMultiplier(state)
	return 1 + BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BONUS * state.rebirths
end

local function incomePerSecond(state)
	local total = 0
	for _, record in ipairs(state.owned) do
		total += record.def.rate * record.mutationMult
	end
	return total * earningsMultiplier(state)
end

local function freeSlot(state)
	for i = 1, BrainrotData.MAX_SLOTS do
		local taken = false
		for _, record in ipairs(state.owned) do
			if record.slot == i then
				taken = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not taken then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function sendHud(player)
	local state = playerState[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	updateHud:FireClient(player, {
		money = state.money,
		rate = incomePerSecond(state),
		count = #state.owned,
		maxSlots = BrainrotData.MAX_SLOTS,
		nextName = nextSpawnDef.name,
		nextRarity = nextSpawnDef.rarity,
		nextMutation = nextSpawnMutation,
		waveIn = waveCountdown,
		thiefActive = thief ~= nil,
		rebirthReady = state.lifetimeEarned >= BrainrotData.REBIRTH_REQUIREMENT,
		lifetimeEarned = state.lifetimeEarned,
		rebirthRequirement = BrainrotData.REBIRTH_REQUIREMENT,
		multiplier = earningsMultiplier(state),
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
	})
end

-- Move + rotate a whole Part-assembled model rigidly around its PrimaryPart.
-- (Model:PivotTo uses the bounding-box pivot, which would sink the model
-- into the ground, so the server moves models through their PrimaryPart.)
local function setModelCFrame(model, cf)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return
	end
	local offset = cf * primary.CFrame:Inverse()
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CFrame = offset * part.CFrame
		end
	end
end

-- Move a model toward a target ground position at the given speed
-- (studs/second), facing its direction of travel. Returns when it arrives.
-- The model's feet stay on the ground: the PrimaryPart rides 1.5 studs up.
local function walkTo(model, target, speed)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return
	end
	while model.Parent ~= nil do
		local current = primary.Position
		local ground = Vector3.new(current.X, 0, current.Z)
		local delta = target - ground
		delta = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
		local distance = delta.Magnitude
		if distance < 0.5 then
			return
		end
		local step = math.min(distance, speed * 0.05)
		local nextGround = ground + delta.Unit * step
		local nextPos = Vector3.new(nextGround.X, 1.5, nextGround.Z)
		local look = CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, nextPos + delta)
		setModelCFrame(model, look)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

-- Smoothly slide a whole model to a target ground position (feet on the
-- ground: the PrimaryPart ends 1.5 studs above the target).
local function tweenModelTo(model, target, seconds)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary or model.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local start = primary.CFrame
	local goal = CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
	local steps = math.max(1, math.floor(seconds / 0.05))
	for i = 1, steps do
		if model.Parent == nil then
			return
		end
		setModelCFrame(model, start:Lerp(goal, i / steps))
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

-- The next brainrot to spawn (pre-rolled so the HUD can preview it).
nextSpawnDef = BrainrotData.pickRandom()
nextSpawnMutation, nextSpawnMult = BrainrotData.rollMutation()

local function rollNextSpawn()
	nextSpawnDef = BrainrotData.pickRandom()
	nextSpawnMutation, nextSpawnMult = BrainrotData.rollMutation()
end

local function tryBuy(player, model, record)
	local state = playerState[player]
	if not state or record.bought then
		return
	end
	if record.def.cost > state.money then
		return
	end
	local slot = freeSlot(state)
	if not slot then
		announceEvent:FireClient(player, "Your base is FULL! Rebirth to grow.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30))
		return
	end
	record.bought = true
	state.money -= record.def.cost
	record.slot = slot
	table.insert(state.owned, record)
	record.model = model
	announceEvent:FireClient(player, "You bought " .. record.def.name .. " for " .. BrainrotData.formatMoney(record.def.cost) .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120))
	task.spawn(function()
		tweenModelTo(model, SLOT_POSITIONS[slot], 1.5)
	end)
end

local function spawnBrainrot()
	local def = nextSpawnDef
	local mutation = nextSpawnMutation
	local mutationMult = nextSpawnMult
	rollNextSpawn()

	local model = BrainrotFactory.build(def, mutation, PORTAL_POS)
	model.Parent = Workspace

	local record = {
		def = def,
		mutation = mutation,
		mutationMult = mutationMult,
		model = model,
		bought = false,
		slot = nil,
	}
	local debounce = {}

	local function onTouched(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if not player then
			return
		end
		if debounce[player] then
			return
		end
		debounce[player] = true
		task.delay(1, function()
			debounce[player] = false
		end)
		tryBuy(player, model, record)
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(onTouched)
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		for _, waypoint in ipairs(WAYPOINTS) do
			if record.bought or model.Parent == nil then
				return
			end
			walkTo(model, waypoint, 7)
		end
		-- Linger at the base entrance so players can still grab it.
		local waited = 0
		while not record.bought and model.Parent ~= nil and waited < 25 do
			task.wait(1)
			waited += 1
		end
		if not record.bought and model.Parent ~= nil then
			model:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- Tsunami wave: a wall sweeps the arena; anyone outside the base loses 10%.
waveCountdown = BrainrotData.WAVE_INTERVAL

local function runWave()
	announceAll("BRAINROT TSUNAMI! Get to your BASE!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
	local wall = Instance.new("Part")
	wall.Name = "TsunamiWall"
	wall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	wall.Size = Vector3.new(220, 30, 4)
	wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 255)
	wall.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	wall.Anchored = true
	wall.CanCollide = false
	wall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 12, -110)
	wall.Parent = Workspace

	local tween = TweenService:Create(wall, TweenInfo.new(4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = Vector3.new(0, 12, 110) })
	tween:Play()

	-- Punish once, as the wall passes the middle of the arena.
	task.wait(2)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and not inSafeZone(root.Position) then
			local state = playerState[player]
			if state then
				local lost = math.floor(state.money * BrainrotData.WAVE_CASH_LOSS)
				state.money = math.max(0, state.money - lost)
				announceEvent:FireClient(player, "The tsunami caught you outside! You lost " .. BrainrotData.formatMoney(lost) .. ".", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
			end
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(BASE_CENTER + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 3, math.random(-8, 8)))
		end
	end
	tween.Completed:Wait()
	wall:Destroy()
	announceAll("The tsunami passed. Your base kept you safe!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
end

-- Noob Nabber thief: runs to a random owned brainrot, channels 3s, steals it
-- unless a player slaps him away with the Slap tool first.
thief = nil

local function spawnThief()
	local candidates = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local state = playerState[player]
		if state and #state.owned > 0 then
			table.insert(candidates, player)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return
	end
	local victim = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local state = playerState[victim]
	local record = state.owned[math.random(1, #state.owned)]

	local model = BrainrotFactory.buildThief(PORTAL_POS)
	model.Parent = Workspace
	thief = { model = model, victim = victim, record = record, channeling = false }
	announceAll("Noob Nabber is coming to STEAL a brainrot! SLAP him with your Slap tool!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))

	task.spawn(function()
		local targetPos = SLOT_POSITIONS[record.slot] + Vector3.new(0, 0, 4)
		walkTo(model, targetPos, 10)
		if thief == nil or thief.model ~= model then
			return
		end
		thief.channeling = true
		announceAll("Noob Nabber is stealing " .. record.def.name .. "! Slap him NOW!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
		local elapsed = 0
		while elapsed < BrainrotData.THIEF_CHANNEL do
			task.wait(0.5)
			elapsed += 0.5
			if thief == nil or thief.model ~= model then
				return
			end
		end
		-- Channel complete: the brainrot is gone.
		if record.model and record.model.Parent ~= nil then
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
		for i, owned in ipairs(state.owned) do
			if owned == record then
				table.remove(state.owned, i)
				break
			end
		end
		announceAll("Noob Nabber stole " .. record.def.name .. " from " .. victim.Name .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
		if model.Parent ~= nil then
			model:Destroy()
		end
		thief = nil
	end)
end

slapEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if thief == nil or thief.model.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local thiefRoot = thief.model.PrimaryPart
	if not root or not thiefRoot then
		return
	end
	if (root.Position - thiefRoot.Position).Magnitude > 15 then
		return
	end
	-- Slap landed: fling the thief away and despawn him.
	local model = thief.model
	thief = nil
	announceAll(player.Name .. " slapped the Noob Nabber away!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120))
	task.spawn(function()
		local start = model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
		local goal = start * CFrame.new(0, 25, -40)
		for i = 1, 16 do
			if model.Parent == nil then
				return
			end
			setModelCFrame(model, start:Lerp(goal, i / 16))
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		if model.Parent ~= nil then
			model:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end)

rebirthEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local state = playerState[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.lifetimeEarned < BrainrotData.REBIRTH_REQUIREMENT then
		return
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(state.owned) do
		if record.model and record.model.Parent ~= nil then
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	state.owned = {}
	state.money = BrainrotData.STARTING_MONEY
	state.rebirths += 1
	announceEvent:FireClient(player, "REBIRTH! Permanent +" .. tostring(math.floor(BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BONUS * 100)) .. "% earnings (x" .. string.format("%.1f", earningsMultiplier(state)) .. ").", Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0))
	sendHud(player)
end)

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	playerState[player] = newState()
	player:LoadCharacter()
	task.spawn(function()
		while player.Parent ~= nil do
			sendHud(player)
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local state = playerState[player]
	if state then
		for _, record in ipairs(state.owned) do
			if record.model and record.model.Parent ~= nil then
				record.model:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	playerState[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Main loops: economy tick, spawning, wave timer, thief timer.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		for player, state in pairs(playerState) do
			local earned = incomePerSecond(state)
			state.money += earned
			state.lifetimeEarned += earned
		end
		waveCountdown -= 1
		if waveCountdown == BrainrotData.WAVE_WARNING then
			announceAll("BRAINROT TSUNAMI in 10 seconds! Get to your BASE!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30))
		elseif waveCountdown <= 0 then
			waveCountdown = BrainrotData.WAVE_INTERVAL
			task.spawn(runWave)
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(BrainrotData.SPAWN_INTERVAL)
		spawnBrainrot()
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(BrainrotData.THIEF_INTERVAL)
		spawnThief()
	end
end)

print("Brainrot Base Rush server ready.")
