-- Fx: the feel of the game, driven entirely by server events. A particle burst in the rarity colour
-- when something is dredged, taken or stolen; a camera shake and a full-screen colour flash when the
-- player is swallowed by the tide. No audio, no wall-clock guesses about game state.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Rarity colours, mirroring the server's Config.RarityColors.
local RARITY_COLORS = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205),
	Uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(85, 175, 80),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(175, 80, 255),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
	Mythic = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
	Secret = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200),
}

local BURST_COUNT = 18
local BURST_LIFETIME = 0.7 -- seconds a burst particle lives

-- ---------- build ----------
-- Creates the full-screen flash overlay and returns a handle with the effect methods.
local function build()
	local handle = {}

	-- Full-screen colour flash (used for the swallow). Starts invisible.
	local flashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	flashGui.Name = "BogFx"
	flashGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	flashGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	flashGui.DisplayOrder = 10
	flashGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Name = "Flash"
	flash.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	flash.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 75, 40)
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.ZIndex = 50
	flash.Parent = flashGui

	handle.flash = flash
	handle.flashGui = flashGui
	handle.shake = nil -- set while a shake is running

	-- ---------- burst ----------
	-- A short particle burst in the rarity colour at a world position.
	-- Pass a Vector3 for where the event happened (the character, pedestal, or victim's raft).
	function handle.burst(position, rarity)
		local color = RARITY_COLORS[rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
		local basePart = Instance.new("Part")
		basePart.Name = "BurstBase"
		basePart.Anchored = true
		basePart.CanCollide = false
		basePart.CanQuery = false
		basePart.CanTouch = false
		basePart.Transparency = 1
		basePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		basePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		basePart.Parent = workspace

		for i = 1, BURST_COUNT do
			local p = Instance.new("Part")
			p.Name = "Spark"
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.CanQuery = false
			p.CanTouch = false
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			p.Color = color
			p.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
			p.CFrame = basePart.CFrame
			p.Parent = workspace

			-- A random outward velocity, biased upward so it reads as a pop.
			local dir = Vector3.new(
				math.random() * 2 - 1,
				math.random() * 1.4 + 0.4,
				math.random() * 2 - 1
			).Unit
			local speed = 8 + math.random() * 8
			local goal = basePart.Position + dir * speed * BURST_LIFETIME * 0.6 + Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)

			local tween = TweenService:Create(
				p,
				TweenInfo.new(BURST_LIFETIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ Position = goal, Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05) }
			)
			tween:Play()
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				p:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		-- Clean the invisible base up once the burst is done.
		task.delay(BURST_LIFETIME + 0.1, function()
			basePart:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	-- ---------- shake + flash (the swallow) ----------
	-- Camera shake plus a full-screen brown flash. Runs entirely off the Swallowed event.
	function handle.swallow()
		-- Flash: snap opaque, then fade out.
		handle.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
		local fade = TweenService:Create(
			handle.flash,
			TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
		)
		fade:Play()

		-- Shake: an offset that decays to zero over ~0.6s, applied every render step.
		local duration = 0.6
		local magnitude = 2.2
		local elapsed = 0
		if handle.shakeConn then
			handle.shakeConn:Disconnect()
			handle.shakeConn = nil
		end
		-- The default camera rewrites camera.CFrame from its own state every frame, so applying a
		-- fresh small offset each RenderStepped does not accumulate into drift.
		handle.shakeConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			elapsed += dt
			if elapsed >= duration then
				if handle.shakeConn then
					handle.shakeConn:Disconnect()
					handle.shakeConn = nil
				end
				return
			end
			-- The offset shrinks as the shake runs out.
			local strength = magnitude * (1 - elapsed / duration)
			local offset = Vector3.new(
				(math.random() * 2 - 1) * strength,
				(math.random() * 2 - 1) * strength,
				0
			)
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		end)
	end

	return handle
end

-- ---------- update ----------
-- Fx has nothing to redraw from a state table; the handle is provided for symmetry with Hud.
local function update(handle, state)
	-- Intentionally empty: Fx is event-driven only.
end

return {
	build = build,
	update = update,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("Fixture")

local function load(player)
	local coins = store:GetAsync(player.UserId) or 0 --! datastore-no-pcall
	return coins
end

local function save(player)
	store:SetAsync(player.UserId, 5) --! datastore-no-pcall
end

local function safeSave(player)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(player.UserId, function(old)
			return (old or 0) + 1
		end)
	end)
	return ok, err
end

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	load(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(load)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) --! datastore-no-bindtoclose
	save(player)
	safeSave(player)
end)

-- ---------- Helpers ----------
-- Format a whole number with a dollar sign and comma thousands separators.
local function money(n)
	n = math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0)
	local whole = tostring(n)
	local neg = string.sub(whole, 1, 1) == "-"
	if neg then whole = string.sub(whole, 2) end
	local out = ""
	local count = 0
	for i = #whole, 1, -1 do
		out = string.sub(whole, i, i) .. out
		count += 1
		if count % 3 == 0 and i > 1 then
			out = "," .. out
		end
	end
	return (neg and "-$" or "$") .. out
end

-- A plain TextLabel with the common defaults filled in.
local function label(name, parent, text, color, size)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Name = name
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Text = text
	t.TextColor3 = color
	t.Font = FONT
	t.TextSize = size or 20
	t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
	t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	t.Parent = parent
	return t
end

	baronTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24)
	baronTitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 54)
	baronTitle.TextScaled = true -- must fit a fixed box

	handle.baronSubtitle = label("BaronSubtitle", baronCard, "You dredged the bog dry.", Color3.fromRGB(220, 210, 240), 22)
	handle.baronSubtitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	handle.baronSubtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 86)
	handle.baronSubtitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 28)

	handle.baronRebirths = label("BaronRebirths", baronCard, "Rebirths: 0", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120), 26)
	handle.baronRebirths.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	handle.baronRebirths.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 140)
	handle.baronRebirths.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 32)

	handle.baronEarned = label("BaronEarned", baronCard, "Total earned: $0", Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 160), 26)
	handle.baronEarned.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	handle.baronEarned.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 184)
	handle.baronEarned.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 32)

	handle.baronBest = label("BaronBest", baronCard, "Best catch: none", Color3.fromRGB(210, 200, 255), 24)
	handle.baronBest.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	handle.baronBest.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 240)
	handle.baronBest.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 60)
	handle.baronBest.TextWrapped = true

	-- Close button.
	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Name = "Close"
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 330)
	close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 48)
	close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 140)
	close.Text = "Close"
	close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 220)
	close.Font = FONT
	close.TextSize = 24
	close.Parent = baronCard
	local cc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	cc.Parent = close
	close.Activated:Connect(function()
		baron.Visible = false
	end)

	handle.baron = baron
	handle.baronCard = baronCard

	-- ---------- handle methods ----------
	-- A lighter cash update between full syncs; the server's CashTick sends just the number.
	function handle.updateCash(cash)
		if type(cash) ~= "number" then return end
		handle.cashLabel.Text = money(cash)
	end

	-- One alert card: colour-coded by kind, fades out, stacked by the UIListLayout.
	function handle.showAlert(kind, title, body)
		local color = ALERT_COLORS[kind] or ALERT_COLORS.info
		local card = panel("Alert", alertStack, Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20))
		card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 64)
		card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20)
		card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2

		local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
		accent.Name = "Accent"
		accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		accent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, 0)
		accent.BackgroundColor3 = color
		accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
		accent.Parent = card
		local ac = Instance.new("UICorner")
		ac.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
		ac.Parent = accent

		local t = label("Title", card, title, color, 20)
		t.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 8)
		t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(372, 24)

		local b = label("Body", card, body or "", Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220), 17)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 34)
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(372, 22)
		b.TextWrapped = true

		local entry = { frame = card, born = os.clock(), fading = false }
		table.insert(handle.alerts, entry)
		-- Cap the stack so a burst of alerts cannot fill the screen.
		while #handle.alerts > 5 do
			local old = table.remove(handle.alerts, 1)
			if old.frame then old.frame:Destroy() end
		end
	end

	-- The Mud Tide banner across the middle. phase = "warning" | "sweep" | "drain".
	-- The server drives this entirely through the TideHorn phase event; no wall-clock guess.
	function handle.setTide(phase)
		handle.tidePhase = phase
		if phase == "warning" then
			handle.tideBanner.Visible = true
			handle.tideBannerTitle.Text = "MUD TIDE INCOMING - GET TO A RAFT"
			handle.tideBannerTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120)
			handle.tideDuration = TIDE.Warning
			handle.tideDeadline = os.clock() + TIDE.Warning
		elseif phase == "sweep" then
			handle.tideBanner.Visible = true
			handle.tideBannerTitle.Text = "THE MUD TIDE SWEEPS"
			handle.tideBannerTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 90)
			handle.tideDuration = TIDE.SweepDuration
			handle.tideDeadline = os.clock() + TIDE.SweepDuration
		elseif phase == "drain" then
			-- The tide is over: hide the banner and restart the calm countdown.
			handle.tideBanner.Visible = false
			handle.tideDuration = TIDE.Interval
			handle.tideDeadline = os.clock() + TIDE.Interval
			handle.tideCountdown.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 170)
		end
	end

	-- The Bog Baron full-screen overlay, filled from the latest state the server sent.
	function handle.showBogBaron()
		local s = handle.lastState
		handle.baronRebirths.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(s and s.rebirths or 0)
		handle.baronEarned.Text = "Total earned: " .. money(s and s.totalEarned or 0)
		local bestText = "Best catch: none yet"
		if s and s.bestName then
			local rc = RARITY_COLORS[s.bestRarity] or Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
			handle.baronBest.TextColor3 = rc
			bestText = "Best catch: " .. s.bestName .. " (" .. tostring(s.bestRarity) .. ")"
		else
			handle.baronBest.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
		end
		handle.baronBest.Text = bestText
		handle.baron.Visible = true
	end

	-- ---------- the per-frame countdown + alert fade loop ----------
	local conns = {}
	conns[1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Tide countdown: only counts while a calm deadline is set (drain phase or startup).
		if handle.tideDeadline then
			local remain = handle.tideDeadline - now
			if handle.tidePhase == "drain" or handle.tidePhase == nil then
				if remain <= 0 then
					handle.tideCountdown.Text = "ANY MOMENT"
				else
					local secs = math.ceil(remain)
					handle.tideCountdown.Text = string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
				end
			end
		end

		-- Tide banner shrinking bar.
		if handle.tideBanner.Visible and handle.tideDeadline then
			local remain = handle.tideDeadline - now
			local frac = remain / handle.tideDuration
			frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
			handle.tideBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, 1)
			if remain <= 0 then
				handle.tideBanner.Visible = false
			end
		end

		-- Alert fade-out.
		for i = #handle.alerts, 1, -1 do
			local a = handle.alerts[i]
			local age = now - a.born
			if not a.fading and age >= ALERT_LIFETIME then
				a.fading = true
			end
			if a.fading then
				local t = math.clamp((age - ALERT_LIFETIME) / ALERT_FADE, 0, 1)
				a.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * t
				for _, d in ipairs(a.frame:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
						d.TextTransparency = t
						d.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6 + 0.4 * t
					elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
						d.BackgroundTransparency = t
					end
				end
				if t >= 1 then
					a.frame:Destroy()
					table.remove(handle.alerts, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	handle.connections = conns
	return handle
end

-- ---------- update ----------
-- Takes a handle and a state table (exactly what the server sent) and redraws everything.
local function update(handle, state)
	if not handle or not state then return end
	handle.lastState = state

	handle.cashLabel.Text = money(state.cash)
	handle.rateLabel.Text = money(state.perSecond) .. " / second"

	local used = state.placed and #state.placed or 0
	handle.deckLabel.Text = "Deck " .. tostring(used) .. " / " .. tostring(state.deckSlotsOwned or 0)

	local rebirths = state.rebirths or 0
	local pct = math.floor(((state.multiplier or 1) - 1) * 100 + 0.5)
	handle.rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths " .. tostring(rebirths) .. "  (+" .. tostring(pct) .. "%)"

	if state.rebirthReady then
		handle.rebirthReady.Text = "REBIRTH READY at the Toll Booth"
		handle.rebirthReady.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 120)
	else
		handle.rebirthReady.Text = ""
	end
end

return {
	build = build,
	update = update,
}

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

-- Tables need an overhaul.

--[[
	Iris.Table(
		{
			NumColumns,
			Header,
			RowBackground,
			OuterBorders,
			InnerBorders
		}
	)

	Config = {
		CellPadding: Vector2,
		CellSize: UDim2,
	}

	Iris.NextColumn()
	Iris.NextRow()
	Iris.SetColumnIndex(index: number)
	Iris.SetRowIndex(index: number)

	Iris.NextHeaderColumn()
	Iris.SetHeaderColumnIndex(index: number)

	Iris.SetColumnWidth(index: number, width: number | UDim)
]]

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    local Tables: { [Types.ID]: Types.Table } = {}
    local TableMinWidths: { [Types.Table]: { boolean } } = {}
    local AnyActiveTable = false
    local ActiveTable: Types.Table? = nil
    local ActiveColumn = 0
    local ActiveLeftWidth = -1
    local ActiveRightWidth = -1
    local MousePositionX = 0

    local function CalculateMinColumnWidth(thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number)
        local width = 0
        for _, row in thisWidget._cellInstances do
            local cell = row[index]
            for _, child in cell:GetChildren() do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    width = math.max(width, child.AbsoluteSize.X)
                end
            end
        end

        thisWidget._minWidths[index] = width + 2 * Iris._config.CellPadding.X
    end

    table.insert(Iris._postCycleCallbacks, function()
        for _, thisWidget in Tables do
            for rowIndex, cycleTick in thisWidget._rowCycles do
                if cycleTick < Iris._cycleTick - 1 then
                    local Row = thisWidget._rowInstances[rowIndex]
                    local RowBorder = thisWidget._rowBorders[rowIndex - 1]
                    if Row ~= nil then
                        Row:Destroy()
                    end
                    if RowBorder ~= nil then
                        RowBorder:Destroy()
                    end
                    thisWidget._rowInstances[rowIndex] = nil
                    thisWidget._rowBorders[rowIndex - 1] = nil
                    thisWidget._cellInstances[rowIndex] = nil
                    thisWidget._rowCycles[rowIndex] = nil
                end
            end

            thisWidget._rowIndex = 1
            thisWidget._columnIndex = 1

            -- update the border container size to be the same, albeit *every* frame!
            local Table = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            if Table.Parent == nil then
                continue
            end
            local BorderContainer: Frame = Table.BorderContainer
            BorderContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thisWidget._rowContainer.AbsoluteSize.Y)
            thisWidget._columnBorders[0].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, thisWidget._rowContainer.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        end

        for thisWidget, columns in TableMinWidths do
            local refresh = false
            for column, _ in columns do
                CalculateMinColumnWidth(thisWidget, column)
                refresh = true
            end
            if refresh then
                table.clear(columns)
                Iris._widgets["Table"].UpdateState(thisWidget)
            end
        end
    end)

    local function UpdateActiveColumn()
        if AnyActiveTable == false or ActiveTable == nil then
            return
        end

        local widths = ActiveTable.state.widths
        local NumColumns = ActiveTable.arguments.NumColumns
        local Table = ActiveTable.Instance :: Frame
        local BorderContainer = Table.BorderContainer :: Frame
        local Fixed = ActiveTable.arguments.FixedWidth
        local Padding = 2 * Iris._config.CellPadding.X

        if ActiveLeftWidth == -1 then
            ActiveLeftWidth = widths.value[ActiveColumn]
            if ActiveLeftWidth == 0 then
                ActiveLeftWidth = Padding / Table.AbsoluteSize.X
            end
            ActiveRightWidth = widths.value[ActiveColumn + 1] or -1
            if ActiveRightWidth == 0 then
                ActiveRightWidth = Padding / Table.AbsoluteSize.X
            end
        end

        local BorderX = Table.AbsolutePosition.X
        local LeftX: number -- the start of the current column
        -- local CurrentX: number = BorderContainer:FindFirstChild(`Border_{ActiveColumn}`).AbsolutePosition.X + 3 - BorderX -- the current column position
        local RightX: number -- the end of the next column
        if ActiveColumn == 1 then
            LeftX = 0
        else
            LeftX = math.floor(BorderContainer:FindFirstChild(`Border_{ActiveColumn - 1}`).AbsolutePosition.X + 3 - BorderX)
        end
        if ActiveColumn >= NumColumns - 1 then
            RightX = Table.AbsoluteSize.X
        else
            RightX = math.floor(BorderContainer:FindFirstChild(`Border_{ActiveColumn + 1}`).AbsolutePosition.X + 3 - BorderX)
        end

        local TableX: number = BorderX - widgets.GuiOffset.X
        local DeltaX: number = math.clamp(widgets.getMouseLocation().X, LeftX + TableX + Padding, RightX + TableX - Padding) - MousePositionX
        local LeftOffset = (MousePositionX - TableX) - LeftX
        local LeftRatio = ActiveLeftWidth / LeftOffset

        if Fixed then
            widths.value[ActiveColumn] = math.clamp(math.round(ActiveLeftWidth + DeltaX), Padding, Table.AbsoluteSize.X - LeftX)
        else
            local Change = LeftRatio * DeltaX
            widths.value[ActiveColumn] = math.clamp(ActiveLeftWidth + Change, 0, (RightX - LeftX - Padding) / Table.AbsoluteSize.X)
            if ActiveColumn < NumColumns then
                widths.value[ActiveColumn + 1] = math.clamp(ActiveRightWidth - Change, 0, 1)
            end
        end

        widths:set(widths.value, true)
    end

    local function ColumnMouseDown(thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number)
        AnyActiveTable = true
        ActiveTable = thisWidget
        ActiveColumn = index
        ActiveLeftWidth = -1
        ActiveRightWidth = -1
        MousePositionX = widgets.getMouseLocation().X
    end

    widgets.registerEvent("InputChanged", function()
        if not Iris._started then
            return
        end
        UpdateActiveColumn()
    end)

    widgets.registerEvent("InputEnded", function(inputObject: InputObject)
        if not Iris._started then
            return
        end
        if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and AnyActiveTable then
            AnyActiveTable = false
            ActiveTable = nil
            ActiveColumn = 0
            ActiveLeftWidth = -1
            ActiveRightWidth = -1
            MousePositionX = 0
        end
    end)

    local function GenerateCell(_thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number, width: UDim, header: boolean)
        local Cell: TextButton
        if header then
            Cell = Instance.new("TextButton")
            Cell.Text = ""
            Cell.AutoButtonColor = false
        else
            Cell = (Instance.new("Frame") :: GuiObject) :: TextButton
        end
        Cell.Name = `Cell_{index}`
        Cell.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        Cell.Size = UDim2.new(width, UDim.new())
        Cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Cell.ZIndex = index
        Cell.LayoutOrder = index
        Cell.ClipsDescendants = true

        if header then
            widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", Cell, Cell, {
                Color = Iris._config.HeaderColor,
                Transparency = 1,
                HoveredColor = Iris._config.HeaderHoveredColor,
                HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.HeaderHoveredTransparency,
                ActiveColor = Iris._config.HeaderActiveColor,
                ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.HeaderActiveTransparency,
            })
        end

        widgets.UIPadding(Cell, Iris._config.CellPadding)
        widgets.UIListLayout(Cell, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new())
        widgets.UISizeConstraint(Cell, Vector2.new(2 * Iris._config.CellPadding.X, 0))

        return Cell
    end

    local function GenerateColumnBorder(thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number, style: "Light" | "Strong")
        local Border = Instance.new("ImageButton")
        Border.Name = `Border_{index}`
        Border.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, 0)
        Border.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Border.Image = ""
        Border.ImageTransparency = 1
        Border.AutoButtonColor = false
        Border.ZIndex = index
        Border.LayoutOrder = 2 * index

        local offset = if index == thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns then 3 else 2

        local Line = Instance.new("Frame")
        Line.Name = "Line"
        Line.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
        Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
        Line.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Color`]
        Line.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Transparency`]
        Line.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Line.Parent = Border

        local Hover = Instance.new("Frame")
        Hover.Name = "Hover"
        Hover.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
        Hover.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
        Hover.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Color`]
        Hover.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Transparency`]
        Hover.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Hover.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.Resizable

        Hover.Parent = Border

        widgets.applyInteractionHighlights("Background", Border, Hover, {
            Color = Iris._config.ResizeGripColor,
            Transparency = 1,
            HoveredColor = Iris._config.ResizeGripHoveredColor,
            HoveredTransparency = Iris._config.ResizeGripHoveredTransparency,
            ActiveColor = Iris._config.ResizeGripActiveColor,
            ActiveTransparency = Iris._config.ResizeGripActiveTransparency,
        })

        widgets.applyButtonDown(Border, function()
            if thisWidget.arguments.Resizable then
                ColumnMouseDown(thisWidget, index)
            end
        end)

        return Border
    end

    -- creates a new row and all columns, and adds all to the table's row and cell instance tables, but does not parent
    local function GenerateRow(thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number)
        local Row: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Row.Name = `Row_{index}`
        Row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        Row.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
        if index == 0 then
            Row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableHeaderColor
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableHeaderTransparency
        elseif thisWidget.arguments.RowBackground == true then
            if (index % 2) == 0 then
                Row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableRowBgAltColor
                Row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableRowBgAltTransparency
            else
                Row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableRowBgColor
                Row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableRowBgTransparency
            end
        else
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        end
        Row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Row.ZIndex = 2 * index - 1
        Row.LayoutOrder = 2 * index - 1
        Row.ClipsDescendants = true

        widgets.UIListLayout(Row, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new())

        thisWidget._cellInstances[index] = table.create(thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns)
        for columnIndex = 1, thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns do
            local Cell = GenerateCell(thisWidget, columnIndex, thisWidget._widths[columnIndex], index == 0)
            Cell.Parent = Row
            thisWidget._cellInstances[index][columnIndex] = Cell
        end

        thisWidget._rowInstances[index] = Row

        return Row
    end

    local function GenerateRowBorder(_thisWidget: Types.Table, index: number, style: "Light" | "Strong")
        local Border = Instance.new("Frame")
        Border.Name = `Border_{index}`
        Border.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
        Border.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Border.ZIndex = 2 * index
        Border.LayoutOrder = 2 * index

        local Line = Instance.new("Frame")
        Line.Name = "Line"
        Line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        Line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
        Line.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Color`]
        Line.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config[`TableBorder{style}Transparency`]
        Line.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Line.Parent = Border

        return Border
    end

    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("Table", {
        hasState = true,
        hasChildren = true,
        Args = {
            NumColumns = 1,
            Header = 2,
            RowBackground = 3,
            OuterBorders = 4,
            InnerBorders = 5,
            Resizable = 6,
            FixedWidth = 7,
            ProportionalWidth = 8,
            LimitTableWidth = 9,
        },
        Events = {},
        Generate = function(thisWidget: Types.Table)
            Tables[thisWidget.ID] = thisWidget
            TableMinWidths[thisWidget] = {}

            local Table = Instance.new("Frame")
            Table.Name = "Iris_Table"
            Table.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            Table.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            Table.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            local RowContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
            RowContainer.Name = "RowContainer"
            RowContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            RowContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
            RowContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            RowContainer.ZIndex = 1

            widgets.UISizeConstraint(RowContainer)
            widgets.UIListLayout(RowContainer, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, UDim.new())

            RowContainer.Parent = Table
			thisWidget._rowContainer = RowContainer

            local BorderContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
            BorderContainer.Name = "BorderContainer"
            BorderContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            BorderContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            BorderContainer.ZIndex = 2
            BorderContainer.ClipsDescendants = true

            widgets.UISizeConstraint(BorderContainer)            
            widgets.UIListLayout(BorderContainer, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, UDim.new())
            widgets.UIStroke(BorderContainer, 1, Iris._config.TableBorderStrongColor, Iris._config.TableBorderStrongTransparency)

            BorderContainer.Parent = Table

            thisWidget._columnIndex = 1
            thisWidget._rowIndex = 1
            thisWidget._rowInstances = {}
            thisWidget._cellInstances = {}
            thisWidget._rowBorders = {}
            thisWidget._columnBorders = {}
            thisWidget._rowCycles = {}

            local callbackIndex = #Iris._postCycleCallbacks + 1
            local desiredCycleTick = Iris._cycleTick + 1
            Iris._postCycleCallbacks[callbackIndex] = function()
                if Iris._cycleTick >= desiredCycleTick then
                    if thisWidget.lastCycleTick ~= -1 then
                        thisWidget.state.widths.lastChangeTick = Iris._cycleTick
                        Iris._widgets["Table"].UpdateState(thisWidget)
                    end
                    Iris._postCycleCallbacks[callbackIndex] = nil
                end
            end

            return Table
        end,
        GenerateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Table)
            local NumColumns = thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns
            if thisWidget.state.widths == nil then
                local Widths: { number } = table.create(NumColumns, 1 / NumColumns)
                thisWidget.state.widths = Iris._widgetState(thisWidget, "widths", Widths)
            end
            thisWidget._widths = table.create(NumColumns, UDim.new())
            thisWidget._minWidths = table.create(NumColumns, 0)

            local Table = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local BorderContainer: Frame = Table.BorderContainer

            thisWidget._cellInstances[-1] = table.create(NumColumns)
            for index = 1, NumColumns do
                local Border = GenerateColumnBorder(thisWidget, index, "Light")
                Border.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders
                thisWidget._columnBorders[index] = Border
                Border.Parent = BorderContainer

                local Cell = GenerateCell(thisWidget, index, thisWidget._widths[index], false)
                local UISizeConstraint = Cell:FindFirstChild("UISizeConstraint") :: UISizeConstraint
                UISizeConstraint.MinSize = Vector2.new(
                    2 * Iris._config.CellPadding.X + (if index > 1 then -2 else 0) + (if index < NumColumns then -3 else 0),
                    0
                )
                Cell.LayoutOrder = 2 * index - 1
                thisWidget._cellInstances[-1][index] = Cell
                Cell.Parent = BorderContainer
            end

            local TableColumnBorder = GenerateColumnBorder(thisWidget, NumColumns, "Strong")
            thisWidget._columnBorders[0] = TableColumnBorder
            TableColumnBorder.Parent = Table
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.Table)
            local NumColumns = thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns
            assert(NumColumns >= 1, "Iris.Table must have at least one column.")

            if thisWidget._widths ~= nil and #thisWidget._widths ~= NumColumns then
                -- disallow changing the number of columns. It's too much effort
                thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns = #thisWidget._widths
                warn("NumColumns cannot change once set. See documentation.")
            end

            for rowIndex, row in thisWidget._rowInstances do
                if rowIndex == 0 then
                    row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableHeaderColor
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableHeaderTransparency
                elseif thisWidget.arguments.RowBackground == true then
                    if (rowIndex % 2) == 0 then
                        row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableRowBgAltColor
                        row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableRowBgAltTransparency
                    else
                        row.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.TableRowBgColor
                        row.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.TableRowBgTransparency
                    end
                else
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                end
            end
            
            for _, Border: Frame in thisWidget._rowBorders do
                Border.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders
            end

            for _, Border: GuiButton in thisWidget._columnBorders do
                Border.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders or thisWidget.arguments.Resizable
            end

            for _, border in thisWidget._columnBorders do
                local hover = border:FindFirstChild("Hover") :: Frame?
                if hover then
                    hover.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.Resizable
                end
            end

            if thisWidget._columnBorders[NumColumns] ~= nil then
                thisWidget._columnBorders[NumColumns].Visible =
                    not thisWidget.arguments.LimitTableWidth and (thisWidget.arguments.Resizable or thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders)
                thisWidget._columnBorders[0].Visible =
                    thisWidget.arguments.LimitTableWidth and (thisWidget.arguments.Resizable or thisWidget.arguments.OuterBorders)
            end
            
            -- the header border visibility must be updated after settings all borders
            -- visiblity or not
            local HeaderRow: Frame? = thisWidget._rowInstances[0]
            local HeaderBorder: Frame? = thisWidget._rowBorders[0]
            if HeaderRow ~= nil then
                HeaderRow.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.Header
            end
            if HeaderBorder ~= nil then
                HeaderBorder.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.Header and thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders
            end

            local Table = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local BorderContainer = Table.BorderContainer :: Frame
            BorderContainer.UIStroke.Enabled = thisWidget.arguments.OuterBorders

            for index = 1, thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns do
                TableMinWidths[thisWidget][index] = true
            end

            if thisWidget._widths ~= nil then
                Iris._widgets["Table"].UpdateState(thisWidget)
            end
        end,
        UpdateState = function(thisWidget: Types.Table)
            local Table = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local BorderContainer = Table.BorderContainer :: Frame
            local RowContainer = Table.RowContainer :: Frame
            local NumColumns = thisWidget.arguments.NumColumns
            local ColumnWidths = thisWidget.state.widths.value
            local MinWidths = thisWidget._minWidths
            
            local Fixed = thisWidget.arguments.FixedWidth
            local Proportional = thisWidget.arguments.ProportionalWidth

            if not thisWidget.arguments.Resizable then
                if Fixed then
                    if Proportional then
                        for index = 1, NumColumns do
                            ColumnWidths[index] = MinWidths[index]
                        end
                    else
                        local maxWidth = 0
                        for _, width in MinWidths do
                            maxWidth = math.max(maxWidth, width)
                        end
                        for index = 1, NumColumns do
                            ColumnWidths[index] = maxWidth
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if Proportional then
                        local TotalWidth = 0
                        for _, width in MinWidths do
                            TotalWidth += width
                        end
                        local Ratio = 1 / TotalWidth
                        for index = 1, NumColumns do
                            ColumnWidths[index] = Ratio * MinWidths[index]
                        end
                    else
                        local width = 1 / NumColumns
                        for index = 1, NumColumns do
                            ColumnWidths[index] = width
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local Position = UDim.new()
            for index = 1, NumColumns do
                local ColumnWidth = ColumnWidths[index]

                local Width = UDim.new(
                    if Fixed then 0 else math.clamp(ColumnWidth, 0, 1),
                    if Fixed then math.max(ColumnWidth, 0) else 0
                )
                thisWidget._widths[index] = Width
                Position += Width

                for _, row in thisWidget._cellInstances do
                    row[index].Size = UDim2.new(Width, UDim.new())
                end

                thisWidget._cellInstances[-1][index].Size = UDim2.new(Width + UDim.new(0,
                    (if index > 1 then -2 else 0) - 3
                ), UDim.new())
            end

            -- if the table has a fixed width and we want to cap it, we calculate the table width necessary
            local Width = Position.Offset
            if not thisWidget.arguments.FixedWidth or not thisWidget.arguments.LimitTableWidth then
                Width = math.huge
            end

            BorderContainer.UISizeConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(Width, math.huge)
            RowContainer.UISizeConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(Width, math.huge)
            thisWidget._columnBorders[0].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Width - 3, 0)
        end,
        ChildAdded = function(thisWidget: Types.Table, _: Types.Widget)
            local rowIndex = thisWidget._rowIndex
            local columnIndex = thisWidget._columnIndex
            -- determine if the row exists yet
            local Row = thisWidget._rowInstances[rowIndex]
            thisWidget._rowCycles[rowIndex] = Iris._cycleTick
            TableMinWidths[thisWidget][columnIndex] = true

            if Row ~= nil then
                return thisWidget._cellInstances[rowIndex][columnIndex]
            end

            Row = GenerateRow(thisWidget, rowIndex)
            if rowIndex == 0 then
                Row.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.Header
            end
            Row.Parent = thisWidget._rowContainer

            if rowIndex > 0 then
                local Border = GenerateRowBorder(thisWidget, rowIndex - 1, if rowIndex == 1 then "Strong" else "Light")
                Border.Visible = thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders and (if rowIndex == 1 then (thisWidget.arguments.Header and thisWidget.arguments.InnerBorders) and (thisWidget._rowInstances[0] ~= nil) else true)
                thisWidget._rowBorders[rowIndex - 1] = Border
                Border.Parent = thisWidget._rowContainer
            end

            return thisWidget._cellInstances[rowIndex][columnIndex]
        end,
        ChildDiscarded = function(thisWidget: Types.Table, thisChild: Types.Widget)
            local Cell = thisChild.Instance.Parent

            if Cell ~= nil then
                local columnIndex = tonumber(Cell.Name:sub(6))
                
                if columnIndex then
                    TableMinWidths[thisWidget][columnIndex] = true
                end
            end
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.Table)
            Tables[thisWidget.ID] = nil
            TableMinWidths[thisWidget] = nil
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
            widgets.discardState(thisWidget)
        end
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)
end

-- BrainrotData: shared definitions for Brainrot Base Rush.
-- Every brainrot, its rarity, earnings, price and look lives here so the
-- server (spawning, economy) and the client (HUD preview) agree exactly.

local BrainrotData = {}

-- rate = dollars earned per second once owned. cost = buy price in dollars.

BrainrotData.REBIRTH_REQUIREMENT = 25000
BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BONUS = 0.5
BrainrotData.MAX_SLOTS = 8
BrainrotData.STARTING_MONEY = 50
BrainrotData.WAVE_CASH_LOSS = 0.10

-- Weighted spawn pick: cheap commons show up most, mythics almost never.
function BrainrotData.pickRandom()
	local roll = math.random(1, 100)
	local index = 1
	if roll <= 30 then
		index = 1
	elseif roll <= 55 then
		index = 2
	elseif roll <= 72 then
		index = 3
	elseif roll <= 84 then
		index = 4
	elseif roll <= 91 then
		index = 5
	elseif roll <= 96 then
		index = 6
	elseif roll <= 99 then
		index = 7
	else
		index = 8
	end
	return BrainrotData.BRAINROTS[index]
end

-- Mutations: 5% Golden (2x rate), 1% Rainbow (5x rate). Returns
-- "Normal", "Golden" or "Rainbow" plus the rate multiplier.
function BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random(1, 100)
	if roll == 1 then
		return "Rainbow", 5
	elseif roll <= 6 then
		return "Golden", 2
	else
		return "Normal", 1
	end
end

function BrainrotData.mutationColor(mutation)
	if mutation == "Golden" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	elseif mutation == "Rainbow" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200)
	else
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	end
end

function BrainrotData.formatMoney(amount)
	amount = math.floor(amount + 0.5)
	local text = tostring(amount)
	local out = ""
	while #text > 3 do
		out = "," .. string.sub(text, -3) .. out
		text = string.sub(text, 1, -4)
	end
	return "$" .. text .. out
end

return BrainrotData

-- init.client: the entry point. It waits for the server's Net folder, builds the HUD and the effects,
-- and subscribes to every remote. The server is the only source of truth; this script keeps no copy
-- of the state of its own - whatever the server last sent is what gets rendered.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Hide Roblox's own chat and player list at startup so they never sit over the game's interface.
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
pcall(function()
	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, false)
	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
end)

local Hud = require(script.Hud)
local Fx = require(script.Fx)

-- ---------- Find the remotes the server opens in ReplicatedStorage.Net ----------
local net = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Net")

local function remote(name)
	return net:WaitForChild(name)
end

local CashTick = remote("CashTick") -- (player, cash)
local SyncState = remote("SyncState") -- (player, stateTable)
local Alert = remote("Alert") -- (player, kind, title, body)
local TideHorn = remote("TideHorn") -- (phase)
local Swallowed = remote("Swallowed") -- (player)
local BogBaron = remote("BogBaron") -- (player)

-- ---------- Build the interface and the effects ----------
local hud = Hud.build(player)
local fx = Fx.build()

-- The rarity colour the next burst should use, taken only from what the server has already sent.
-- Nothing here is a guess: if the server has not told us a character's rarity yet, the burst is gold.
local lastRarity = nil

-- The position a burst is drawn at: the player's own character, which is where every one of these
-- events physically happens for this client (the pedestal, the victim's raft, or the thief).
local function burstHere(rarity)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	fx.burst(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), rarity)
end

-- ---------- State ----------
-- SyncState is the truth. CashTick is a lighter intermediate push of just the cash figure; it updates
-- the money label between full syncs without the client ever owning the number.
local function onCashTick(cash)
	if type(cash) ~= "number" then return end
	hud.updateCash(cash)
end

local function onSyncState(state)
	if type(state) ~= "table" then return end
	-- Prime the burst colour from the newest character the server has told us about.
	if state.carried and state.carried.rarity then
		lastRarity = state.carried.rarity
	elseif state.placed and #state.placed > 0 then
		lastRarity = state.placed[#state.placed].rarity
	end
	Hud.update(hud, state)
end

local function onAlert(kind, title, body)
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or type(title) ~= "string" then return end
	hud.showAlert(kind, title, body)
	-- A dredge, a place (taking what you carry to a slot) or a steal surfaces a character; pop a
	-- burst in the rarity colour we last heard about from the server.
	if kind == "good" and (title == "Dredged!" or string.sub(title, 1, 6) == "Stole " or string.sub(title, 1, 6) == "Placed") then
		burstHere(lastRarity)
	end
end

-- TideHorn carries the phase name; the HUD banner and the countdown both follow it.
local function onTideHorn(phase)
	if type(phase) ~= "string" then return end
	hud.setTide(phase)
end

local function onSwallowed()
	fx.swallow()
end

local function onBogBaron()
	hud.showBogBaron()
end

CashTick.OnClientEvent:Connect(onCashTick)
SyncState.OnClientEvent:Connect(onSyncState)
Alert.OnClientEvent:Connect(onAlert)
TideHorn.OnClientEvent:Connect(onTideHorn)
Swallowed.OnClientEvent:Connect(onSwallowed)
BogBaron.OnClientEvent:Connect(onBogBaron)

-- ---------- Handshake ----------
-- The server sends SyncState on join (see init.server.luau onPlayerAdded). The subscription above
-- already receives it: lastRarity is primed and the HUD is drawn. Nothing else to do.

print("[BRAINROT BOG] client up")

            Right.Name = "Right"
            Right.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
            Right.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Iris._config.SeparatorTextBorderSize)
            Right.BackgroundColor3 = Iris._config.SeparatorColor
            Right.BackgroundTransparency = Iris._config.SeparatorTransparency
            Right.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Right.LayoutOrder = 2

            Right.Parent = SeparatorText

            return SeparatorText
        end,
        Update = function(thisWidget: Types.SeparatorText)
            local SeparatorText = thisWidget.Instance :: Frame
            local TextLabel: TextLabel = SeparatorText.TextLabel
            if thisWidget.arguments.Text == nil then
                error("Text argument is required for Iris.SeparatorText().", 5)
            end
            TextLabel.Text = thisWidget.arguments.Text
        end,
        Discard = function(thisWidget: Types.SeparatorText)
            thisWidget.Instance:Destroy()
        end,
    } :: Types.WidgetClass)
end

-- BrainrotFactory: turns a Cast entry into a labelled Model, and moves it between the pedestal, a
-- player's head, and a deck slot, through named functions.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local Cast = require(script.Parent.Cast)
local World = require(script.Parent.World) -- read-only: pedestal top surface for standing

local BrainrotFactory = {}

local Heartbeat = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
local container = workspace:FindFirstChild("Brainrots")
if not container then
	container = Instance.new("Folder")
	container.Name = "Brainrots"
	container.Parent = workspace
end

-- Bob the model up and down. Each active model gets a Heartbeat connection that drives its bob.
local bobbing = {} -- Model -> { connection, phase, base }

local function startBobbing(model, getBaseCFrame)
	local phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local conn
	conn = Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not model.PrimaryPart then
			conn:Disconnect()
			bobbing[model] = nil
			return
		end
		phase += dt * 2
		local bob = math.sin(phase) * 0.35
		local base = getBaseCFrame()
		if base then
			model:PivotTo(base + CFrame.new(0, bob, 0))
		end
	end)
	bobbing[model] = { connection = conn, phase = phase, getBaseCFrame = getBaseCFrame }
end

local function stopBobbing(model)
	local entry = bobbing[model]
	if entry then
		entry.connection:Disconnect()
		bobbing[model] = nil
	end
end

local function setCollide(model, canCollide)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = canCollide end
	end
end

-- The name of the physical sign panel (and its border) so bounding-box math can skip them.
local SIGN_PART_NAMES = { BrainrotLabel = true, SignBorder = true }

local function isSignPart(part)
	return SIGN_PART_NAMES[part.Name] == true
end

-- Measure a model's bounding box from its own parts, excluding the sign panel and border, so the
-- sign's size never skews where the body sits or where the sign is hung. Returns min/max Vector3.
local function measureModel(model)
	local min = nil
	local max = nil
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and not isSignPart(p) then
			local pos = p.Position
			local half = p.Size / 2
			local lo = pos - half
			local hi = pos + half
			if not min then
				min, max = lo, hi
			else
				min = Vector3.new(math.min(min.X, lo.X), math.min(min.Y, lo.Y), math.min(min.Z, lo.Z))
				max = Vector3.new(math.max(max.X, hi.X), math.max(max.Y, hi.Y), math.max(max.Z, hi.Z))
			end
		end
	end
	return min, max
end

local function modelTop(model)
	local _, max = measureModel(model)
	return max and max.Y or nil
end

-- ---------- The label ----------
local RARITY_COLORS = Config.RarityColors

local function rainbowColor(t)
	local hue = (t * 0.25) % 1
	return Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
end

-- The label is a physical sign (a BillboardGui is not captured by CaptureService, but a
-- SurfaceGui on a part is). The sign is welded above the character and carries two SurfaceGuis,
-- Front and Back, so a player reads it from either side. Every model is scaled up after build so
-- the sign (welded at the pre-scale offset) rides up with it.
local SIGN_SIZE = Vector3.new(7, 3.4, 0.2)
local SIGN_CANVAS = Vector2.new(900, 440)
local SIGN_LIFT = 8.4 -- studs above the torso centre: the sign's bottom clears the head by ~2
local MODEL_SCALE = 1.4 -- every character model is scaled to this multiple of its built size

local function buildLabelFace(gui, entry)
	gui.CanvasSize = SIGN_CANVAS
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Brightness = 1.5
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false

	-- A solid dark plate filling the canvas so the words always sit on black, never on the world
	-- showing through, and so the panel reads as self-lit at night (with LightInfluence 0 above).
	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = "BackgroundPlate"
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 17, 20)
	plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	plate.Parent = gui

	local NAME_H = 140
	local ROW_H = 70
	local SPACING = 85 -- even distance between row centres: 220, 305, 390
	local PADDING = 20

	local function makeText(name, text, color, font, textSize)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = name
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = color
		-- TextScaled does not survive on the labels this engine build creates, so size each row
		-- with an explicit TextSize instead.
		label.TextScaled = false
		label.TextSize = textSize
		label.Font = font
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
		label.TextWrapped = false
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		return label
	end

	-- Three rows only: name, rarity, rate. (The joke stays on the model as an attribute.)
	-- The name sits in the vertical middle of the canvas; rarity and rate sit under it with even
	-- spacing. Every row spans the full canvas width less a little padding on each side.
	local name = makeText("NameLabel", entry.Name, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Font.FredokaOne, 104)
	name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PADDING * 2, 0, NAME_H)
	name.Position = UDim2.new(0, PADDING, 0.5, -NAME_H / 2)
	name.Parent = gui

	local rarity = makeText("RarityLabel", string.upper(entry.Rarity), RARITY_COLORS[entry.Rarity], Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, 68)
	rarity.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PADDING * 2, 0, ROW_H)
	rarity.Position = UDim2.new(0, PADDING, 0.5, SPACING - ROW_H / 2)
	rarity.Parent = gui

	local rate = makeText("RateLabel", "$" .. entry.Rate .. "/s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, 68)
	rate.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PADDING * 2, 0, ROW_H)
	rate.Position = UDim2.new(0, PADDING, 0.5, SPACING * 2 - ROW_H / 2)
	rate.Parent = gui

	-- The "LOCKED" strip across the very top of the canvas, visible only while locked.
	local lock = Instance.new("Frame")
	lock.Name = "LockIcon"
	lock.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 44)
	lock.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0, 0)
	lock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)
	lock.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	lock.Visible = false
	lock.Parent = gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = lock
	local lockText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lockText.Name = "LockText"
	lockText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	lockText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lockText.Text = "LOCKED"
	lockText.TextScaled = true
	lockText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0)
	lockText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	lockText.Parent = lock

	return gui
end

local function buildLabel(model, entry)
	local torso = model.PrimaryPart
	if not torso then return nil end

	local sign = Instance.new("Part")
	sign.Name = "BrainrotLabel"
	sign.Size = SIGN_SIZE
	sign.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 36, 42) -- dark charcoal panel
	sign.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	sign.Transparency = 0
	sign.CanCollide = false
	sign.Anchored = true
	sign.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, SIGN_LIFT, 0)
	sign.Parent = model

	-- A thin rarity-coloured border strip along the top edge of the panel.
	local border = Instance.new("Part")
	border.Name = "SignBorder"
	border.Size = Vector3.new(SIGN_SIZE.X + 0.1, 0.18, SIGN_SIZE.Z + 0.06)
	border.Color = RARITY_COLORS[entry.Rarity]
	border.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	border.CanCollide = false
	border.Anchored = true
	border.CFrame = sign.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, SIGN_SIZE.Y / 2 + 0.09, 0)
	border.Parent = model

	-- A slight glow so the panel reads in the evening.
	local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
	glow.Name = "SignGlow"
	glow.Color = RARITY_COLORS[entry.Rarity]
	glow.Range = 7
	glow.Brightness = 1.2
	glow.Parent = sign

	local front = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	front.Name = "BrainrotLabelFront"
	front.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	front.Parent = sign
	buildLabelFace(front, entry)

	local back = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	back.Name = "BrainrotLabelBack"
	back.Face = Enum.NormalId.Back
	back.Parent = sign
	buildLabelFace(back, entry)

	-- Weld the sign to the torso so it moves with the model when carried.
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "SignWeld"
	weld.Part0 = torso
	weld.Part1 = sign
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, SIGN_LIFT, 0)
	weld.Parent = torso
	sign.Anchored = false
	-- The border strip rides on the sign through its own weld (the sign itself is unanchored).
	local borderWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
	borderWeld.Name = "SignBorderWeld"
	borderWeld.Part0 = sign
	borderWeld.Part1 = border
	borderWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, SIGN_SIZE.Y / 2 + 0.09, 0)
	borderWeld.Parent = sign
	border.Anchored = false

	-- Show the gold strip whenever the Locked attribute flips on.
	local function applyLock(visible)
		local frontLock = front:FindFirstChild("LockIcon")
		local backLock = back:FindFirstChild("LockIcon")
		if frontLock then frontLock.Visible = visible end
		if backLock then backLock.Visible = visible end
	end
	applyLock(model:GetAttribute("Locked") == true)
	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Locked"):Connect(function()
		applyLock(model:GetAttribute("Locked") == true)
	end)

	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", entry.Rarity)
	model:SetAttribute("Rate", entry.Rate)
	model:SetAttribute("Joke", entry.Joke)
	model:SetAttribute("Name", entry.Name)
	model:SetAttribute("Secret", entry.Rarity == "Secret")
	return sign
end

-- Hang the sign so its bottom clears the model's highest body part by SIGN_CLEARANCE, measured
-- from the body alone (the sign's own box is excluded by measureModel). Keeps the torso's X, Z and
-- rotation and only lifts along the torso's up axis; the weld is retargeted so the sign still rides
-- with the model when carried.
local SIGN_CLEARANCE = 1.2

local function rehangLabel(model)
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("BrainrotLabel")
	local torso = model.PrimaryPart
	if not sign or not torso then return end
	local top = modelTop(model)
	if not top then return end
	local weld = torso:FindFirstChild("SignWeld")
	if not weld then return end
	local desiredCentreY = top + SIGN_CLEARANCE + SIGN_SIZE.Y / 2
	-- How far along the torso's up axis the sign centre currently sits.
	local currentLift = (torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(sign.CFrame)).Position.Y
	local newLift = currentLift + (desiredCentreY - sign.Position.Y)
	sign.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, newLift, 0)
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, newLift, 0)
end

local function updateLabelColor(model, t)
	local entry = { Rarity = model:GetAttribute("Rarity"), Name = model:GetAttribute("Name") }
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("BrainrotLabel")
	if not sign then return end
	if entry.Rarity == "Secret" then
		local c = rainbowColor(t)
		for _, faceName in ipairs({ "BrainrotLabelFront", "BrainrotLabelBack" }) do
			local gui = sign:FindFirstChild(faceName)
			if gui then
				local n = gui:FindFirstChild("NameLabel")
				local r = gui:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel")
				if n then n.TextColor3 = c end
				if r then r.TextColor3 = c end
			end
		end
		local glow = sign:FindFirstChild("SignGlow")
		if glow then glow.Color = c end
	end
end

local function addParticles(model, entry)
	local color = RARITY_COLORS[entry.Rarity]
	local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emit.Name = "SpawnBurst"
	emit.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emit.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6)
	emit.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emit.Rate = 6
	emit.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
	emit.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	emit.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	-- A small one-time burst then a slow idle sparkle.
	emit:Emit(25)
	return emit
end

local function addRainbowTrail(model)
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name = "TrailA"
	a.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	a.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	local b = Instance.new("Attachment")
	b.Name = "TrailB"
	b.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)
	b.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "RainbowTrail"
	trail.Attachment0 = a
	trail.Attachment1 = b
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 120)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(80, 120, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 255)),
	})
	trail.Lifetime = 0.6
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	trail.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	return trail
end

-- ---------- Build the model ----------
-- Create the model standing at a position, fully built and labelled.
local function createBrainrot(entry, position, ownerUserId)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = entry.Name

	local primary = nil
	for i, recipe in ipairs(entry.Parts) do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = recipe.Name
		p.Size = recipe.Size
		p.Color = recipe.Color
		p.Material = recipe.Material
		p.Transparency = recipe.Transparency
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + recipe.Offset)
		if recipe.Shape == "Ball" then
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		elseif recipe.Shape == "Cylinder" then
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		elseif recipe.Shape == "Wedge" then
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Wedge
		end
		if recipe.Name == "Torso" or i == 1 then
			primary = primary or p
		end
		p.Parent = model
	end
	-- Promote the part named Torso to primary; fall back to the first part.
	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	model.PrimaryPart = torso or primary

	-- Weld every part to the primary so the model can move as one when carried.
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= model.PrimaryPart then
			local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0 = model.PrimaryPart
			weld.Part1 = p
			weld.C0 = CFrame.new(p.Position - model.PrimaryPart.Position)
			weld.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
		end
	end

	-- Scale the whole model up so a character reads at a distance (built size ~3 studs is too small).
	model:ScaleTo(MODEL_SCALE)

	buildLabel(model, entry)
	addParticles(model, entry)
	if entry.Rarity == "Secret" then
		addRainbowTrail(model)
	end
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", ownerUserId or 0)
	model.Parent = container
	updateLabelColor(model, os.clock())
	return model
end

-- ---------- Placement helpers ----------
-- Stand a model upright on a surface whose top is at surfaceTopY, centred at (x, z): anchored,
-- uncarried, slowly bobbing. surfaceTopY comes from the deck pad or the pedestal, so the same
-- resting math serves both.
local function standOnSurface(model, position, surfaceTopY)
	stopBobbing(model)
	local yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
	local anchor = CFrame.new(position.X, surfaceTopY, position.Z) * yaw
	model:PivotTo(anchor)
	-- Rest the body on the surface: measure from the model's own parts (never the sign), then lift
	-- so the lowest body point sits on the surface plus a small clearance. The sign, hung above the
	-- body, is re-hung to match.
	local min, _ = measureModel(model)
	local offsetY = 0
	if min then
		offsetY = (surfaceTopY + 0.01) - min.Y
		if offsetY ~= 0 then
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.X, surfaceTopY + offsetY, position.Z) * yaw)
		end
	end
	rehangLabel(model)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	local base = CFrame.new(position.X, surfaceTopY + offsetY, position.Z) * yaw
	startBobbing(model, function() return base end)
	model:SetAttribute("Placed", true)
	return offsetY
end

-- Stand a model in a deck slot, resting on the pad's top surface (the slot centre's Y).
local function standInSlot(model, slotPosition)
	return standOnSurface(model, slotPosition, slotPosition.Y)
end

-- Stand a model on the dredge pedestal, resting on the pedestal's top surface. The pedestal is
-- built from a flat-topped cylinder; read its top Y from the anchor part so the body never sinks in.
local function standOnPedestal(model, pedestalPosition)
	local core = World.GetAnchors().PedestalCore
	local topY = pedestalPosition.Y
	if core and core:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- A cylinder rotated onto its side: the top face is the max world Y across its corners.
		local half = core.Size / 2
		local max = nil
		for i = 0, 7 do
			local sx = (i % 2 == 0) and half.X or -half.X
			local sy = (math.floor(i / 2) % 2 == 0) and half.Y or -half.Y
			local sz = (math.floor(i / 4) % 2 == 0) and half.Z or -half.Z
			local wy = core.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz)).Y
			if not max or wy > max then max = wy end
		end
		topY = max
	end
	return standOnSurface(model, pedestalPosition, topY)
end

-- Weld a model above a player's head, slightly tilted, bobbing while carried.
local function weldToPlayer(model, player)
	stopBobbing(model)
	if not model.PrimaryPart then return false end
	local character = player and player.Character
	if not character then return false end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character.PrimaryPart
	if not head then return false end
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = false
			p.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	-- A carriage weld from the head to the primary, offset above and tilted.
	local existing = model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = head
	weld.Part1 = model.PrimaryPart
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(8))
	weld.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.2, 0)
	weld.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	model:PivotTo(head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0))
	model:SetAttribute("Placed", false)
	model:SetAttribute("CarriedBy", player.UserId)
	-- Bob by nudging the carry weld's C0.
	local phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local conn
	conn = Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not model.PrimaryPart or not model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld") then
			conn:Disconnect()
			bobbing[model] = nil -- clear so a dropped model does not leak a dead entry
			return
		end
		phase += dt * 2.5
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.6 + math.sin(phase) * 0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(8))
		updateLabelColor(model, os.clock())
	end)
	bobbing[model] = { connection = conn }
	return true
end

-- Drop a carried model onto the ground where the player stands (used when a tide swallows them).
local function dropModel(model, position)
	stopBobbing(model)
	local carry = model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if carry then carry:Destroy() end
	model:SetAttribute("CarriedBy", nil)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)))
end

local function removeModel(model)
	if not model then return end
	stopBobbing(model)
	model:Destroy()
end

BrainrotFactory.CreateBrainrot = createBrainrot
BrainrotFactory.StandInSlot = standInSlot
BrainrotFactory.StandOnPedestal = standOnPedestal
BrainrotFactory.WeldToPlayer = weldToPlayer
BrainrotFactory.DropModel = dropModel
BrainrotFactory.RemoveModel = removeModel
BrainrotFactory.SetCollide = setCollide
BrainrotFactory.GetContainer = function() return container end

return BrainrotFactory

-- Fixture: correct ways to remember a failed load. No findings expected in this file.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("Fixture")
local data = {}
local loaded = {}

-- the flag is stored directly
local function loadA(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("a" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	loaded[player] = ok
	data[player] = saved
end

-- the flag is stored as an attribute
local function loadB(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("b" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("load failed", saved)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("DataLoaded", ok)
end

-- the flag is stored through true / false
local function loadC(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("c" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok then
		data[player] = saved
		loaded[player] = true
	else
		loaded[player] = false
	end
end

-- the player is removed when the load fails
local function loadD(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("d" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		player:Kick("Could not load your data, please rejoin.")
		return
	end
	data[player] = saved
end

-- leaves before the stats exist, so there is nothing to save later
local function loadE(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("e" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	data[player] = saved
end

-- the caller gets the flag
local function loadF(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("f" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	return ok, saved
end

-- load and save in the same function (daily reward style): nothing is overwritten later
local function daily(player)
	local ok, last = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("day" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and last ~= 1 then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("day" .. player.UserId, 1)
		end)
	end
end

local function save(player)
	if not loaded[player] then
		return
	end
	for _, prefix in { "a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f" } do
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync(prefix .. player.UserId, data[player])
		end)
	end
end

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	loadA(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	loadA(player)
	loadB(player)
	loadC(player)
	loadD(player)
	loadE(player)
	loadF(player)
	daily(player)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		save(player)
	end
end)

for _, entry in ipairs(ENTRIES) do
	assert(Config.RarityColors[entry.Rarity], "Cast entry " .. entry.Name .. " has an unknown rarity")
	assert(Config.RarityWeights[entry.Rarity], "Cast entry " .. entry.Name .. " has a rarity with no weight")
	assert(Config.RarityRank[entry.Rarity], "Cast entry " .. entry.Name .. " has a rarity with no rank")
end

local byRarity = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(ENTRIES) do
	byRarity[entry.Rarity] = byRarity[entry.Rarity] or {}
	table.insert(byRarity[entry.Rarity], entry)
end

-- The rarity names, ordered best last, plus their normalised weights.
local rarityNames, weights = {}, {}
for name, weight in pairs(Config.RarityWeights) do
	table.insert(rarityNames, name)
	weights[name] = weight
end
table.sort(rarityNames, function(a, b) return Config.RarityRank[a] < Config.RarityRank[b] end)
local totalWeight = 0
for _, name in ipairs(rarityNames) do totalWeight += weights[name] end
local cumulative = {}
local running = 0
for _, name in ipairs(rarityNames) do
	running += weights[name] / totalWeight
	cumulative[name] = running
end

-- Roll one rarity by the configured weights, then pick uniformly inside it.
local function rollRarity()
	local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
	for _, name in ipairs(rarityNames) do
		if roll <= cumulative[name] then
			return name
		end
	end
	return rarityNames[1]
end

-- Roll one random character: rarity first, then a uniform pick inside that rarity.
local function rollCharacter()
	local rarity = rollRarity()
	local pool = byRarity[rarity]
	if not pool or #pool == 0 then
		-- Fall back to the whole cast rather than indexing an empty pool.
		return ENTRIES[math.random(#ENTRIES)]
	end
	return pool[math.random(#pool)]
end

-- Every character of one rarity. Returns an empty table rather than erroring when the config names a
-- rarity that the cast does not carry.
local function charactersOfRarity(rarity)
	local pool = byRarity[rarity] or {}
	local copy = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(pool) do table.insert(copy, entry) end
	return copy
end

Cast.Entries = ENTRIES
Cast.RollCharacter = rollCharacter
Cast.RollRarity = rollRarity
Cast.CharactersOfRarity = charactersOfRarity
Cast.GetByName = function(name)
	for _, entry in ipairs(ENTRIES) do
		if entry.Name == name then return entry end
	end
	return nil
end

return Cast

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

return function(Iris: Types.Internal, widgets: Types.WidgetUtility)
    local function relocateTooltips()
        if Iris._rootInstance == nil then
            return
        end
        local PopupScreenGui = Iris._rootInstance:FindFirstChild("PopupScreenGui")
        local TooltipContainer: Frame = PopupScreenGui.TooltipContainer
        local mouseLocation = widgets.getMouseLocation()
        local newPosition = widgets.findBestWindowPosForPopup(mouseLocation, TooltipContainer.AbsoluteSize, Iris._config.DisplaySafeAreaPadding, PopupScreenGui.AbsoluteSize)
        TooltipContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newPosition.X, newPosition.Y)
    end

    widgets.registerEvent("InputChanged", function()
        if not Iris._started then
            return
        end
        relocateTooltips()
    end)

    --stylua: ignore
    Iris.WidgetConstructor("Tooltip", {
        hasState = false,
        hasChildren = false,
        Args = {
            ["Text"] = 1,
        },
        Events = {},
        Generate = function(thisWidget: Types.Tooltip)
