--[[ These are the tests that we have tried to get working with Lua-OOP, if you have any suggestions or improvements, please let us know. ]]

local User = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  age = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name, age)
    self.name = name
    self.age = age
  end
})
local u = User:new("Alice", 25)
assert(u.name == "Alice" and u.age == 25, "Test 1 failed")
local User = class({
  password = {nil, true},  -- private
  constructor = function(self, super, pwd)
    self.password = pwd
  end
})
local u = User:new("secret")
local ok = pcall(function() print(u.password) end)
assert(not ok, "Test 2 failed: private property accessible")

-- Test 3: Private property accessible internally
local User = class({
  password = {nil, true},
  getPassword = {function(self) return self.password end, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, pwd)
    self.password = pwd
  end
})
local u = User:new("secret")
assert(u.getPassword() == "secret", "Test 3 failed")
local User = class({
  count = {0, false, true},  -- static
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    self.name = name
  end
})
User.count = 5
local u = User:new("Alice")
local ok = pcall(function() print(u.count) end)
assert(not ok, "Test 4 failed: static accessible on instance")
assert(User.count == 5, "Test 4 failed: static not on class")

-- Test 5: Instance properties on instance, not class
local ok2 = pcall(function() print(User.name) end)
assert(not ok2, "Test 5 failed: instance accessible on class")
local User = class({
  id = {1, false, false, true},  -- immutable
  constructor = function(self, super, id)
    self.id = id
  end
})
local u = User:new(100)
local ok = pcall(function() u.id = 999 end)
assert(not ok, "Test 6 failed: immutable modified")
assert(u.id == 100, "Test 6 failed: immutable changed")

-- Test 7: Mutable property can be changed
local User = class({
  name = {nil, false, false, false},  -- mutable
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    self.name = name
  end
})
local u = User:new("Alice")
u.name = "Bob"
assert(u.name == "Bob", "Test 7 failed")
local User = class({
  _value = {0, true},
  get = {
    value = function(self) return self._value * 2 end
  },
  constructor = function(self, super, val)
    self._value = val
  end
})
local u = User:new(5)
assert(u.value == 10, "Test 8 failed")

-- Test 9: Setter works
local User = class({
  _value = {0, true},
  getValue = {function(self) return self._value end, false},  -- Add getter
  set = {
    value = function(self, val) self._value = val * 2 end
  },
  constructor = function(self) self._value = 0 end
})
local u = User:new()
u.value = 5
assert(u.getValue() == 10, "Test 9 failed")

-- Test 10: Getter can't be modified (correct version)
local User = class({
  _value = {0, true},
  get = {
    value = function(self) return self._value end  -- Getter only, no setter
  },
  constructor = function(self) self._value = 10 end
})
local u = User:new()
local ok = pcall(function() u.value = 20 end)  -- Try to set getter-only property
assert(not ok, "Test 10 failed: getter modified")

local Parent = class({
  id = {1, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, id)
    self.id = id
  end
})
local Child = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name, id)
    super(id)
    self.name = name
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new("Alice", 100)
assert(c.id == 100 and c.name == "Alice", "Test 11 failed")

-- Test 12: Child inherits parent getters
local Parent = class({
  value = {10, false},
  get = {
    getValue = function(self) return self.value end
  },
  constructor = function(self, super, val)
    self.value = val
  end
})
local Child = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name, val)
    super(val)
    self.name = name
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new("Test", 42)
assert(c.getValue == 42, "Test 12 failed")

-- Test 13: Child inherits parent setters
local Parent = class({
  _value = {0, true},
  getValue = {function(self) return self._value end, false},
  set = {
    value = function(self, val) self._value = val * 2 end
  },
  constructor = function(self)
    self._value = 0
  end
})
local Child = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    super()
    self.name = name
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new("Test")
c.value = 5
assert(c.getValue() == 10, "Test 13 failed")
local Parent = class({
  secret = {nil, true},  -- private
  constructor = function(self, super, sec)
    self.secret = sec
  end
})
local Child = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name, sec)
    super(sec)
    self.name = name
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new("Alice", "password")
local ok = pcall(function() print(c.secret) end)
assert(not ok, "Test 14 failed: parent private accessible")

-- Test 15: Parent immutable property blocked in child
local Parent = class({
  id = {1, false, false, true},  -- immutable
  constructor = function(self, super, id)
    self.id = id
  end
})
local Child = class({
  constructor = function(self, super, id)
    super(id)
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new(100)
local ok = pcall(function() c.id = 999 end)
assert(not ok, "Test 15 failed: parent immutable modified")
local Parent = class({
  greet = {function(self) return "Hello from parent" end, false, false, false, true},
  constructor = function(self) end
})
local Child = class({
  greet = {function(self) return "Hello from child" end, false, false, true, false, true},
  constructor = function(self, super) super() end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new()
print(c.greet())  -- Should print "Hello from child", probably prints "Hello from parent"
local Grandparent = class({
  id = {1, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, id)
    self.id = id
  end
})
local Parent = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name, id)
    super(id)
    self.name = name
  end
}, Grandparent)
local Child = class({
  age = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, age, name, id)
    super(name, id)
    self.age = age
  end
}, Parent)
local c = Child:new(20, "Alice", 100)
assert(c.id == 100 and c.name == "Alice" and c.age == 20, "Test 17 failed")
local Parent = class({
  count = {0, false, true},  -- static
  constructor = function(self) end
})
local Child = class({
  constructor = function(self, super) super() end
}, Parent)
assert(Child.count == 0, "Test 18 failed")
-- This might fail - test it

local User = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  greet = {function(self) return "Hello " .. self.name end, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    self.name = name
  end
})
local u = User:new("Alice")
assert(u.greet() == "Hello Alice", "Test 19 failed")

-- Test 20: Static methods work
local User = class({
  create = {function(self, name) return "Created " .. name end, false, true}, -- 481
  constructor = function(self) end
})
assert(User.create("Alice") == "Created Alice", "Test 20 failed")
local User = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    self.name = name
  end
})
local u1 = User:new("Alice")
local u2 = User:new("Bob")
u1.name = "Charlie"
assert(u1.name == "Charlie" and u2.name == "Bob", "Test 21 failed")

-- Test 22: Metatable protection
local User = class({
  constructor = function(self) end
})
local u = User:new()
local mt = getmetatable(u)
assert(mt == "access denied", "Test 22 failed: metatable exposed")

-- Test 23: Constructor validation
local User = class({
  name = {nil, false},
  age = {nil, false},
  constructor = function(self, super, name)
    self.name = name
    -- Forgot to set age
  end
})
local ok = pcall(function() User:new("Alice") end)
assert(not ok, "Test 23 failed: validation missed unset property")


local Parent = class({
  greet = {function(self) return "Hello from parent" end, false, false, false, true}, 
  constructor = function(self) end
})

local Child = class({
  greet = {function(self) return "Hello from child" end, false, false, false, false, true},
  constructor = function(self, super) super() end
}, Parent)

local c = Child:new()
print(c.greet())  -- Should print "Hello from child"

-- pure-247 (Pure 24/7): every 24/7 and LTD store in GTA V, shopped by hand on WHIP.
-- Take goods off the game's own racks (a WHIP prompt on each product), carry them in your hands or in a basket from
-- the stack by the door, and pay the clerk (a WHIP NPC) in cash or by card; the clerk also hands over cigarettes from
-- behind the counter (client/shelves.lua, server/shelves.lua, server/clerks.lua). Rooms and rack spots come from the
-- game's own map (config.lua, shared/racks.lua).

fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'
lua54 'yes'

name 'pure-247'
description 'Pure 24/7 by PureFX: every 24/7 store on WHIP, shopped by hand (racks, basket, clerk and checkout) with groceries'
author 'fozen'
website 'https://purefx.dev'
version '1.0.0'

dependency 'whip_core'
whip_requires '1.0'

shared_scripts {
    '@whip_core/lib/satellite.lua',
    'config.lua',
    'shared/rooms.lua',
    'shared/goods.lua',
    'shared/racks.lua',   -- generated: every product on the game's own 24/7 racks
}

client_scripts {
    'client/basketedit.lua',   -- /basketedit, and the carry poses
    'client/shelves.lua',
    'client/basket_goods.lua',   -- what is in a basket, drawn inside it
}

server_scripts {
    'server/main.lua',
    'server/clerks.lua',
    'server/shelves.lua',
}

-- The groceries' pictures come from WHIP's prop picture pack (whip_media_props, installed with WHIP in
-- resources/[assets]/[media]). Without it the shop shows WHIP's "missing" picture; nothing else changes.

-- The hand basket you carry while shopping (stream/pure247_basket.ydr): the 24/7's own wire basket, the top one of
-- the stack on the store's front shelf (GTA V's v_66_shelves, its basketwire faces and texture), as a prop of its own.
files { 'stream/pure247_basket.ytyp', 'html/img/items/*.webp' }   -- the basket's archetype; the rack goods' pictures
data_file 'DLC_ITYP_REQUEST' 'stream/pure247_basket.ytyp'

-- client.lua: the depot desk, and a prompt at every door (shown only while you carry a package)
Whip.register(function()
    local function offDuty() return LocalPlayer.state.whipJob ~= 'mydelivery' end

    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id      = 'depot',
        at      = { coords = Config.Depot },
        options = {
            { id = 'signon', label = 'Sign on as a driver', icon = 'id', canInteract = offDuty,
              onSelect = function() TriggerServerEvent('mydelivery:signon') end },

            { id = 'clockon', label = 'Clock on', require = { job = 'mydelivery' }, canInteract = offDuty,
              onSelect = function(ctx)
                  local ok, why = exports.whip_core:ClockOn('mydelivery')
                  if not ok then ctx.refuse(why) end
              end },

            { id = 'start', label = ('Take a van ($%d deposit)'):format(Config.Deposit), icon = 'car',
              require = { job = 'mydelivery', onDuty = true },
              onSelect = function() TriggerServerEvent('mydelivery:start') end },

            { id = 'finish', label = 'Return the van', icon = 'garage', require = { job = 'mydelivery', onDuty = true },
              onSelect = function() TriggerServerEvent('mydelivery:finish') end },

            { id = 'clockoff', label = 'Clock off', require = { job = 'mydelivery', onDuty = true },
              onSelect = function() exports.whip_core:ClockOff('mydelivery') end },
        },
    })

    -- The server decides which door is theirs; a prompt at the wrong one is told so
    for i, stop in ipairs(Config.Drops) do
        Whip.core:AddAction({
            id       = 'drop_' .. i,
            at       = { coords = stop.coords },
            label    = 'Deliver the package',
            icon     = 'give',
            require  = { job = 'mydelivery', onDuty = true, item = 'mydelivery_package' },
            onSelect = function() TriggerServerEvent('mydelivery:drop') end,
        })
    end
end)

---@alias MemberKey string | "get" | "set" | "constructor"
---@alias Member ShorthandedMemberValue | MemberEntries | Getter | Setter | Constructor
---@alias ShorthandedMemberValue number | string | boolean | fun(self: unknown, ...: unknown): unknown?
---@alias MemberEntries {[1]: MemberValue, [2]?: MemberFlag, [3]?: MemberFlag, [4]?: MemberFlag, [5]?: MemberFlag, [6]?: MemberFlag}
---@alias MemberValue number | string | boolean | table | nil | fun(self: unknown, ...: unknown): unknown
---@alias MemberFlag boolean | nil
---@alias Getter fun(self: unknown): unknown
---@alias Setter fun(self: unknown, value: unknown): nil
---@alias Constructor fun(self: unknown, super: fun(...: any): unknown, ...: unknown): unknown
---@alias Members table<string, PropertyFlags>
---@alias MembersValues table<string, MemberValue>
---@alias RawMembers table<MemberKey, Member>

---@class PropertyFlags
---@field private MemberFlag
---@field static MemberFlag
---@field final MemberFlag
---@field virtual MemberFlag
---@field override MemberFlag

---@param Members RawMembers
---@param Parent? unknown
local class<const> = function (Members, Parent)
  ---@type Members
  local members<const> = {}
  ---@type MembersValues
  local membersValues<const> = {}
  local default<const> = function(existingValue, defaultValue)
    if existingValue ~= nil then
      return existingValue
    else return defaultValue end
  end
  ---@type table<string, Getter>
  local getters<const> = {}
  ---@type table<string, Setter>
  local setters<const> = {}

  for memberKey, member in pairs(Members) do
    assert(member ~= nil, ("syntax error: expected member, got `%s`"):format(type(member)))
    if memberKey == "constructor" then
      if type(member) ~= "function" then error(("syntax error: constructor expected `function`, got `%s`"):format(type(member))) end
    elseif memberKey == "get" then
      if type(member) ~= "table" then error(("syntax error: get expected `table`, got `%s`"):format(type(member))) end
      ---@cast member table<string, Getter>
      for getterKey, getter in pairs(member) do
        if type(getter) ~= "function" then error(("syntax error: the getters(`%s`) can be only a `function`, got `%s`"):format(getterKey, type(getter))) end
        local getterInfo<const> = debug.getinfo(getter, "u")
        if getterInfo.nparams ~= 1 then error(("syntax error: the getters(`%s`) can not have parameters (excluding `self`)"):format(getterKey)) end
        getters[getterKey] = getter
      end
    elseif memberKey == "set" then
      if type(member) ~= "table" then error(("syntax error: set expected `table`, got `%s`"):format(type(member))) end
      ---@cast member table<string, Setter>
      for setterKey, setter in pairs(member) do
        if type(setter) ~= "function" then error(("syntax error: the setters(`%s`) can be only a `function`, got `%s`"):format(setterKey, type(setter))) end
        local getterInfo<const> = debug.getinfo(setter, "u")
        if getterInfo.nparams ~= 2 then error(("syntax error: the setters(`%s`) must have exactly one parameter (excluding `self`)"):format(setterKey)) end
        setters[setterKey] = setter
      end
    else
      members[memberKey] = {}
      if type(member) == "table" then
        membersValues[memberKey] = member[1]
        members[memberKey] = {
          private = default(member[2], true),
          static = default(member[3], false),
          final = default(member[4], false),
          virtual = default(member[5], false),
          override = default(member[6], true),
        }
      else
        membersValues[memberKey] = member
        members[memberKey] = {
          private = true,
          static = false,
          final = true,
          virtual = false,
          override = false,
        }
      end
    end
  end

  for memberKey, member in pairs(members) do
    if member.override then
      if not Parent or not Parent.__extended then
        error(("cannot override `%s`: no parent class was derived"):format(memberKey))
      end

      local parentMember<const> = Parent.__extended.members[memberKey]
      if not parentMember then
        error(("override failed: no such `%s` parent method"):format(memberKey))
      end

      if not parentMember.virtual then
        error(("override denied: the parent method `%s` is not virtual"):format(memberKey))
      end
    end
  end

  if Parent and Parent.__extended then
    for memberKey, member in pairs(Parent.__extended.members) do
      if not members[memberKey] then
        members[memberKey] = member
        membersValues[memberKey] = Parent.__extended.membersValues[memberKey]
      else
        if not members[memberKey].override then
          error(("method `%s` already exists in parent, did you mean to use the override flag"):format(memberKey))
        end
      end
    end

    for getterKey, getter in pairs(Parent.__extended.getters) do
      if not getters[getterKey] then
        getters[getterKey] = getter
      end
    end

    for setterKey, setter in pairs(Parent.__extended.setters) do
      if not setters[setterKey] then
        setters[setterKey] = setter
      end
    end
  end

  return setmetatable({
    __extended = {
      members = members,
      membersValues = membersValues,
      getters = getters,
      setters = setters
    },
    new = function(self, ...)
      ---@type MembersValues
      local instance<const> = {}
      for memberKey, member in pairs(members) do
        if not member.static then
          instance[memberKey] = membersValues[memberKey]
        end
      end

      if Members.constructor and not Parent then
        Members.constructor(instance, nil, ...)
      elseif Members.constructor and Parent then
        local super<const> = function(...)
          local parentInstance<const> = Parent:new(...)

          local parentMetatable<const> = debug.getmetatable(parentInstance)
          if parentMetatable and parentMetatable.__instance then
            for memberKey, memberValue in pairs(parentMetatable.__instance) do
              local parentMember<const> = Parent.__extended.members[memberKey]
              if members[memberKey] and members[memberKey].override then
              elseif parentMember and not parentMember.private then
                instance[memberKey] = memberValue
              end
            end
          end

          return parentInstance
        end
        Members.constructor(instance, super, ...)
      else error("no constructor was provided") end

      for memberKey, member in pairs(members) do
        if not instance[memberKey] and not member.static and not member.private then
          error(("the `%s` was not instantiated in constructor"):format(memberKey))
        end
      end

      if Parent and Parent.__extended then
        for memberKey, member in pairs(Parent.__extended.members) do
          if not instance[memberKey] and not member.static and not member.private then
            error(("derived member `%s` was not instantiated"):format(memberKey))
          end
        end
      end

      return setmetatable({}, {
        __metatable = "access denied",
        __instance = instance,
        __index = function(_, memberKey)
          local member<const> = members[memberKey]
          if not member then 
            if getters[memberKey] then
              return getters[memberKey](instance)
            elseif Parent and Parent.__extended then
              local parentMember<const> = Parent.__extended.members[memberKey]
              if parentMember then
                if parentMember.private then
                  error(("`%s` is not a public member"):format(memberKey))
                end
                return instance[memberKey]
              end
            elseif setters[memberKey] then
              error(("`%s` setter can not be accessed"):format(memberKey))
            end
            error(("`%s` does not exist"):format(memberKey))  
          end
          assert(not member.private, ("`%s` is not a public member"):format(memberKey))
          assert(not member.static, ("`%s` is a static member"):format(memberKey))

          local value<const> = instance[memberKey]
          if type(value) == "function" then
            return function(_, ...)
              return value(instance, ...)
            end
          end

          return value
        end,
        __newindex = function(_, memberKey, memberValue)
          if setters[memberKey] then
            setters[memberKey](instance, memberValue)
            return
          end

          local member = members[memberKey]

          if not member and Parent and Parent.__extended then
            member = Parent.__extended.members[memberKey]
          end

          if not member then 
            if getters[memberKey] then
              error(("getters can not be modified: at `%s`"):format(memberKey))
            end
            error(("`%s` does not exist"):format(memberKey))
          end

          assert(not member.private, ("`%s` is not a public member"):format(memberKey))
          assert(not member.static, ("`%s` is a static member"):format(memberKey))
          assert(not member.final, ("`%s` is a readonly member"):format(memberKey))

          instance[memberKey] = memberValue
        end
      })
    end
  }, {
    __metatable = "access denied",
    __index = function(self, memberKey)
      local member<const> = members[memberKey]
      if not member then
        if getters[memberKey] then
          return getters[memberKey](membersValues)
        elseif Parent then
          return Parent[memberKey]
        elseif setters[memberKey] then
          error(("setters can not be accessed: at `%s`"):format(memberKey))
        end
        error(("`%s` does not exist"):format(memberKey))
      end
      assert(not member.private, ("`%s` is not a public member"):format(memberKey))
      assert(member.static, ("`%s` is not a static member"):format(memberKey))
      local value<const> = membersValues[memberKey]

      if type(value) == "function" then
        return function(...)
          return value(membersValues, ...)
        end
      end

      return value
    end,
    __newindex = function(self, memberKey, memberValue)
      local member<const> = members[memberKey]
      if not member then
        if setters[memberKey] then
          setters[memberKey](membersValues, memberValue)
          return
        elseif Parent then
          Parent[memberKey] = memberValue
          return
        elseif getters[memberKey] then
          error(("getters can not be modified: at `%s`"):format(memberKey))
        end
        error(("`%s` does not exist"):format(memberKey))
      end
      assert(not member.private, ("`%s` is not a public member"):format(memberKey))
      assert(member.static, ("`%s` is not a static member"):format(memberKey))
      assert(not member.final, ("`%s` is a readonly member"):format(memberKey))
      membersValues[memberKey] = memberValue
    end
  })
end

Clerks = {}

local COUNTER = {}
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
    if it.counter then COUNTER[#COUNTER + 1] = it end
end
local busy = {}

local GIVE = { dict = 'pure247_clerk', clip = 'clerk_cig' }
local GRAB_MS, HANDOVER_MS, DONE_MS = 2330, 6130, 6950

local function ask(src, storeKey, item)
    local c = Clerks[storeKey]
    if not c then return false, 'Nobody is at the counter' end
    if busy[storeKey] then return false, 'The clerk is busy' end
    local ok, why = AddToTab(src, storeKey, item, true)
    if not ok then return false, why end
    busy[storeKey] = true
    local model
    for _, it in ipairs(COUNTER) do if it.key == item then model = it.prop end end
    Whip.core:SetNpcState(c.npcId, { anim = GIVE })
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:clerkGive', -1, c.netId, model, GRAB_MS, HANDOVER_MS)
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:receive', src, c.netId, HANDOVER_MS)
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(HANDOVER_MS)
        if GetPlayerPed(src) ~= 0 then
            local added, err = AddToTab(src, storeKey, item)
            if not added then exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, err or 'You could not take it', 'error') end
        end
        Wait(DONE_MS - HANDOVER_MS)
        Whip.core:SetNpcState(c.npcId, { anim = false })
        busy[storeKey] = nil
    end)
end

function ClerkCounter()
    local brands = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(COUNTER) do
        if #brands < 6 then brands[#brands + 1] = { id = it.key, label = ('%s  $%d'):format(it.name, it.price) } end
    end
    return brands
end
ClerkAsk = function(src, storeKey, item) return ask(src, storeKey, item) end

local function spawnOne(st)
    local npcId, netId = Whip.core:SpawnNpc({
        model = Config.Keeper, coords = st.pos, behaviour = 'stand',
        conditions = { invincible = true, canMove = false, reacts = false, flees = false },
        interior = true,
    }, { fightBack = false })
    if npcId then
        Clerks[st.key] = { npcId = npcId, netId = netId }
    else
        print(('^3[pure-247] clerk of %s not made: %s^7'):format(st.key, tostring(netId)))
    end
end

local function spawnAll()
    for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
        local c = Clerks[st.key]
        if not c or not exports.whip_core:GetNpc(c.npcId) then spawnOne(st) end
    end
end

local function blips()
    if (Config.Blip.sprite or 0) <= 0 then return end
    for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
        exports.whip_core:ShowBlip('everyone', 'store:' .. st.key, {
            coords = vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z), label = st.name,
            sprite = Config.Blip.sprite, color = Config.Blip.color, shortRange = true,
        })
    end
end

Whip.register(function()
    Clerks = {}
    blips()
    if #GetPlayers() > 0 then spawnAll() end
end)
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:loaded', function() spawnAll() end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        if #GetPlayers() > 0 then
            spawnAll()
        end
    end
end)

-- server.lua
local PACKAGE = 'mydelivery_package'

-- One run per player: [source] = { vanId, receipt, stops = { index, ... }, done }
local runs = {}

local function blipId(source) return 'mydelivery_' .. source end

local function currentStop(run)
    return run and run.stops and Config.Drops[run.stops[run.done + 1]]
end

-- Point the map at the next door, or back to the depot when the van is empty
local function showNext(source, run)
    local stop = currentStop(run)
    if stop then
        exports.whip_core:ShowBlip({ people = { source } }, blipId(source),
            { coords = stop.coords, label = 'Drop-off: ' .. stop.label, route = true })
    else
        exports.whip_core:ShowBlip({ people = { source } }, blipId(source),
            { coords = Config.Depot, label = 'Return the van', route = true, color = 2 })
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'All delivered. Take the van back for your deposit', 'success')
    end
end

-- Packages still in their pockets go back when the run ends
local function takeBackPackages(source)
    local left = exports.whip_core:GetItemCount(source, PACKAGE) or 0
    if left > 0 then exports.whip_core:RemoveItem(source, PACKAGE, left, nil, { reason = 'delivery run ended' }) end
end

local function pickStops(n)
    local order = {}
    for i = 1, #Config.Drops do order[i] = i end
    for i = #order, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
    end
    local stops = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(n, #order) do stops[i] = order[i] end
    return stops
end

Whip.register(function()
    runs = {}   -- whip_core (re)started: every van and blip went with it

    Whip.core:RegisterItem(PACKAGE, {
        name     = 'Package',
        desc     = 'Addressed and taped. Take it to the door on your map.',
        weight   = 2.0,
        stack    = true,
        maxStack = 5,
    })

    local job, why = Whip.core:EnsureJob('mydelivery', {
        name  = 'Post Op',
        roles = {
            { name = 'Manager', level = 100 },
            { name = 'Driver',  level = 1 },
        },
    })
    if not job then print('[mydelivery] no job: ' .. tostring(why)) end

    -- The depot on everyone's map (67 is GTA's van icon)
    Whip.core:ShowBlip('everyone', 'mydelivery_depot',
        { coords = Config.Depot, label = 'Post Op depot', sprite = 67, color = 5, shortRange = true })

    local atDepot = { at = Config.Depot, range = 3.0, message = 'Go to the depot desk' }

    -- Anyone may sign on as a driver
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('mydelivery:signon', { rateLimit = 3000, near = atDepot }, function(source)
        if exports.whip_core:GetPlayerRole(source, 'mydelivery') then
            return false, 'You already drive for us: clock on'
        end
        local ok, err = exports.whip_core:HirePlayer(source, 'mydelivery', 'Driver')
        if not ok then return false, err end
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'Signed on. Clock on to take a van', 'success')
    end)

    -- A van for a deposit, its boot loaded with packages, and a route to the first door
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('mydelivery:start', { rateLimit = 3000, near = atDepot }, function(source, player)
        if not exports.whip_core:IsPlayerClockedOn(source, 'mydelivery') then return false, 'Clock on first' end
        if runs[source] then return false, 'You already have a van out' end

        local run = { done = 0 }
        runs[source] = run   -- held now, so a second press is refused while the van is made
        local function undo(reason, receipt, vanId)
            if runs[source] == run then runs[source] = nil end
            if vanId then exports.whip_core:DespawnVehicle(vanId) end
            if receipt then exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt) end
            return false, reason
        end

        local receipt, err = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(source, Config.Deposit, { method = 'bank', reason = 'Van deposit' })
        if not receipt then return undo(err) end

        -- 25 minutes: the deposit can be refunded for 30
        local vanId, verr = exports.whip_core:SpawnTempVehicle(Config.VanModel, Config.VanSpawn, {
            forSource = source, despawnAfter = 1500,
        })
        if not vanId then return undo(verr, receipt) end

        local slot, gerr = exports.whip_core:StoreGive({ kind = 'vehicle', id = vanId, sub = 'trunk' },
            PACKAGE, Config.Packages, nil, 'delivery run')
        if not slot then return undo(gerr, receipt, vanId) end

        -- The waits above took time: still the same character, and still this run?
        if runs[source] ~= run or not exports.whip_core:IsSessionCurrent(source, player.session) then
            return undo(nil, receipt, vanId)
        end

        run.vanId, run.receipt, run.stops = vanId, receipt, pickStops(Config.Packages)
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'The van is outside. Take a package from the boot and follow the route', 'success')
        showNext(source, run)
    end)

    -- At the door: the server times the bar, takes the package and pays
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('mydelivery:drop', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        near = {
            at = function(source)
                local stop = currentStop(runs[source])
                return stop and stop.coords   -- nil: no package due here, refused as too far
            end,
            range   = 3.0,
            message = 'Not this door: follow the route on your map',
        },
    }, function(source, player)
        local run = runs[source]
        local stop = currentStop(run)
        if not exports.whip_core:HasItem(source, PACKAGE) then return false, 'Take a package from the van first' end

        local done, reason = exports.whip_core:Progress(source, {
            label    = 'Delivering...',
            duration = 4000,
            near     = { coords = stop.coords, range = 3.0 },
        })
        if not done then return false, reason end
        if runs[source] ~= run or not exports.whip_core:IsSessionCurrent(source, player.session) then return end

        local taken, terr = exports.whip_core:RemoveItem(source, PACKAGE, 1, nil, { reason = 'delivered' })
        if not taken then return false, terr end
        run.done = run.done + 1
        exports.whip_core:PayPlayer(source, Config.Pay, { reason = 'Delivery: ' .. stop.label })
        showNext(source, run)
    end)

    -- The van back at the depot: it goes, and so does the deposit, back to them
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('mydelivery:finish', { rateLimit = 3000, near = atDepot }, function(source)
        local run = runs[source]
        if not run or not run.vanId then return false, 'You have no van out' end

        local van = exports.whip_core:GetVehicle(run.vanId)
        if not van or not van.coords or #(van.coords - Config.Depot) > Config.VanBack then
            return false, 'Park the van at the depot first'
        end

        runs[source] = nil
        exports.whip_core:HideBlip(blipId(source))
        exports.whip_core:DespawnVehicle(run.vanId)
        exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(run.receipt)
        takeBackPackages(source)
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, ('Van returned. $%d deposit back'):format(Config.Deposit), 'success')
    end)
end)

-- Leaving ends the run: the van goes, the deposit stays with the depot
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:logout', function(e)
    if GetInvokingResource() ~= 'whip_core' or type(e) ~= 'table' then return end
    local run = runs[e.source]
    if not run then return end
    runs[e.source] = nil
    exports.whip_core:HideBlip(blipId(e.source))
    if run.vanId then exports.whip_core:DespawnVehicle(run.vanId) end
    takeBackPackages(e.source)
end)

-- The van went without being returned: its time ran out, or it sat alone for ten minutes
AddEventHandler('whip_core:vehicle:released', function(e)
    if GetInvokingResource() ~= 'whip_core' or type(e) ~= 'table' or e.reason == 'despawned' then return end
    for source, run in pairs(runs) do
        if run.vanId == e.vehicleId then
            runs[source] = nil
            exports.whip_core:HideBlip(blipId(source))
            takeBackPackages(source)
            exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'The depot took the van back. Your deposit is kept', 'error')
            return
        end
    end
end)

local PICTURES = '@whip_media_props/img/props/%s.webp'

Prices = {}
for key, it in pairs(Config.CoreItems) do Prices[key] = it.price end
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do Prices[it.key] = it.price end

local function feed(def)
    return function(source)
        local hunger = Whip.core:GetItemSetting(def.key, 'hunger') or def.hunger or 0
        local thirst = Whip.core:GetItemSetting(def.key, 'thirst') or def.thirst or 0
        local ok, why = true, nil
        if hunger > 0 then ok, why = Whip.core:AddStat(source, 'hunger', hunger, 'item:' .. def.key) end
        if ok and thirst > 0 then ok, why = Whip.core:AddStat(source, 'thirst', thirst, 'item:' .. def.key) end
        return ok, why
    end
end

local function open(def)
    return function(source)
        local o = def.opens
        local fits, why = Whip.core:CanFitItem(source, o.item, o.amount)
        if not fits then return false, why or 'No room for them' end
        local ok, err = Whip.core:AddItem(source, o.item, o.amount, nil, { reason = 'opened ' .. def.key })
        if not ok then return false, err or 'Could not open it' end
        return true
    end
end

local function smoke(def)
    return function(source)
        if exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(source) then return false, 'Your hands are full' end
        TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:smoke', source, def.smoke)
        return true
    end
end

local function registerItems()
    for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
        local edible = (it.hunger or 0) > 0 or (it.thirst or 0) > 0
        local special = it.opens ~= nil or it.smoke ~= nil
        local ok, why = Whip.core:RegisterItem(it.key, {
            name = it.name, desc = it.desc, weight = it.weight or 0.2, type = edible and 'consumable' or 'misc',
            stack = true, maxStack = it.maxStack or 20, usable = edible or special, cooldown = (edible or special) and 3 or nil,
            prop = it.prop or it.picture,

            image = it.picture and PICTURES:format(it.picture) or nil,
            settings = edible and {
                { key = 'hunger', type = 'int', default = it.hunger or 0, min = 0, max = 100, label = 'Hunger restored' },
                { key = 'thirst', type = 'int', default = it.thirst or 0, min = 0, max = 100, label = 'Thirst restored' },
            } or nil,
        })
        if not ok then Whip.startProblem('item %s refused: %s', it.key, tostring(why)) end
        if edible then Whip.core:RegisterUseHandler(it.key, feed(it)) end
        if it.opens then Whip.core:RegisterUseHandler(it.key, open(it)) end
        if it.smoke then Whip.core:RegisterUseHandler(it.key, smoke(it)) end
    end
end

local function removeOldShops()
    CreateThread(function()
        for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
            local shop = exports.whip_core:GetShop({ key = 'pure-247_' .. st.key })
            if shop then
                local ok, why = exports.whip_core:DeleteShop(shop.shopId)
                print(ok and ('[pure-247] removed the old WHIP shop of %s (the clerk sells now)'):format(st.key)
                    or ('^3[pure-247] old WHIP shop of %s not removed: %s^7'):format(st.key, tostring(why)))
            end
        end
    end)
end

exports('GetStores', function()
    local out = {}
    for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
        local goods = {}
        for item, price in pairs(Prices) do goods[item] = price end
        out[#out + 1] = { key = 'pure-247_' .. st.key, name = st.name, coords = vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z), goods = goods }
    end
    return out
end)

Whip.register(function()
    registerItems()
    removeOldShops()
end)

Whip.sayStarted()

if not Config.Shelves or not Config.Shelves.enabled then return end

local S = Config.Shelves
local baskets = {}
local clerkPts = {}
local after = {}
local goods = {}

local function say(src, text, kind) exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, text, kind or 'info') end

local function priceAt(_, item)
    local p = tonumber(Prices[item])
    return p and p >= 0 and math.floor(p) or nil
end

local function nameOf(item)
    local def = exports.whip_core:GetItemDef(item)
    return def and def.name or item
end

local function inStore(src, storeKey)
    local st = Rooms.store(storeKey)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not st or ped == 0 then return false end
    local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    return #(c - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) <= 15.0
end

local function priced(b)
    local lines, total, count = {}, 0, 0
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do
        local price = priceAt(b.store, item)
        if price then
            lines[#lines + 1] = { item = item, qty = qty, price = price }
            total = total + price * qty
            count = count + qty
        end
    end
    table.sort(lines, function(a, c) return a.item < c.item end)
    return lines, total, count
end

local TAG = 'basket'
local FULL_TAG = GetCurrentResourceName() .. ':' .. TAG

local function holdBasket(src)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B or not B.model then return end
    local ok, why = exports.whip_core:HoldProps(src, { { model = B.model, bone = B.bone, offset = B.offset, rot = B.rot } }, TAG)
    if not ok then print(('^3[pure-247] basket not put in the hand: %s^7'):format(tostring(why))) end
end

local HANDS_TAG = 'hands'
local FULL_HANDS = GetCurrentResourceName() .. ':' .. HANDS_TAG

local function units(b)
    local n = 0
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do n = n + qty * (Goods.isBig(item) and 2 or 1) end
    return n
end

local function handsOf(lines)
    local list = {}
    for item, qty in pairs(lines) do for _ = 1, qty do list[#list + 1] = item end end
    table.sort(list)
    if list[1] and Goods.isBig(list[1]) then return { right = list[1] } end
    return { left = list[1], right = list[2] }
end

local function holdHeld(src, held)
    local props = {}
    for _, hand in ipairs({ 'left', 'right' }) do
        local h = held[hand] and Goods.hold(held[hand], hand)
        if h then props[#props + 1] = h end
    end
    if #props > 0 then exports.whip_core:HoldProps(src, props, HANDS_TAG)
    elseif exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == FULL_HANDS then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, HANDS_TAG) end

    local fists = (held.left and 'L' or '') .. (held.right and 'R' or '')
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:fists', fists ~= '' and fists or nil, true)
end

local function holdHands(src, b) holdHeld(src, handsOf(b.lines)) end

local function letGoBasket(src)
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:fists', nil, true)
    local tag = exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src)
    if tag == FULL_TAG then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, TAG)
    elseif tag == FULL_HANDS then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, HANDS_TAG) end
end

local function finishAfter(src)
    local a = after[src]
    if not a then return end
    after[src] = nil
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', nil, true)
    letGoBasket(src)
end

local function showList(src)
    if not S.showList then return end
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) return end
    local lines, total = priced(b)
    local parts = {}
    for i, l in ipairs(lines) do
        if i > 4 then parts[#parts + 1] = ('+%d more'):format(#lines - 4) break end
        parts[#parts + 1] = ('%d× %s'):format(l.qty, nameOf(l.item))
    end
    local row = #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, '  ·  ') or 'empty: take goods off the racks'
    exports.whip_core:ShowPlayerText(src, ('%s  $%d | %s'):format(b.hand and 'In your hands' or 'Basket', total, row),
        { position = 'top', icon = 'pickup' })
end

local function syncGoods(src)
    local b = baskets[src]
    local list = nil
    if b and not b.hand then
        list = {}
        for item in pairs(b.lines) do list[#list + 1] = item end
        table.sort(list)
    end
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', list, true)
end

local function dropBasket(src, why)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then return end
    baskets[src] = nil
    syncGoods(src)
    if clerkPts[src] then RefreshClerk(src) end
    letGoBasket(src)
    if S.showList then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) end
    if why then say(src, why) end
end

local pay

local function tillLabel(b)
    local _, total, count = priced(b)
    return ('Pay $%d · %d item%s'):format(total, count, count == 1 and '' or 's')
end

local function clerkMenu(src, store)
    local b = baskets[src]
    local opts, label = {}, 'Clerk'
    if b and b.store == store and next(b.lines) then
        label = tillLabel(b)
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'cash', label = 'Pay in cash' }
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'bank', label = 'Pay by card' }
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'empty', label = 'Put it all back' }
    end
    local brands = ClerkCounter and ClerkCounter() or {}
    if #brands > 0 then opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'cigs', label = 'Ask for cigarettes', options = brands } end
    return label, opts
end

function RefreshClerk(src, store)
    local cur = clerkPts[src]
    store = store or (cur and cur.store)
    if not store then return end
    local clerk = Clerks and Clerks[store]
    local netId = clerk and clerk.netId and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(clerk.netId) ~= 0 and clerk.netId or nil
    local label, opts = clerkMenu(src, store)
    if cur and cur.store == store and cur.netId == netId and cur.pointId then
        exports.whip_core:UpdatePoint(cur.pointId, { label = label, options = opts })
        return
    end
    if cur and cur.pointId then exports.whip_core:RemovePoint(cur.pointId) end
    clerkPts[src] = nil
    local where
    if netId then
        where = { netId = netId, offset = vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.15) }
    else
        local at = Rooms.at(store, 'pay')
        if not at then return end
        where = { coords = at }
    end
    local id, why = exports.whip_core:AddPoint({
        at = where, label = label, talk = true, options = opts,
        audience = { people = { src } }, reach = 2.5, seeFrom = 8.0,
        onUse = function(source, use)
            if (use.path or ''):sub(1, 5) == 'cigs/' then return ClerkAsk(source, store, use.option) end
            return pay(source, use.option)
        end,
    })
    if id then clerkPts[src] = { store = store, pointId = id, netId = netId }
    else print(('^3[pure-247] clerk prompt not made: %s^7'):format(tostring(why))) end
end

local function dropClerk(src)
    local cur = clerkPts[src]
    if cur and cur.pointId then exports.whip_core:RemovePoint(cur.pointId) end
    clerkPts[src] = nil
end

local function showTill(src)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if b then RefreshClerk(src, b.store) end
end

pay = function(src, option)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then return false, 'Your basket is empty' end
    if option == 'empty' then
        dropBasket(src, 'You put everything back on the shelves')
        return true
    end
    local lines, total = priced(b)
    if #lines == 0 then dropBasket(src) return false, 'Nothing in your basket is for sale any more' end
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
        local fits, why = exports.whip_core:CanFitItem(src, l.item, l.qty)
        if not fits then return false, ('No room for %d %s: %s'):format(l.qty, nameOf(l.item), why or 'your pockets are full') end
    end
    local me = exports.whip_core:GetPlayer(src)
    local session = me and me.session
    local receipt, why = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(src, total, {
        method = option == 'bank' and 'bank' or 'cash', reason = ('24/7: %d items'):format(#lines),
    })
    if not receipt then return false, why end

    if not exports.whip_core:IsSessionCurrent(src, session) then
        exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt)
        return false, 'That did not go through'
    end

    local undelivered, bought = 0, {}
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
        local where = exports.whip_core:AddItem(src, l.item, l.qty, nil, { reason = '24/7 shelf purchase', noDrop = true })
        if where then
            bought[#bought + 1] = { itemKey = l.item, price = l.price, amount = l.qty }
        else
            undelivered = undelivered + l.price * l.qty
        end
    end
    if undelivered > 0 then exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt, undelivered) end
    local store = b.store

    local count, list = 0, {}
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do count = count + qty list[#list + 1] = item end
    table.sort(list)
    baskets[src] = nil
    if clerkPts[src] then RefreshClerk(src) end
    if S.showList then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) end
    local held = b.hand and handsOf(b.lines) or nil
    after[src] = { store = store, hand = b.hand, list = list, held = held, stuffs = math.min(count, 4),
                   untilMs = GetGameTimer() + 40000 }
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:paid', src, { store = store, hand = b.hand == true, stuffs = math.min(count, 4),
        left = held and held.left ~= nil, right = held and held.right ~= nil })
    say(src, ('Paid $%d. Thanks for shopping at 24/7!'):format(total - undelivered), 'success')
    CreateThread(function()
        Whip.core:LogActivity(src, 'pure-247_shelf_purchase', { detail = ('%s: $%d'):format(store, total - undelivered) })
    end)

    TriggerEvent('pure-247:purchased', {
        source = src, shopKey = 'pure-247_' .. store, store = store, paymentMethod = receipt.method, items = bought,
    })
    return true
end

function AddToTab(src, store, item, checkOnly)
    local price = priceAt(store, item)
    if not price then return false, 'That is not for sale here' end
    local b = baskets[src]
    if b and b.store ~= store then
        if checkOnly then b = nil else dropBasket(src) b = nil end
    end
    if not checkOnly then finishAfter(src) end
    local fresh = false
    if not b then

        b = { store = store, lines = {}, hand = true }
        fresh = true
    end
    if b.hand and units(b) + (Goods.isBig(item) and 2 or 1) > (S.handUnits or 2) then
        return false, next(b.lines) and 'Your hands are full: take a basket from the stack by the door'
            or 'That is too big to carry: take a basket from the stack by the door'
    end
    local n = 0 for _ in pairs(b.lines) do n = n + 1 end
    if not b.lines[item] and n >= S.maxLines then return false, 'Your basket is full' end
    if (b.lines[item] or 0) >= S.maxEach then return false, ('That is all the %s you can take'):format(nameOf(item)) end
    if checkOnly then return true end
    if fresh then
        baskets[src] = b
        if not b.hand then holdBasket(src) end
    end
    b.lines[item] = (b.lines[item] or 0) + 1
    if b.hand then holdHands(src, b) end
    syncGoods(src)
    showTill(src)
    if S.showList then
        showList(src)
    else
        local _, total = priced(b)
        say(src, ('+1 %s · $%d, pay the clerk'):format(nameOf(item), total))
    end
    return true
end

Whip.register(function()

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:grab', {
        rateLimit = 300, burst = 5,
        params = { { 'store', 'string', 24 }, { 'index', 'id', 1, 200 } },
    }, function(src, _, store, index)
        if not Config.Rooms[store] or not inStore(src, store) then return false, 'You are not in that store' end

        goods[store] = goods[store] or Rooms.goodsAt(store)
        local g = goods[store][index]
        if not g then return false, 'That is not for sale here' end
        local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
        if ped == 0 or #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - g.coords) > 3.0 then return false, 'Too far from the shelf' end
        return AddToTab(src, store, g.item)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:takeBasket', {
        rateLimit = 800,
        params = { { 'store', 'string', 24 } },
    }, function(src, _, store)
        if not Config.Rooms[store] or not inStore(src, store) then return false, 'You are not in that store' end
        local b = baskets[src]
        finishAfter(src)
        if b and b.store == store then
            if b.hand then

                b.hand = nil
                holdBasket(src)
                syncGoods(src)
                showList(src)
                return
            end
            if next(b.lines) == nil then dropBasket(src, 'You put the basket back') return end
            return false, 'You already have a basket'
        end
        if b then dropBasket(src) end
        baskets[src] = { store = store, lines = {} }
        holdBasket(src)
        syncGoods(src)
        showList(src)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:stuffed', {
        rateLimit = 300, burst = 4,
        params = { { 'hand', 'string', 8 } },
    }, function(src, _, hand)
        local a = after[src]
        if not a then return end
        if a.hand then
            if hand ~= 'left' and hand ~= 'right' then return end
            a.held[hand] = nil
            holdHeld(src, a.held)
            if not a.held.left and not a.held.right then after[src] = nil end
            return
        end

        local take = math.ceil(#a.list / math.max(1, a.stuffs))
        for _ = 1, take do table.remove(a.list) end
        a.stuffs = math.max(0, a.stuffs - 1)
        Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', #a.list > 0 and a.list or nil, true)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:returned', { rateLimit = 500 }, function(src)
        local a = after[src]
        if a and not a.hand then finishAfter(src) end
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureCallback('pure-247:prices', { rateLimit = 2000 }, function()
        local out = {}
        for key in pairs(Config.Rooms) do out[key] = Prices end
        return out
    end)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(4000)
        for src, b in pairs(baskets) do
            local st = Rooms.store(b.store)
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
            if ped == 0 or not st then
                dropBasket(src)
            elseif #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) > (S.leaveMeters or 25) then
                dropBasket(src, b.hand and 'You left the store: what you had not paid for went back on the shelves'
                    or 'You left the store: your basket went back on the shelves')
            elseif exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == nil then

                if b.hand then holdHands(src, b) elseif S.basket and S.basket.model then holdBasket(src) end
            end
        end

        local now = GetGameTimer()
        for src, a in pairs(after) do
            if GetPlayerPed(src) == 0 or now > a.untilMs then finishAfter(src) end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() dropBasket(source) after[source] = nil dropClerk(source) end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(1500)
        local seen = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
            local src = tonumber(id)
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
            if ped ~= 0 then
                local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
                for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
                    if #(c - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) < 15.0 then
                        seen[src] = true
                        local cur = clerkPts[src]

                        local clerk = Clerks and Clerks[st.key]
                        local live = clerk and clerk.netId and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(clerk.netId) ~= 0 and clerk.netId or nil
                        if not cur or cur.store ~= st.key or cur.netId ~= live then RefreshClerk(src, st.key) end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for src in pairs(clerkPts) do
            if not seen[src] then dropClerk(src) end
        end
    end
end)

local POSE_KVP = 'pure-247:basketPose:v2'
local function applyPose(p)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B then return end
    if type(p) == 'table' then
        if type(p.offset) == 'table' then B.offset = p.offset end
        if type(p.rot) == 'table' then B.rot = p.rot end
        if tonumber(p.pose) then B.pose = math.floor(tonumber(p.pose)) end
    end
    GlobalState['pure-247:carryPose'] = B.pose or 1
end
do
    local ok, saved = pcall(json.decode, GetResourceKvpString(POSE_KVP) or 'null')
    applyPose(ok and saved or nil)
end

Whip.command('basketedit', { dev = true, console = false }, function(src)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B or not B.model then return say(src, 'Config.Shelves.basket has no model', 'error') end
    if exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == FULL_TAG then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, TAG) end
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:basketEdit', src, { model = B.model, bone = B.bone, offset = B.offset, rot = B.rot, pose = B.pose or 1 })
end)

local function num3(t, lim)
    if type(t) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local v = tonumber(t[i])
        if not v or v ~= v or math.abs(v) > lim then return nil end
        out[i] = math.floor(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
    end
    return out
end

Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:saveBasketPose', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { { 'offset', 'any' }, { 'rot', 'any' }, { 'pose', 'int', 1, 4 } },
    }, function(src, _, offset, rot, pose)
        if not IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'whip.devtools') then return false, 'Only staff place the basket' end
        local o, r = num3(offset, 1.0), num3(rot, 360.0)
        if not o or not r then return false, 'That placement could not be read' end
        local p = { offset = o, rot = r, pose = pose }
        SetResourceKvp(POSE_KVP, json.encode(p))
        applyPose(p)
        holdBasket(src)
        local line = ('offset = { %.3f, %.3f, %.3f }, rot = { %.1f, %.1f, %.1f }, pose = %d'):format(o[1], o[2], o[3], r[1], r[2], r[3], pose)
        print('[pure-247] basket hold saved (kept across restarts): ' .. line)
        say(src, 'Basket hold saved for everyone', 'success')
    end)
end)

-- Client: a prompt at the counter. Press E to ask the server; the server decides.
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id       = 'counter',
        at       = { coords = Config.Counter },
        reach    = Config.Range,
        label    = function() return ('Buy a snack ($%d)'):format(Config.Price) end,
        icon     = 'cash',
        onSelect = function()
            TriggerServerEvent('myres:buy')
        end,
    })
end)

function Goods.model(item)
    if MODELS[item] then return MODELS[item] end
    local d = defs[item]
    if d and d.prop then return d.prop end

    if d and d.picture and not d.picture:find('^v_ret_247_') then return d.picture end
    return nil
end

function Goods.isBig(item) return BIG[item] == true end

function Goods.hold(item, hand)
    local m = Goods.model(item)
    local h = m and Goods.HOLD[m] and Goods.HOLD[m][hand == 'left' and 'L' or 'R']
    if not h then return nil end
    return { model = m, bone = PH[hand] or PH.right, offset = h.offset, rot = h.rot }
end
